<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>TRACE Acquisition OS — Final</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#10141A;
  --bg-elev:#171D26;
  --bg-card:#1B222C;
  --bg-card-hover:#212A36;
  --border:#2A3340;
  --border-soft:#232B36;
  --text:#E7E4DC;
  --text-dim:#9AA3AF;
  --text-faint:#5C6673;
  --accent:#C9A15D;
  --accent-soft:#3A3324;
  --accent-2:#4C8C8C;
  --accent-2-soft:#1E2E2E;
  --danger:#C1554A;
  --danger-soft:#33201E;
  --radius:10px;
  --font-display:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;
  --font-body:'Inter',sans-serif;
  --font-mono:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;}
body{
  background:var(--bg);
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:var(--font-body);
  font-size:14px;
  line-height:1.5;
}
::selection{background:var(--accent);color:#10141A;}
a{color:inherit;}

/* ---------- layout ---------- */
#app{display:flex;min-height:100vh;}
.sidebar{
  width:220px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--bg-elev);
  border-right:1px solid var(--border-soft);
  padding:22px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;
  position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;
}
.brand{
  font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;
  letter-spacing:0.02em;margin-bottom:2px;
}
.brand-sub{
  font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--accent);
  letter-spacing:0.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:26px;
}
.nav-item{
  padding:9px 12px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text-dim);
  font-size:13px;font-weight:500;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  transition:background .12s,color .12s;
}
.nav-item:hover{background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);}
.nav-item.active{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);}
.nav-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;opacity:.6;}
.sidebar-footer{margin-top:auto;font-size:11px;color:var(--text-faint);padding:12px;font-family:var(--font-mono);}

.main{flex:1;padding:28px 34px;max-width:1280px;}
.page{display:none;}
.page.active{display:block;}

.page-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;}
.page-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:22px;font-weight:700;}
.page-subtitle{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:12.5px;margin-top:4px;}

/* ---------- buttons / inputs ---------- */
.btn{
  font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;
  padding:8px 14px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--border);
  background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;
  transition:background .12s,border-color .12s;white-space:nowrap;
}
.btn:hover{background:var(--bg-card-hover);border-color:var(--text-faint);}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;}
.btn-accent{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#181109;}
.btn-accent:hover{background:#dab174;}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;border-color:transparent;color:var(--text-dim);}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--bg-card);color:var(--text);}
.btn-sm{padding:5px 10px;font-size:11.5px;}
.btn-danger{color:var(--danger);}

input[type=text],input[type=number],input[type=url],textarea,select{
  font-family:var(--font-body);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);
  color:var(--text);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:13px;width:100%;
}
textarea{resize:vertical;font-family:var(--font-body);}
label{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-dim);font-weight:600;display:block;margin-bottom:5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;}
.field{margin-bottom:14px;}
.field-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;}

/* ---------- stat cards ---------- */
.stats-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:26px;}
.stat-card{
  background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:16px 16px;
}
.stat-value{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:26px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);}
.stat-label{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-dim);margin-top:4px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;}

/* ---------- lead cards ---------- */
.section-label{
  font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--accent);
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;margin:26px 0 12px;
}
.lead-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:12px;}
.lead-card{
  background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:16px;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .12s,background .12s;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;
}
.lead-card:hover{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--bg-card-hover);}
.lead-card-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;}
.lead-name{font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;}
.lead-meta{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-dim);margin-top:2px;}
.score-badge{
  font-family:var(--font-mono);font-weight:600;font-size:13px;
  padding:4px 9px;border-radius:6px;flex-shrink:0;
}
.score-high{background:var(--accent-2-soft);color:var(--accent-2);}
.score-mid{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);}
.score-low{background:var(--danger-soft);color:var(--danger);}
.score-none{background:var(--bg-elev);color:var(--text-faint);border:1px dashed var(--border);}
.lead-tags{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.tag{
  font-size:10.5px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--bg-elev);
  color:var(--text-dim);border:1px solid var(--border-soft);
}
.lead-angle{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-dim);border-top:1px solid var(--border-soft);padding-top:8px;margin-top:2px;}
.lead-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:2px;}
.outreach-hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg-elev),var(--bg-card));border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.outreach-hero-title{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:4px;}
.outreach-hero-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:10px;}
.btn-instagram{background:#1f2430;border:1px solid #5d6575;color:#fff;}
.btn-instagram:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);}

.status-pill{
  font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:600;
  padding:3px 8px;border-radius:20px;
}
.status-new{background:#22303f;color:#7fb1d6;}
.status-analyzed{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);}
.status-contacted{background:#2b3350;color:#9aa6e6;}
.status-replied{background:var(--accent-2-soft);color:var(--accent-2);}
.status-meeting{background:#2f4a2f;color:#8fce8f;}
.status-not_a_fit,.status-closed{background:var(--bg-elev);color:var(--text-faint);}

.empty-state{
  border:1px dashed var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:38px 20px;
  text-align:center;color:var(--text-faint);font-size:13px;
}

/* ---------- table (leads page) ---------- */
.table-wrap{background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.5px;}
th{
  text-align:left;padding:10px 12px;color:var(--text-faint);font-weight:600;
  text-transform:uppercase;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.05em;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);
  background:var(--bg-elev);
}
td{padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);}
tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
tr.row-clickable:hover{background:var(--bg-card-hover);cursor:pointer;}

.toolbar{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;}
.toolbar select,.toolbar input{width:auto;min-width:150px;}

/* ---------- modal ---------- */
.modal-backdrop{
  position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(6,8,11,.72);display:none;
  align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;z-index:100;padding:36px 16px;overflow-y:auto;
}
.modal-backdrop.open{display:flex;}
.modal{
  background:var(--bg-elev);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;
  max-width:760px;width:100%;padding:26px 28px 30px;position:relative;
}
.modal-close{
  position:absolute;top:18px;right:20px;background:none;border:none;color:var(--text-faint);
  font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;line-height:1;
}
.modal-close:hover{color:var(--text);}
.modal h2{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:19px;margin:0 0 2px;}
.modal .lead-meta{margin-bottom:18px;}

.detail-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin-bottom:20px;}
.detail-block{background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:9px;padding:14px 16px;}
.detail-block h4{
  margin:0 0 10px;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;
  color:var(--text-faint);font-weight:600;
}
.kv{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12.5px;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);}
.kv:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.kv-k{color:var(--text-dim);}
.kv-v{font-family:var(--font-mono);text-align:right;}
.unknown{color:var(--text-faint);font-style:italic;}

.dim-bar-row{margin-bottom:9px;}
.dim-bar-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:3px;}
.dim-bar-track{height:6px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;}
.dim-bar-fill{height:100%;background:var(--accent);border-radius:4px;}

.hypothesis-badge{
  font-size:9.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:700;
  color:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 5px;margin-left:6px;
}
.pain-point{font-size:12.5px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);}
.pain-point:last-child{border-bottom:none;}

.dm-box{
  background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:9px;
  padding:14px 16px;font-size:13px;white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.6;
}
.ai-disclaimer{
  font-size:11px;color:var(--text-faint);margin-top:8px;line-height:1.5;
  border-left:2px solid var(--border);padding-left:9px;
}
.spinner{
  display:inline-block;width:13px;height:13px;border:2px solid var(--border);
  border-top-color:var(--accent);border-radius:50%;animation:spin .7s linear infinite;
  vertical-align:-2px;margin-right:6px;
}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg);}}

.toast{
  position:fixed;bottom:20px;right:20px;background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:8px;padding:10px 16px;font-size:12.5px;z-index:200;box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  display:none;
}
.csv-help{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-faint);margin-top:6px;font-family:var(--font-mono);line-height:1.6;}


/* ---------- acquisition command center ---------- */
.hero-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--bg-card),#202936);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:24px;margin-bottom:20px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.hero-card:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:220px;height:220px;border:1px solid rgba(201,161,93,.10);border-radius:50%;right:-80px;top:-100px;}
.hero-eyebrow{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--accent);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px;}
.hero-title{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:28px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.12;margin-bottom:7px;max-width:720px;}
.hero-copy{color:var(--text-dim);font-size:13px;max-width:700px;margin-bottom:18px;}
.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;}
.hero-status{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-faint);font-family:var(--font-mono);margin-top:12px;}
.quick-card{background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:12px;padding:15px;}
.quick-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:22px;}
.quick-value{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:22px;font-weight:600;}
.quick-label{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-dim);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-top:3px;}
.source-status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:11px;color:var(--text-dim);padding:4px 8px;border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:20px;background:var(--bg-elev);}
.source-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent-2);}
.source-dot.off{background:var(--text-faint);}
.discovery-simple{max-width:760px;}
.discovery-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;}
.discovery-big-btn{font-size:13px;padding:11px 16px;}
.advanced{margin-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border-soft);padding-top:12px;}
.advanced summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--text-dim);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;}
.muted-note{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-faint);line-height:1.55;}
.data-source-chip{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--text-faint);}


/* ---------- V2/V3 intelligence UI ---------- */
.action-strip{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 20px;}
.pipeline-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.pipeline-summary .quick-card{min-height:74px;}
.kanban{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:10px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:6px;}
.kanban-col{background:var(--bg-elev);border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:10px;min-height:420px;padding:10px;}
.kanban-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--text-dim);}
.kanban-count{font-family:var(--font-mono);color:var(--accent);}
.kanban-card{background:var(--bg-card);border:1px solid var(--border-soft);border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer;}
.kanban-card:hover{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--bg-card-hover);}
.kanban-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px;}
.kanban-meta{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-dim);}
.next-action{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--accent);margin-top:7px;border-top:1px solid var(--border-soft);padding-top:6px;}
.follow-card{min-height:150px;}
.follow-card.overdue{border-color:var(--danger);}
.follow-date{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--accent);}
.learning-bar{height:7px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:5px;}
.learning-fill{height:100%;background:var(--accent-2);}
.funnel-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr 60px;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:8px 0;font-size:12px;}
.funnel-track{height:9px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden;}
.funnel-fill{height:100%;background:var(--accent);}
@media(max-width:1100px){.kanban{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,220px)}.pipeline-summary{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}

@media (max-width:900px){
  #app{flex-direction:column;}
  .sidebar{width:100%;height:auto;position:relative;flex-direction:row;overflow-x:auto;padding:14px;}
  .brand,.brand-sub,.sidebar-footer{display:none;}
  .stats-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  .detail-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .main{padding:18px;}
}

/* TRACE Consultant embedded mode: no second-app chrome. */
@media (min-width:1px){
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"],html[data-trace-embedded="1"] body{background:#f4f5f9;color:#171a21;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .sidebar{display:none!important;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] #app{display:block!important;min-height:100%;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .main{width:100%;max-width:none;padding:22px 0 34px;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .page-header{display:none!important;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"]{overflow-x:hidden;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .sidebar,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .brand,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .brand-sub,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .sidebar-footer{display:none!important;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .page{padding-top:0!important;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .hero-card,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .stat-card,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .quick-card,
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .action-strip,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .discovery-simple,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .detail-block,
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .table-wrap,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .lead-card,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .outreach-hero{
    background:#fff;border-color:#e8eaf1;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(23,26,33,.03),0 8px 24px -18px rgba(23,26,33,.12);
  }
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .lead-card:hover{background:#fbfbfd;border-color:#f9622c;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] input[type=text],html[data-trace-embedded="1"] input[type=number],html[data-trace-embedded="1"] input[type=url],
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] textarea,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] select{background:#fff;color:#171a21;border-color:#e0e3ea;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .btn{background:#fff;color:#4b5563;border-color:#e0e3ea;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .btn-accent{background:#f9622c;color:#fff;border-color:#f9622c;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .section-label,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .hero-eyebrow{color:#f9622c;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .page-title,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .hero-title,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .lead-name,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .outreach-hero-title{color:#171a21;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .page-subtitle,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .lead-meta,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .lead-angle,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .hero-copy,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .muted-note,html[data-trace-embedded="1"] .stat-label{color:#6b7280;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] th{background:#f7f8fb;color:#7d8494;border-color:#eef0f5;}
  html[data-trace-embedded="1"] td{border-color:#eef0f5;}
}

/* Phase 2 — Evidence & explainability surface */
.evidence-panel{margin-top:14px;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.96),rgba(248,249,251,.92));box-shadow:0 12px 35px -28px rgba(20,24,31,.35)}
.evidence-panel-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
.evidence-status{font:800 10px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:999px}
.evidence-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.evidence-metrics>div{padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:#fff}.evidence-metrics span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}.evidence-metrics b{display:block;margin-top:3px;font:800 18px var(--mono)}
.evidence-row,.score-breakdown-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(20,24,31,.07);font-size:12px}.evidence-row:last-child,.score-breakdown-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}.evidence-ok{font:700 10px var(--mono);color:#287a50}.evidence-missing{font:700 10px var(--mono);color:#9a5d26}.score-breakdown{margin:8px 0}.score-breakdown-row span:last-child{font-family:var(--mono)}
@media(max-width:720px){.evidence-metrics{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.evidence-metrics>div:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}}

/* Acquisition UX simplification: workflow first, advanced pages preserved. */
.trace-acq-flow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;margin:0 0 16px}
.trace-acq-flow button{border:1px solid #e4e7ec;background:#fff;border-radius:13px;padding:11px 12px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s ease}
.trace-acq-flow button:hover{border-color:#f9622c;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.trace-acq-flow b{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#101828}.trace-acq-flow span{display:block;font-size:9.5px;color:#667085;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.3}
@media(max-width:700px){.trace-acq-flow{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:460px){.trace-acq-flow{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>

<style id="trace-acquisition-premium-v62">
/* TRACE Acquisition OS premium layer. Existing data/JS contracts untouched. */
body{background:#f6f7f9!important;color:#101828!important;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
#app{min-height:100vh}
.sidebar{background:#fcfcfd!important;border-right:1px solid #e4e7ec!important}
.main{background:radial-gradient(700px 280px at 80% -8%,rgba(255,106,42,.06),transparent 65%),#f6f7f9!important;max-width:none!important}
.page-title,.hero-title,.lead-name,.outreach-hero-title{letter-spacing:-.035em!important;color:#101828!important}
.hero-card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#f8fafc)!important;border:1px solid #e4e7ec!important;border-radius:20px!important;box-shadow:0 18px 45px -30px rgba(16,24,40,.25)!important;padding:28px!important}
.hero-eyebrow,.section-label{color:#f05b25!important;font-weight:800!important}
.hero-title{font-size:32px!important;line-height:1.08!important}
.hero-copy,.page-subtitle,.lead-meta,.lead-angle,.muted-note,.stat-label{color:#667085!important}
.stats-grid{gap:14px}.stat-card,.quick-card,.lead-card,.table-wrap,.detail-block,.outreach-hero,.pipeline-card,.followup-card,.insight-card,.settings-card{background:#fff!important;border:1px solid #e4e7ec!important;border-radius:16px!important;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.04),0 12px 28px -22px rgba(16,24,40,.18)!important}
.stat-card{padding:18px}.stat-value{font-size:28px!important;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.lead-grid{gap:14px}.lead-card{padding:18px!important;transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease,border-color .18s ease!important}
.lead-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)!important;border-color:#f4b39a!important;background:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 18px 34px -25px rgba(16,24,40,.25)!important}
.btn{min-height:40px!important;border-radius:11px!important;background:#fff!important;border-color:#dfe3e8!important;color:#344054!important;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.03)!important}
.btn:hover{background:#f8fafc!important;border-color:#cbd1d9!important;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.btn-accent{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff7b3a,#f85d24)!important;border-color:#f85d24!important;color:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 10px 22px -12px rgba(249,98,44,.65)!important}
input[type=text],input[type=number],input[type=url],textarea,select{background:#fff!important;color:#101828!important;border-color:#dfe3e8!important;border-radius:11px!important;min-height:40px}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{outline:none!important;border-color:#ff8a5a!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,106,42,.10)!important}
.tag,.source-status{border-color:#e4e7ec!important;background:#f8fafc!important}.source-status{border-radius:999px!important}
.table-wrap{overflow:auto!important}.table-wrap table{min-width:720px}th{background:#f8fafc!important;color:#667085!important}td,th{padding:12px 13px!important}
.modal-backdrop{background:rgba(15,23,42,.32)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)!important}.modal{border-radius:20px!important;box-shadow:0 30px 80px -30px rgba(16,24,40,.35)!important}
.empty-state{background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);border-color:#d9dee7!important;border-radius:16px!important}
@media(max-width:900px){.main{padding:16px!important}.hero-card{padding:21px!important}.hero-title{font-size:27px!important}.stats-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important}}
@media(max-width:560px){.main{padding:12px!important}.hero-card{border-radius:17px!important;padding:19px!important}.hero-title{font-size:25px!important}.stats-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important;gap:9px}.stat-card{padding:14px!important}.stat-value{font-size:23px!important}.lead-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.btn{min-height:42px!important}}
</style>

</head>
<body>
<script>
(function(){try{if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('embedded')==='1')document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-trace-embedded','1');}catch(e){}})();
</script>

<div id="app">
  <div class="sidebar">
    <div class="brand">TRACE</div>
    <div class="brand-sub">Acquisition OS · Final</div>
    <div class="nav-item active" data-page="dashboard"><span class="nav-dot"></span>Command Center</div>
    <div class="nav-item" data-page="discovery"><span class="nav-dot"></span>Find Leads</div>
    <div class="nav-item" data-page="leads"><span class="nav-dot"></span>All Leads</div>
    <div class="nav-item" data-page="settings"><span class="nav-dot"></span>Settings</div>
    <div class="sidebar-footer">F&B Coverage<br>Jabodetabek + Bandung<br><span style="color:var(--accent);">Final · V1–V4</span></div>
  </div>

  <div class="main">

    <!-- DASHBOARD -->
    <div class="page active" id="page-dashboard">
      <div class="hero-card">
        <div class="hero-eyebrow">TRACE Acquisition OS · Indonesia F&B Intelligence</div>
        <div class="hero-title">Temukan calon klien F&B tanpa cari satu-satu.</div>
        <div class="hero-copy">Sistem mencari bisnis F&B di wilayah pilihan, menggabungkan data yang tersedia, memberi prioritas, lalu menyiapkan alasan dan angle outreach.</div>
        <div class="hero-actions">
          <button class="btn btn-accent discovery-big-btn" onclick="startDiscoveryFromDashboard()">🔎 Temukan Calon Klien Hari Ini</button>
          <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="switchPage('leads')">Lihat Semua Lead</button>
        </div>
        <div class="hero-status" id="hero-status">Siap mencari data F&B Bogor.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="trace-acq-flow" aria-label="Alur Acquisition">
        <button type="button" data-flow-page="discovery"><b>1 · Cari</b><span>Discovery area + sumber</span></button>
        <button type="button" data-flow-page="leads"><b>2 · Validasi</b><span>Lead, dedupe, evidence</span></button>
        <button type="button" data-flow-page="pipeline"><b>3 · Prioritaskan</b><span>Fit, stage, next action</span></button>
        <button type="button" data-flow-page="followups"><b>4 · Tindak lanjut</b><span>Follow-up sampai meeting</span></button>
      </div>

      <div class="stats-grid" id="stats-grid"></div>
      <div class="quick-grid" id="quick-grid"></div>

      <div class="action-strip">
        <button class="btn btn-accent" onclick="refreshStaleLeads()">↻ Refresh Data Lama</button>
        <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="switchPage('pipeline')">Lihat Pipeline</button>
        <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="switchPage('followups')">Cek Follow-up</button>
        <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="exportLeadsCSV()">Export CSV</button>
      </div>

      <div class="section-label">🔥 Top 10 Calon Klien Hari Ini</div>
      <div class="lead-grid" id="top-leads-grid"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- LEADS -->
    <div class="page" id="page-leads">
      <div class="page-header">
        <div>
          <div class="page-title">Leads Database</div>
          <div class="page-subtitle">Semua lead F&B yang tersimpan</div>
        </div>
        <button class="btn btn-accent" onclick="showAddLeadModal()">+ Tambah Lead Manual</button>
      </div>

      <div class="toolbar">
        <input type="text" id="filter-search" placeholder="Cari nama bisnis..." oninput="renderLeadsTable()">
        <select id="filter-city" onchange="renderLeadsTable()">
          <option value="">Semua Kota/Kabupaten</option>
          <option value="DKI Jakarta">DKI Jakarta</option>
          <option value="Kota Bogor">Kota Bogor</option>
          <option value="Kabupaten Bogor">Kabupaten Bogor</option>
          <option value="Kota Depok">Kota Depok</option>
          <option value="Kota Bekasi">Kota Bekasi</option>
          <option value="Kabupaten Bekasi">Kabupaten Bekasi</option>
          <option value="Kota Tangerang">Kota Tangerang</option>
          <option value="Kabupaten Tangerang">Kabupaten Tangerang</option>
          <option value="Kota Tangerang Selatan">Kota Tangerang Selatan</option>
          <option value="Kota Bandung">Kota Bandung</option>
          <option value="Kabupaten Bandung">Kabupaten Bandung</option>
          <option value="Kabupaten Bandung Barat">Kabupaten Bandung Barat</option>
          <option value="Kota Cimahi">Kota Cimahi</option>
        </select>
        <select id="filter-status" onchange="renderLeadsTable()">
          <option value="">Semua Status</option>
          <option value="new">New</option>
          <option value="analyzed">Analyzed</option>
          <option value="contacted">Contacted</option>
          <option value="replied">Replied</option>
          <option value="meeting">Meeting</option>
          <option value="proposal">Proposal</option>
          <option value="closed">Won / Closed</option>
          <option value="not_a_fit">Not a Fit</option>
        </select>
        <!-- FIX: filter kategori, sortir, dan sembunyikan kata kunci — supaya
             lead yang kemungkinan besar bukan target ideal (fast food/franchise
             besar, warteg, dll) gampang disingkirkan dari pandangan tanpa
             menghapus datanya (masih bisa dimunculkan lagi kapan saja). -->
        <select id="filter-category" onchange="renderLeadsTable()">
          <option value="">Semua Kategori</option>
          <option value="Café">Café</option>
          <option value="Restaurant">Restaurant</option>
          <option value="Bakery">Bakery</option>
          <option value="Dessert">Dessert</option>
          <option value="Casual Dining">Casual Dining (termasuk fast food/franchise)</option>
          <option value="F&B">F&B (kategori umum)</option>
        </select>
        <select id="sort-leads" onchange="renderLeadsTable()">
          <option value="score_desc">Urutkan: Skor tertinggi</option>
          <option value="score_asc">Urutkan: Skor terendah</option>
          <option value="name_asc">Urutkan: Nama A-Z</option>
          <option value="recent">Urutkan: Baru ditemukan dulu</option>
        </select>
        <input type="text" id="filter-exclude-keywords" placeholder="Sembunyikan kata kunci (pisah koma), mis. KFC, Warteg, McDonald's" oninput="onExcludeKeywordsChange()" style="min-width:260px;">
      </div>

      <div class="table-wrap">
        <table>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Business</th><th>Category</th><th>Location</th><th>Rating</th>
              <th>Score</th><th>Status</th><th>Last Checked</th><th>Freshness</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody id="leads-table-body"></tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- DISCOVERY -->
    <div class="page" id="page-discovery">
      <div class="page-header">
        <div>
          <div class="page-title">Find F&B Leads</div>
          <div class="page-subtitle">Satu klik untuk discovery → analisis → prioritas → outreach.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="source-status"><span class="source-dot" id="source-dot"></span><span id="source-status-text">OSM ready · Google optional</span></div>
      </div>

      <div class="discovery-simple">
        <div class="detail-block">
          <div class="hero-eyebrow">Discovery</div>
          <h2 style="font-family:var(--font-display);margin:0 0 6px;font-size:20px;">Temukan bisnis F&B di wilayah target</h2>
          <p class="muted-note" style="margin-top:0;">Tidak perlu mencari Google → Maps → Instagram satu per satu. OS akan mengambil data dari sumber yang tersedia, menghapus duplikat, lalu memprioritaskan lead.</p>
          <div class="discovery-options">
            <div class="field"><label>Area</label><select id="disc-area"><option value="jabodetabek_bandung">Jabodetabek + Bandung</option><option value="jabodetabek">Jabodetabek</option><option value="bandung">Bandung Raya</option><option value="both">Bogor Kota + Kabupaten Bogor</option><option value="kota">Bogor Kota</option><option value="kabupaten">Kabupaten Bogor</option></select></div>
            <div class="field"><label>Target</label><select id="disc-category"><option value="all">Semua F&B</option><option value="coffee_shop">Coffee Shop</option><option value="cafe">Café</option><option value="restaurant">Restaurant</option><option value="bakery">Bakery</option><option value="dessert">Dessert</option><option value="casual_dining">Casual Dining</option></select></div>
          </div>
          <label class="muted-note" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin:6px 0 2px;cursor:pointer;">
            <input type="checkbox" id="disc-force-refresh" style="width:auto;margin:0;">
            Paksa refresh (abaikan cache OSM, ambil data terbaru langsung dari Overpass)
          </label>
          <button class="btn btn-accent discovery-big-btn" id="btn-start-discovery" style="width:100%;margin-top:2px;">🔎 Temukan Calon Klien</button>
          <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="btn-stop-discovery" style="width:100%;margin-top:6px;display:none;">⏹ Stop Discovery</button>
          <div class="advanced">
            <details>
              <summary>Pengaturan sumber data</summary>
              <div style="margin-top:12px;">
                <div class="field"><label>Mode</label><select id="disc-source"><option value="hybrid">Automatic — semua sumber yang aktif</option><option value="osm">OpenStreetMap</option><option value="google_places">Google Places via proxy</option></select></div>
                <div class="field"><label>Google Places Proxy URL</label><input type="url" id="google-proxy-url" placeholder="Opsional — isi jika Google Places sudah dikonfigurasi"></div>
                <div class="muted-note">Google Places menambah rating, jumlah review, website, telepon, jam buka, dan Google Maps URL. API key disimpan di server/proxy, bukan di browser. Instagram hanya disimpan bila ditemukan dan dapat diverifikasi; sistem tidak melakukan bypass Instagram.</div>
                <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" id="btn-test-google" style="margin-top:10px;">Test Google Connection</button>
              </div>
            </details>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="detail-block" id="disc-progress-block" style="display:none;margin-top:14px;">
          <h4>Progress</h4>
          <div id="disc-progress-list" style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:12px;line-height:2;color:var(--text-dim);"></div>
        </div>

        <div id="disc-result-block" style="display:none;margin-top:14px;">
          <div class="section-label">Discovery Result</div>
          <div class="stats-grid" id="disc-result-stats" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- PIPELINE -->
    <div class="page" id="page-pipeline">
      <div class="page-header">
        <div><div class="page-title">Sales Pipeline</div><div class="page-subtitle">Dari lead dingin sampai menjadi klien TRACE Consultant.</div></div>
        <button class="btn btn-accent" onclick="switchPage('discovery')">+ Cari Lead Baru</button>
      </div>
      <div class="pipeline-summary" id="pipeline-summary"></div>
      <div class="kanban" id="pipeline-board"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- FOLLOW UPS -->
    <div class="page" id="page-followups">
      <div class="page-header">
        <div><div class="page-title">Follow-ups</div><div class="page-subtitle">Jangan kehilangan lead hanya karena lupa follow-up.</div></div>
        <button class="btn btn-accent" onclick="renderFollowups()">↻ Refresh</button>
      </div>
      <div class="stats-grid" id="followup-stats"></div>
      <div class="detail-grid" id="followup-grid"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- INSIGHTS -->
    <div class="page" id="page-insights">
      <div class="page-header">
        <div><div class="page-title">Sales Intelligence</div><div class="page-subtitle">OS membaca pola dari lead yang Anda hubungi dan hasilnya.</div></div>
        <span class="source-status"><span class="source-dot"></span>Learning engine aktif</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stats-grid" id="insight-stats"></div>
      <div class="detail-grid">
        <div class="detail-block"><h4>Winning Signals</h4><div id="winning-signals"></div></div>
        <div class="detail-block"><h4>Recommended Focus</h4><div id="recommended-focus"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="detail-block" style="margin-top:14px;"><h4>Sales Performance</h4><div id="sales-funnel"></div></div>
    </div>

    <!-- SETTINGS -->
    <div class="page" id="page-settings">
      <div class="page-header">
        <div><div class="page-title">Settings</div><div class="page-subtitle">Pengaturan teknis hanya jika diperlukan.</div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="detail-block" style="max-width:760px;">
        <h4>Data Sources</h4>
        <div class="kv"><span class="kv-k">OpenStreetMap / Overpass</span><span class="kv-v" style="color:var(--accent-2);">READY</span></div>
        <div class="kv"><span class="kv-k">Google Places</span><span class="kv-v" id="settings-google-status">OPTIONAL</span></div>
        <div class="kv"><span class="kv-k">Analysis Engine</span><span class="kv-v">Fact-based heuristic + optional AI provider</span></div>
        <p class="muted-note" style="margin-top:14px;">V1 tidak memerlukan API key untuk discovery dasar. Untuk data Google rating/review/website/telepon yang lebih lengkap, sambungkan Google Places melalui server-side proxy.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="detail-block" style="max-width:760px;margin-top:14px;">
        <h4>AI / Scoring</h4>
        <p class="muted-note">Jika AI provider belum dikonfigurasi, OS tetap melakukan scoring lokal berbasis data nyata yang tersedia. Hasil tersebut ditandai sebagai <strong>Local heuristic</strong>, bukan fakta dari AI.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="detail-block" style="max-width:760px;margin-top:14px;">
        <h4>Sales Learning</h4>
        <p class="muted-note">V3 menggunakan hasil contacted → replied → meeting → proposal → won sebagai sinyal pembelajaran untuk memprioritaskan lead berikutnya. Ini adalah learning heuristic lokal, bukan model AI yang mengarang data.</p>
        <div class="field-row" style="margin-top:12px;">
          <div class="field"><label>Follow-up 1 (hari)</label><input type="number" id="fu1-days" min="1" max="30" value="2"></div>
          <div class="field"><label>Follow-up 2 (hari)</label><input type="number" id="fu2-days" min="2" max="60" value="5"></div>
        </div>
        <button class="btn btn-accent btn-sm" onclick="saveSalesSettings()">Simpan Pengaturan</button>
      </div>
      <div class="detail-block" style="max-width:760px;margin-top:14px;">
        <h4>Backup & Data</h4>
        <p class="muted-note">Data Acquisition tersimpan mengikuti storage TRACE Consultant saat modul dibuka dari dalam TRACE. Backup JSON tetap tersedia sebagai cadangan manual.</p>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px;">
          <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onclick="exportBackup()">Download Backup JSON</button>
          <label class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" style="cursor:pointer;margin:0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;">Restore JSON<input type="file" id="restore-file" accept="application/json" onchange="restoreBackup(this.files[0])" style="display:none"></label>
          <button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" onclick="clearAllLeads()">Hapus Semua Data Lokal</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- IMPORT -->
    <div class="page" id="page-import">
      <div class="page-header">
        <div>
          <div class="page-title">Data Ingestion</div>
          <div class="page-subtitle">Foundation import — CSV manual, bukan scraping otomatis</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="detail-block" style="max-width:640px;">
        <h4>Import via CSV</h4>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Paste isi CSV</label>
          <textarea id="csv-input" rows="8" placeholder="business_name,category,city,regency,district,address,phone,website,instagram,rating,review_count,price_range,outlet_count,opening_hours,source,source_url"></textarea>
        </div>
        <div class="csv-help">
          Header wajib: business_name<br>
          Header opsional: category, city, regency, district, address, phone, website, instagram, rating, review_count, price_range, outlet_count, opening_hours, source, source_url<br>
          Kolom kosong akan otomatis diberi label "Unknown".
        </div>
        <div style="margin-top:12px;display:flex;gap:8px;">
          <button class="btn btn-accent" onclick="importCSV()">Import CSV</button>
          <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="document.getElementById('csv-input').value=''">Bersihkan</button>
        </div>
        <div id="import-result" style="margin-top:10px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-dim);"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="ai-disclaimer" style="max-width:640px;margin-top:18px;">
        Catatan sumber data: setiap lead menyimpan field <code>source</code> dan <code>last_checked</code>.
        Sistem ini tidak melakukan scraping otomatis atau bypass rate-limit/authentication pihak ketiga.
        Untuk data live (Google Maps, Instagram, dsb), hubungkan API resmi melalui layer ingestion terpisah —
        di luar scope V1.
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>

<!-- ADD LEAD MODAL -->
<div class="modal-backdrop" id="add-lead-modal">
  <div class="modal" style="max-width:560px;">
    <button class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('add-lead-modal')">×</button>
    <h2>Tambah Lead Manual</h2>
    <div class="lead-meta">Field yang tidak diisi akan disimpan sebagai "Unknown".</div>
    <div class="field-row">
      <div class="field"><label>Business Name *</label><input type="text" id="nl-name"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Category</label>
        <select id="nl-category">
          <option value="">-- pilih --</option>
          <option>Coffee Shop</option><option>Café</option><option>Restaurant</option>
          <option>Bakery</option><option>Dessert</option><option>Casual Dining</option><option>Other</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="field-row">
      <div class="field"><label>City</label>
        <select id="nl-city"><option value="">-- pilih --</option><option>Kota Bogor</option><option>Kabupaten Bogor</option><option>Kota Depok</option><option>Kota Bekasi</option><option>Kabupaten Bekasi</option><option>Kota Tangerang</option><option>Kabupaten Tangerang</option><option>Kota Tangerang Selatan</option><option>DKI Jakarta</option><option>Kota Bandung</option><option>Kabupaten Bandung</option><option>Kabupaten Bandung Barat</option><option>Kota Cimahi</option></select>
      </div>
      <div class="field"><label>District</label><input type="text" id="nl-district"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="field"><label>Address</label><input type="text" id="nl-address"></div>
    <div class="field-row">
      <div class="field"><label>Phone</label><input type="text" id="nl-phone"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Instagram</label><input type="text" id="nl-instagram" placeholder="@username"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="field-row">
      <div class="field"><label>Website</label><input type="text" id="nl-website"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Price Range</label><input type="text" id="nl-price" placeholder="e.g. Rp25.000–60.000"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="field-row">
      <div class="field"><label>Rating (0-5)</label><input type="number" id="nl-rating" step="0.1" min="0" max="5"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Review Count</label><input type="number" id="nl-reviews" min="0"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="field-row">
      <div class="field"><label>Outlet Count</label><input type="number" id="nl-outlets" min="0"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Source</label><input type="text" id="nl-source" placeholder="e.g. manual entry, referral"></div>
    </div>
    <button class="btn btn-accent" onclick="submitAddLead()">Simpan Lead</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- LEAD DETAIL MODAL -->
<div class="modal-backdrop" id="detail-modal">
  <div class="modal">
    <button class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal('detail-modal')">×</button>
    <div id="detail-modal-content"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

<script>
/* ============================================================
   STORAGE ADAPTER
   Uses Claude Artifact persistent storage (window.storage) when
   available; falls back to localStorage for standalone use

const ACQ_STORE_KEY = 'acquisitionLeads';

const STORE_KEY = ACQ_STORE_KEY;
const SETTINGS_KEY = ACQ_SETTINGS_KEY;
async function getTraceBridge(timeoutMs=3000){
  const until=Date.now()+timeoutMs;
  while(Date.now()<until){
    if(window.parent && window.parent.TRACE_ACQUISITION_BRIDGE) return window.parent.TRACE_ACQUISITION_BRIDGE;
    await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));
  }
  return null;
}
const storageAdapter = {
  async get(key){
    const bridge=await getTraceBridge(800);
    if(bridge && key===ACQ_STORE_KEY){ const v=await bridge.loadLeads(); return JSON.stringify(v||[]); }
    return localStorage.getItem(key);
  },
  async set(key,value){
    const bridge=await getTraceBridge(800);
    if(bridge && key===ACQ_STORE_KEY){ try{return !!(await bridge.saveLeads(JSON.parse(value)));}catch(e){console.error(e);return false;} }
    try{localStorage.setItem(key,value);return true;}catch(e){return false;}
  }
};

function salesSettings(){
  try{return Object.assign({fu1:2,fu2:5},JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SETTINGS_KEY)||'{}'));}catch(e){return {fu1:2,fu2:5};}
}
function saveSalesSettings(){

function daysFromNow(days){const d=new Date();d.setDate(d.getDate()+days);return d.toISOString();}
function formatDateTime(v){if(!v)return '—';return new Date(v).toLocaleString('id-ID',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});}
function followupDue(lead){return lead.next_follow_up_at ? new Date(lead.next_follow_up_at) <= new Date() : false;}
function scheduleNextFollowup(lead, stage){
  const cfg=salesSettings();
  if(stage==='contacted') lead.next_follow_up_at=daysFromNow(cfg.fu1);
  else if(stage==='replied') lead.next_follow_up_at=null;
  else if(stage==='meeting') lead.next_follow_up_at=null;
  else if(stage==='proposal') lead.next_follow_up_at=daysFromNow(3);
  else if(stage==='closed'||stage==='not_a_fit') lead.next_follow_up_at=null;
}
function learningMultiplier(lead){
  const stats=LEADS.reduce((a,l)=>{const s=l.status; if(['contacted','replied','meeting','proposal','closed'].includes(s))a.contacted++; if(['replied','meeting','proposal','closed'].includes(s))a.replied++; if(['meeting','proposal','closed'].includes(s))a.meeting++; if(s==='closed')a.won++; return a;},{contacted:0,replied:0,meeting:0,won:0});
  if(!stats.contacted) return 1;
  const base=stats.replied/stats.contacted;
  const localSignals=(lead.analysis?.recommended_sales_angle||'').toLowerCase();
  let bonus=0;
  if(localSignals.includes('profitability') && base>.2) bonus+=.04;
  if((lead.outlet_count||0)>1 && stats.meeting>0) bonus+=.04;
  return Math.min(1.12,1+bonus);
}
function todayTopLeads(){
  return LEADS.filter(l=>l.lead_score!==null && !['closed','not_a_fit'].includes(l.status))
    .map(l=>Object.assign({adjusted_score:Math.round((l.lead_score||0)*learningMultiplier(l))},l))
    .sort((a,b)=>b.adjusted_score-a.adjusted_score).slice(0,10);
}

const WEIGHTS = {
  business_potential: 20,
  growth_signal: 20,
  operational_complexity: 15,
  marketing_opportunity: 15,
  profitability_opportunity: 15,
  expansion_signal: 10
  // data_quality: 5 (computed separately)
};

function computeDataQuality(lead){
  const fields = ['phone','website','instagram','address','rating','review_count','price_range','outlet_count','category','city'];
  let filled = 0;
  fields.forEach(f=>{
    const v = lead[f];
    if (v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '' && v !== 'Unknown') filled++;
  });
  return Math.round((filled / fields.length) * 100);
}

function evidenceValue(v){
  return v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '' && v !== 'Unknown' && v !== 'Not Found';
}

function buildEvidenceLedger(lead){
  const checks = [
    ['Business identity','business_name',lead.business_name,'Business name'],
    ['Category','category',lead.category,'Business category'],
    ['Location','address',lead.address,'Business address'],
    ['Phone','phone',lead.phone,'Phone/contact'],
    ['Website','website',lead.website,'Website'],
    ['Instagram','instagram',lead.instagram,'Instagram'],
    ['Rating','rating',lead.rating,'Rating'],
    ['Review count','review_count',lead.review_count,'Review count'],
    ['Price range','price_range',lead.price_range,'Price range'],
    ['Outlet count','outlet_count',lead.outlet_count,'Outlet count'],
    ['Source','source',lead.source,'Discovery source']
  ];
  return checks.map(([id,field,value,label])=>({
    id, field, label,
    status:evidenceValue(value)?'Available':'Unavailable',
    value:evidenceValue(value)?value:null,
    source:evidenceValue(value)?(lead.source||'TRACE discovery'):'Not available',
    source_url:evidenceValue(value)?(lead.source_url||null):null,
    captured_at:lead.last_checked||lead.updated_at||null,
    notes:evidenceValue(value)?'Ditemukan pada data lead.':'Data ini tidak tersedia pada sumber yang diperoleh.'
  }));
}

function evidenceCompleteness(lead){
  const ledger=buildEvidenceLedger(lead);
  const usable=ledger.filter(x=>x.status==='Available').length;
  return Math.round((usable/ledger.length)*100);
}

function buildScoreReasons(lead, analysis){
  const r=[];
  const reviews=Number(lead.review_count||0), rating=Number(lead.rating||0), outlets=Number(lead.outlet_count||0);
  if(reviews) r.push(`Review count ${reviews.toLocaleString('id-ID')} menjadi evidence customer proof.`);
  if(rating) r.push(`Rating ${rating} menjadi evidence social proof, bukan evidence profitability.`);
  if(outlets) r.push(`Outlet count ${outlets} menjadi evidence skala/kompleksitas, bukan bukti masalah operasional.`);
  if(evidenceValue(lead.website)) r.push('Website tersedia sebagai sumber konteks digital/offer.');
  if(evidenceValue(lead.instagram)) r.push('Instagram tersedia sebagai sumber presence digital yang dapat diverifikasi.');
  if(!r.length) r.push('Evidence publik masih terbatas; analisis perlu validasi langsung.');
  return r;
}

function enrichAnalysisEvidence(lead, analysis){
  const ledger=buildEvidenceLedger(lead);
  const completeness=evidenceCompleteness(lead);
  const confidence=Math.max(20, Math.min(95, Math.round(35 + completeness*.45 + (lead.analysis?.analysis_mode==='ai'?10:0))));
  analysis.evidence={
    status:completeness>=75?'Sufficient Evidence':completeness>=45?'Partial Evidence':'Insufficient Data',
    completeness,
    items:ledger,
    missing:ledger.filter(x=>x.status==='Unavailable').map(x=>x.label),
    limitations:'Missing data limits scope of conclusion; it does not block analysis based on available evidence.'
  };
  analysis.confidence={score:confidence,reason:`Confidence ${confidence}% ditentukan dari kelengkapan evidence (${completeness}%) dan mode analisis. Confidence tidak berarti fakta terverifikasi.`};
  analysis.score_reasons=buildScoreReasons(lead,analysis);
  return analysis;
}

function manualEvidenceForLead(leadId){
  const lead=LEADS.find(l=>l.id===leadId); if(!lead) return;
  const type=prompt('Data Type (contoh: transaction, conversion, customer, COGS):',''); if(!type) return;
  const value=prompt('Value:',''); if(value===null) return;
  const period=prompt('Period (contoh: Aug 2026):','');
  const source=prompt('Source:','Owner-provided');
  const notes=prompt('Notes:','')||'';
  if(!Array.isArray(lead.manual_evidence)) lead.manual_evidence=[];
  lead.manual_evidence.push({id:uid(),type,value,period,source:source||'Manual / Owner-provided',notes,created_at:new Date().toISOString()});
  lead.updated_at=new Date().toISOString();
  if(lead.analysis) enrichAnalysisEvidence(lead,lead.analysis);
  persistLeads().then(()=>{renderDetail(lead);toast('Manual evidence tersimpan.');});
}

function computeOverallScore(lead){
  if (!lead.analysis) return null;
  const a = lead.analysis;
  let sum = 0;
  for (const k in WEIGHTS){
    const v = typeof a[k] === 'number' ? a[k] : 0;
    sum += (v/100) * WEIGHTS[k];
  }
  const dq = computeDataQuality(lead);
  sum += (dq/100) * 5;
  const score=Math.round(sum);
  const fitStatus = score >= 75 ? 'high' : score >= 50 ? 'medium' : score > 0 ? 'low' : 'insufficient_data';
  lead.fit_score=score;
  lead.fit_status=fitStatus;
  lead.priority=fitStatus==='high'?'P1':fitStatus==='medium'?'P2':fitStatus==='low'?'P3':'P4';
  lead.acquisition_stage='prioritized';
  lead.problem_hypotheses=Array.isArray(a.likely_pain_points) ? a.likely_pain_points.map(x=>({text:x.text,is_hypothesis:x.is_hypothesis!==false,status:'hypothesis'})) : [];
  a.score_breakdown={...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(WEIGHTS).map(([k,w])=>[k,{value:typeof a[k]==='number'?a[k]:0,weight:w,contribution:Math.round(((typeof a[k]==='number'?a[k]:0)/100)*w*100)/100}])),data_quality:{value:dq,weight:5,contribution:Math.round((dq/100)*5*100)/100},total:score};
  return score;
}

function potentialLevel(score){
  if (score === null || score === undefined) return {label:'Not Analyzed', cls:'score-none'};
  if (score >= 75) return {label:'High', cls:'score-high'};
  if (score >= 50) return {label:'Medium', cls:'score-mid'};
  return {label:'Low', cls:'score-low'};
}

function freshness(lastChecked){
  if (!lastChecked) return {icon:'🔴', label:'Stale'};
  const days = (Date.now() - new Date(lastChecked).getTime()) / 86400000;
  if (days <= 7) return {icon:'🟢', label:'Fresh'};
  if (days <= 30) return {icon:'🟡', label:'Aging'};
  return {icon:'🔴', label:'Stale'};
}

function fmt(v){
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '' || v === 'Unknown') return '<span class="unknown">Unknown</span>';
  return escapeHtml(v);
}

function toast(msg){
  const t = document.getElementById('toast');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.style.display = 'block';
  clearTimeout(t._timer);
  t._timer = setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.display='none'; }, 2600);
}

function localHeuristicAnalysis(lead){
  const review=lead.review_count||0, rating=lead.rating||0, outlets=lead.outlet_count||0;
  const completeness=computeDataQuality(lead);
  const volume=Math.min(100, Math.round(Math.log10(Math.max(1,review)+1)*38));
  const business=Math.min(100, Math.round(35 + volume*.45 + Math.min(outlets,10)*4 + (rating>=4.5?10:rating>=4.2?6:0)));
  const growth=Math.min(100, Math.round(25 + volume*.45 + (outlets>1?25:0) + (lead.website!=='Unknown'?8:0)));
  const complexity=Math.min(100, Math.round(20 + Math.min(outlets,10)*7 + volume*.35));
  const marketing=Math.min(100, Math.round(25 + (lead.instagram && !['Unknown','Not Found'].includes(lead.instagram)?25:0) + (lead.website!=='Unknown'?10:0) + (rating>=4.4?12:0)));
  const profit=Math.min(100, Math.round(25 + volume*.5 + (outlets>1?18:0) + (lead.price_range!=='Unknown'?7:0)));
  const expansion=Math.min(100, Math.round(15 + (outlets>1?55:0) + (review>1000?18:0)));
  const likely=[];
  if(outlets>1 || review>500) likely.push({text:'Ada indikasi skala bisnis yang mulai membutuhkan kontrol operasional dan profitability yang lebih terstruktur.',is_hypothesis:true});
  if(lead.instagram && !['Unknown','Not Found'].includes(lead.instagram)) likely.push({text:'Aktivitas digital dapat menjadi area yang layak dievaluasi bersama conversion dan repeat customer.',is_hypothesis:true});
  if(!likely.length) likely.push({text:'Data masih terbatas; kebutuhan operasional perlu divalidasi melalui percakapan langsung.',is_hypothesis:true});
  const opportunity=outlets>1?'Potensi utama: standardisasi dan kontrol saat bisnis bertumbuh atau memiliki beberapa outlet.':'Potensi utama: menguji area profitability, food cost, OPEX, dan sistem operasional sebelum scale-up.';
  const angle=outlets>1?'Operational System + Profitability':'Food Cost + Profitability';
  return {business_potential:business,growth_signal:growth,operational_complexity:complexity,marketing_opportunity:marketing,profitability_opportunity:profit,expansion_signal:expansion,likely_pain_points:likely,opportunity,recommended_sales_angle:angle,reasoning:`FACT: ${review?review+' review tercatat; ':''}${rating?'rating '+rating+'; ':''}${outlets?outlets+' outlet terdeteksi; ':''}data completeness ${completeness}%. INFERENCE: sinyal tersebut menunjukkan tingkat kematangan/skala tertentu. HYPOTHESIS: kebutuhan yang disarankan masih perlu divalidasi saat outreach.`};
}

function automaticSocialIntelligence(lead){
  const ig = lead.instagram && !['Unknown','Not Found'].includes(lead.instagram) ? lead.instagram : null;
  const website = lead.website && !['Unknown','Not Found'].includes(lead.website) ? lead.website : null;
  const rating = Number(lead.rating||0), reviews=Number(lead.review_count||0), outlets=Number(lead.outlet_count||0);

  const contentOpportunity = ig ? (website ? 'Brand sudah memiliki jejak digital yang dapat dianalisis; peluang utama perlu diuji pada consistency, reach, engagement, dan conversion.' : 'Instagram menjadi aset digital utama yang layak dievaluasi untuk reach, content consistency, dan conversion.') : 'Instagram belum terverifikasi; gunakan website/business signals sebagai konteks awal dan jangan mengklaim observasi feed.';

async function runAutomaticSocialIntelligence(leadId, opts={}){
  const lead=LEADS.find(l=>l.id===leadId); if(!lead) return null;
  try{
    const endpoint=['localhost','127.0.0.1'].includes(location.hostname)?'/api/social-intel':'/api/acq-social-intel';
    const r=await acqFetch(endpoint,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({lead})});
    if(r.ok){ const data=await r.json(); lead.instagram_intelligence=Object.assign(automaticSocialIntelligence(lead),data); }
    else lead.instagram_intelligence=automaticSocialIntelligence(lead);
  }catch(e){ lead.instagram_intelligence=automaticSocialIntelligence(lead); }
  lead.updated_at=new Date().toISOString();
  if(!opts?.skipPersist) await persistLeads();
  return lead.instagram_intelligence;
}

async function runAIAnalysis(leadId, opts){
  const lead = LEADS.find(l=>l.id===leadId);
  if (!lead) return;
  try{
    const system = `Kamu adalah analyst internal di TRACE Consultant, konsultan operasional & bisnis F&B di Indonesia. Layanan TRACE Consultant: ${TRACE_SERVICES.join(', ')}. Nilai potensi bisnis sebagai calon klien hanya berdasarkan fact sheet. Bedakan FACT, INFERENCE, HYPOTHESIS. Jangan mengarang. Balas HANYA JSON valid dengan business_potential,growth_signal,operational_complexity,marketing_opportunity,profitability_opportunity,expansion_signal (0-100), likely_pain_points:[{text,is_hypothesis}], opportunity, recommended_sales_angle, reasoning.`;
    const user = `Fact sheet bisnis:\n${leadFactSheet(lead)}\nBerikan analisis sesuai format JSON.`;
    const result = await callAI(system, user);

    lead.analysis = Object.assign({analyzed_at:new Date().toISOString(),analysis_mode:'local_heuristic'}, localHeuristicAnalysis(lead));

  if(!lead.instagram_intelligence) await runAutomaticSocialIntelligence(lead.id,{skipPersist:opts?.skipPersist});
  lead.status = lead.status==='new' ? 'analyzed' : lead.status;
  lead.updated_at=new Date().toISOString();

  // dianalisis, seluruh array LEADS (bisa 5000-7500+ item) diupload ulang ke
  // Supabase lewat persistLeads(). Untuk Discovery dengan ribuan lead baru,
  // itu berarti ribuan kali upload ulang SELURUH database, bukan cuma lead
  // yang baru — inilah yang membuat proses berjalan sangat lama dan membuat
  // sesi login lebih rawan kadaluarsa di tengah jalan. Panggilan tunggal
  // (klik manual re-analyze satu lead di UI) tetap langsung persist seperti
  // biasa; hanya proses batch (Discovery) yang melewati ini dan
  // menggabungkan penyimpanan lewat opts.skipPersist di bawah.
  if (!opts?.skipPersist) await persistLeads();
  return lead.analysis;
}

   DISCOVERY ENGINE
   Provider abstraction: each provider exposes fetchBusinesses(area, category)

   lead schema. Adding a new source = adding one entry to DISCOVERY_PROVIDERS,
   nothing else in the workflow changes.

// Area names and resilient batching for Overpass. Large multi-region queries can time out;
// V4.3 splits Jabodetabek + Bandung into smaller administrative batches.
const OSM_AREAS = {
  kota: ['Kota Bogor'],
  kabupaten: ['Kabupaten Bogor'],
  jabodetabek: ['Daerah Khusus Ibukota Jakarta','Kota Jakarta','Kota Bogor','Kabupaten Bogor','Kota Depok','Kota Bekasi','Kabupaten Bekasi','Kota Tangerang','Kabupaten Tangerang','Kota Tangerang Selatan'],
  bandung: ['Kota Bandung','Kabupaten Bandung','Kabupaten Bandung Barat','Kota Cimahi'],
  jabodetabek_bandung: ['Daerah Khusus Ibukota Jakarta','Kota Jakarta','Kota Bogor','Kabupaten Bogor','Kota Depok','Kota Bekasi','Kabupaten Bekasi','Kota Tangerang','Kabupaten Tangerang','Kota Tangerang Selatan','Kota Bandung','Kabupaten Bandung','Kabupaten Bandung Barat','Kota Cimahi'],
  both: ['Kota Bogor','Kabupaten Bogor']
};
const OSM_BATCHES = {
  jabodetabek: [
    ['Daerah Khusus Ibukota Jakarta','Kota Jakarta','Kota Tangerang','Kabupaten Tangerang','Kota Tangerang Selatan'],
    ['Kota Bogor','Kabupaten Bogor','Kota Depok'],
    ['Kota Bekasi','Kabupaten Bekasi']
  ],
  bandung: [['Kota Bandung','Kabupaten Bandung','Kabupaten Bandung Barat','Kota Cimahi']],
  jabodetabek_bandung: [
    ['Daerah Khusus Ibukota Jakarta','Kota Jakarta','Kota Tangerang','Kabupaten Tangerang','Kota Tangerang Selatan'],
    ['Kota Bogor','Kabupaten Bogor','Kota Depok'],
    ['Kota Bekasi','Kabupaten Bekasi'],
    ['Kota Bandung','Kabupaten Bandung','Kabupaten Bandung Barat','Kota Cimahi']
  ]
};
const OSM_CATEGORY_TAGS = {
  coffee_shop: ['amenity=cafe'],
  cafe: ['amenity=cafe'],
  restaurant: ['amenity=restaurant', 'amenity=fast_food'],
  bakery: ['shop=bakery'],
  dessert: ['shop=pastry', 'cuisine=dessert'],
  casual_dining: ['amenity=restaurant'],
  all: ['amenity=cafe', 'amenity=restaurant', 'amenity=fast_food', 'shop=bakery', 'shop=pastry']
};
function mapOSMCategory(tags){
  const amenity=tags.amenity, shop=tags.shop, cuisine=(tags.cuisine||'').toLowerCase();
  if(shop==='bakery') return 'Bakery';
  if(shop==='pastry' || cuisine.includes('dessert') || cuisine.includes('ice_cream')) return 'Dessert';
  if(amenity==='cafe') return 'Café';
  if(amenity==='fast_food') return 'Casual Dining';
  if(amenity==='restaurant') return 'Restaurant';
  return 'F&B';
}
function escapeOverpassRegex(s){
  return String(s).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
}
// Exact ["name"="X"] match is fragile: OSM contributors are not fully
// consistent about including the "Kota"/"Kabupaten" prefix in the `name`
// tag for Indonesian administrative boundaries (some map it as "Kota Bogor",
// others just "Bogor", with the prefix only in name:id or official_name).
// A single wrong/missing prefix silently returns an EMPTY area — no error,
// just "0 data ditemukan" for that whole batch. To avoid depending on us
// guessing the exact tagging for every area, match on the name OR the same
// name with an optional Kota/Kabupaten prefix stripped/added, across both
// `name` and `name:id`.
function areaNameVariants(name){
  const bare = name.replace(/^(Kota|Kabupaten|Daerah Khusus Ibukota)\s+/i,'').trim();
  const variants = new Set([name, bare]);
  if(/^Jakarta/i.test(bare)) variants.add('DKI Jakarta');
  return [...variants].map(escapeOverpassRegex);
}
function buildOverpassQueryForNames(areaNames, categoryKey){
  const tagFilters=OSM_CATEGORY_TAGS[categoryKey]||OSM_CATEGORY_TAGS.all;
  const areaClauses=areaNames.map((name,i)=>{
    const pattern = '^(' + areaNameVariants(name).join('|') + ')$';
    return `area["boundary"="administrative"]["name"~"${pattern}"]->.a${i};\n`+
           `area["boundary"="administrative"]["name:id"~"${pattern}"]->.b${i};`;
  }).join('\n');
  const nwr=[];
  areaNames.forEach((_,i)=>tagFilters.forEach(tag=>{
    const [k,v]=tag.split('=');
    nwr.push(`nwr["${k}"="${v}"](area.a${i});`);
    nwr.push(`nwr["${k}"="${v}"](area.b${i});`);
  }));
  return `[out:json][timeout:45];\n${areaClauses}\n(\n${nwr.join('\n')}\n);\nout center tags;`;
}
function buildOverpassQuery(areaKey, categoryKey){ return buildOverpassQueryForNames(OSM_AREAS[areaKey]||OSM_AREAS.both,categoryKey); }
function regionLabel(areaKey){
  return ({jabodetabek:'Jabodetabek',bandung:'Bandung Raya',jabodetabek_bandung:'Jabodetabek + Bandung',both:'Bogor Kota + Kabupaten Bogor',kota:'Kota Bogor',kabupaten:'Kabupaten Bogor'})[areaKey]||areaKey;
}
// ---- Overpass result cache (localStorage only — does NOT touch trace_kv,
// since that table already holds other production data and mixing cache
// entries into it would risk collisions). Cached per batch (area names +
// category) so different area selections that share a batch (e.g. "Kota
// Bogor" appears in both "both" and "jabodetabek") reuse the same entry. ----
const OVERPASS_CACHE_PREFIX = 'trace:acq:overpass_cache:v1:';
const OVERPASS_CACHE_TTL_MS = 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 6 jam — listing F&B tidak berubah tiap menit
function overpassCacheKey(names, categoryKey){
  return OVERPASS_CACHE_PREFIX + [...names].sort().join(',') + '|' + categoryKey;
}
function readOverpassCache(names, categoryKey){
  try{
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(overpassCacheKey(names, categoryKey));
    if(!raw) return null;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if(!parsed || !Array.isArray(parsed.elements) || !parsed.cachedAt) return null;
    return parsed;
  }catch(e){ return null; }
}
function writeOverpassCache(names, categoryKey, elements){
  try{
    localStorage.setItem(overpassCacheKey(names, categoryKey), JSON.stringify({ cachedAt: Date.now(), elements }));
  }catch(e){ /* localStorage full/unavailable — caching is best-effort, not critical */ }
}
const OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS = [
  'https://maps.mail.ru/osm/tools/overpass/api/interpreter',
  'https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter',
  'https://lz4.overpass-api.de/api/interpreter',
  'https://z.overpass-api.de/api/interpreter',
  'https://overpass.kumi.systems/api/interpreter',
  'https://overpass.private.coffee/api/interpreter',
  'https://overpass.openstreetmap.fr/api/interpreter'
];
async function postOverpass(query, signal){
  let lastError = null;
  for (const endpoint of OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS){
    try{
      const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
        body: 'data=' + encodeURIComponent(query),
        signal: signal || discoveryAbortController?.signal
      });
      if (!res.ok){
        const text = await res.text().catch(()=> '');
        lastError = new Error(`Overpass (${endpoint}) HTTP ${res.status}${text ? ': '+text.slice(0,180) : ''}`);
        continue;
      }
      const data = await res.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.elements)){
        lastError = new Error(`Overpass (${endpoint}) mengembalikan response tidak valid`);
        continue;
      }
      return data.elements;
    }catch(err){
      if(err?.name==='AbortError' || discoveryAbortController?.signal.aborted) throw err;
      lastError = err;
      continue;
    }
  }
  throw lastError || new Error('Semua server Overpass publik gagal dihubungi. Coba lagi beberapa saat.');
}
async function saveOSMBatchIncrementally(elements, areaKey, onProgress){
  if(!elements || !elements.length) return;
  const normalized = elements.map(normalizeOSMElement).filter(Boolean);
  if(!normalized.length) return;
  let savedNew = 0, savedUpdated = 0;
  const seenInThisBatch = new Set();
  for(const rec of normalized){
    const normKey = normOSM(rec.business_name, rec.address);
    if((rec.external_id && seenInThisBatch.has(rec.external_id)) || seenInThisBatch.has(normKey)) continue;
    if(rec.external_id) seenInThisBatch.add(rec.external_id);
    seenInThisBatch.add(normKey);

    const existing = LEADS.find(l => (rec.external_id && l.external_id===rec.external_id) || normOSM(l.business_name,l.address)===normKey);
    if(existing){
      const mergeFields=['business_name','category','city','regency','district','address','latitude','longitude','phone','website','instagram','rating','review_count','price_range','outlet_count','opening_hours','external_id','source','source_url','social_verified'];
      mergeFields.forEach(f=>{const v=rec[f]; if(v!==undefined && v!==null && v!=='' && v!=='Unknown' && v!=='Not Found') existing[f]=v;});
      existing.last_checked=new Date().toISOString(); existing.updated_at=new Date().toISOString();
      savedUpdated++;
      continue;
    }
    const newLead = blankLead(rec);
    LEADS.push(newLead);
    savedNew++;
  }
  await persistLeads();
  // Skor cepat untuk lead baru di batch ini supaya kalaupun proses terhenti
  // di tengah jalan, lead yang sudah tersimpan sudah punya skor.
  // FIX (Stop tidak responsif + simpan berulang): loop ini sebelumnya
  // memanggil persistLeads() (upload SELURUH database) untuk SETIAP lead di
  // batch OSM ini (bisa ratusan sekaligus), dan sama sekali tidak mengecek
  // tombol Stop — makanya klik Stop kelihatan macet lama di tahap
  // "Batch 1: X data ditemukan" ini. Sekarang: skip persist per-lead
  // (checkpoint tiap 25 + 1x di akhir), dan cek discoveryStopRequested
  // tiap lead supaya Stop langsung kerasa responnya di tahap ini juga.
  const justAdded = LEADS.slice(-savedNew).filter(l=>!l.analysis);
  const SAVE_BATCH_SIZE = 25;
  let analyzedInBatch = 0;
  for(const lead of justAdded){
    if (typeof discoveryStopRequested !== 'undefined' && discoveryStopRequested) break;
    try{
      await runAIAnalysis(lead.id, {skipPersist:true});
      analyzedInBatch++;
      if (analyzedInBatch % SAVE_BATCH_SIZE === 0) await persistLeads();
    }catch(e){ /* skor bisa menyusul nanti, data mentahnya sudah aman */ }
  }
  await persistLeads();
  if(savedNew || savedUpdated){
    onProgress&&onProgress(`💾 Tersimpan otomatis: ${savedNew} lead baru, ${savedUpdated} diperbarui — aman walau proses terhenti.`);
  }
}

async function fetchOSM(areaKey,categoryKey,onProgress,forceRefresh){
  const allNames=OSM_AREAS[areaKey]||OSM_AREAS.both;
  const batches=OSM_BATCHES[areaKey]||[allNames];
  onProgress&&onProgress(`Mencari OpenStreetMap — ${regionLabel(areaKey)} (${allNames.length} wilayah; ${batches.length} batch)...`);
  const all=[]; let failed=0; let fromCache=0; let staleFallback=0;
  for(let i=0;i<batches.length;i++){
    assertDiscoveryActive();
    if (typeof discoveryStopRequested !== 'undefined' && discoveryStopRequested){
      onProgress&&onProgress(`Dihentikan oleh user sebelum batch ${i+1}/${batches.length}.`);
      break;
    }
    const names=batches[i];
    const cached = forceRefresh ? null : readOverpassCache(names, categoryKey);
    const cacheIsFresh = cached && (Date.now() - cached.cachedAt) < OVERPASS_CACHE_TTL_MS;

    if(cacheIsFresh){
      const ageMin = Math.round((Date.now()-cached.cachedAt)/60000);
      onProgress&&onProgress(`Batch ${i+1}/${batches.length}: ${names.join(', ')} — pakai cache (${cached.elements.length} data, umur ${ageMin} menit).`);
      cached.elements.forEach(el=>{el._trace_scope=areaKey;});
      all.push(...cached.elements);
      fromCache++;
      await saveOSMBatchIncrementally(cached.elements, areaKey, onProgress);
      continue;
    }

    try{
      onProgress&&onProgress(`OSM batch ${i+1}/${batches.length}: ${names.join(', ')}...`);
      const els=await postOverpass(buildOverpassQueryForNames(names,categoryKey),discoveryAbortController?.signal);
      writeOverpassCache(names, categoryKey, els);
      els.forEach(el=>{el._trace_scope=areaKey;});
      all.push(...els);
      onProgress&&onProgress(`Batch ${i+1}: ${els.length} data ditemukan.${els.length===0?' (0 hasil bisa berarti nama wilayah OSM tidak cocok, atau memang OSM belum banyak memetakan F&B di area ini — bukan error koneksi.)':''}`);
      await saveOSMBatchIncrementally(els, areaKey, onProgress);
    }catch(err){
      if(err?.name==='AbortError' || discoveryAbortController?.signal.aborted) throw err;
      // Live fetch gagal — coba pakai cache lama (walau sudah lewat TTL) daripada
      // langsung kehilangan seluruh batch ini. Lebih baik data agak basi
      // daripada tidak ada data sama sekali.
      if(cached && cached.elements.length){
        const ageHr = Math.round((Date.now()-cached.cachedAt)/3600000);
        onProgress&&onProgress(`Batch ${i+1} gagal (${err.message}) — memakai cache lama (±${ageHr} jam) sebagai fallback.`);
        cached.elements.forEach(el=>{el._trace_scope=areaKey;});
        all.push(...cached.elements);
        staleFallback++;
        await saveOSMBatchIncrementally(cached.elements, areaKey, onProgress);
      } else {
        failed++;
        onProgress&&onProgress(`Batch ${i+1} gagal: ${err.message}`);
      }
    }
  }
  if(!all.length) throw new Error(`Discovery ${regionLabel(areaKey)} gagal: semua batch Overpass gagal dan tidak ada cache tersedia. Jika memakai file://, jalankan OPEN_TRACE.command atau gunakan deployment Netlify.`);
  if(failed) onProgress&&onProgress(`${failed} batch gagal total, tetapi ${all.length} data berhasil dikumpulkan dari batch lain.`);
  if(fromCache) onProgress&&onProgress(`${fromCache} batch diambil dari cache (hemat waktu & tidak membebani Overpass).`);
  if(staleFallback) onProgress&&onProgress(`${staleFallback} batch memakai cache lama karena live fetch gagal — data mungkin tidak 100% terbaru.`);
  onProgress&&onProgress(`${regionLabel(areaKey)}: ${all.length} raw records sebelum deduplication.`);
  return all;
}

function normOSM(businessName, address){
  return (businessName||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,' ') + '|' + (address||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,' ');
}

function normalizeOSMElement(el){
  const tags = el.tags || {};
  if (!tags.name) return null; // require a name — never fabricate one

  const addrParts = [tags['addr:street'], tags['addr:housenumber'], tags['addr:suburb']].filter(Boolean);
  const address = addrParts.length ? addrParts.join(' ') : 'Unknown';
  const district = tags['addr:suburb'] || tags['addr:district'] || 'Unknown';
  const scope = el._trace_scope;
  const rawCity = tags['addr:city'] || tags['addr:town'] || tags['addr:municipality'] || '';
  const text = `${rawCity} ${tags['addr:county']||''} ${tags['addr:state']||''}`.toLowerCase();
  const regionNames = ['Jakarta','Depok','Bogor','Bekasi','Tangerang','Bandung','Cimahi'];
  const city = rawCity || (scope==='kota' ? 'Kota Bogor' : 'Unknown');
  let regency = tags['addr:county'] || 'Unknown';
  if (/kabupaten bogor/.test(text)) regency='Kabupaten Bogor';
  else if (/kabupaten bekasi/.test(text)) regency='Kabupaten Bekasi';
  else if (/kabupaten tangerang/.test(text)) regency='Kabupaten Tangerang';
  else if (/kabupaten bandung barat/.test(text)) regency='Kabupaten Bandung Barat';
  else if (/kabupaten bandung/.test(text)) regency='Kabupaten Bandung';
  else if (scope==='kabupaten') regency=city;
  const lat = el.lat ?? (el.center ? el.center.lat : null);
  const lon = el.lon ?? (el.center ? el.center.lon : null);
  const instagram = tags['contact:instagram'] || tags['instagram'] || null;
  const website = tags['contact:website'] || tags['website'] || 'Unknown';
  const phone = tags['contact:phone'] || tags['phone'] || 'Unknown';

  return {
    external_id: 'osm:' + el.type + '/' + el.id,
    business_name: tags.name,
    category: mapOSMCategory(tags),
    address, city, regency, district,
    latitude: lat, longitude: lon,
    phone, website,
    instagram: instagram || 'Not Found',
    social_verified: !!instagram,
    rating: null,          // OSM does not provide ratings
    review_count: null,    // OSM does not provide review counts
    price_range: 'Unknown',
    outlet_count: null,
    opening_hours: tags.opening_hours || 'Unknown',
    source: 'OpenStreetMap (Overpass API)',
    source_url: `https://www.openstreetmap.org/${el.type}/${el.id}`,
    last_checked: new Date().toISOString()
  };
}
