function googleCentersFor(areaKey){
  if(areaKey==='kota') return GOOGLE_CENTERS.filter(c=>['Bogor Tengah','Bogor Selatan','Bogor Utara','Bogor Timur','Bogor Barat'].includes(c.name));
  if(areaKey==='kabupaten') return GOOGLE_CENTERS.filter(c=>['Cibinong','Sentul','Citeureup','Gunung Putri','Cileungsi','Ciawi','Parung'].includes(c.name));
  if(areaKey==='jabodetabek') return GOOGLE_CENTERS.filter(c=>c.region==='jabodetabek');
  if(areaKey==='bandung') return GOOGLE_CENTERS.filter(c=>c.region==='bandung');
  if(areaKey==='jabodetabek_bandung') return GOOGLE_CENTERS;
  return GOOGLE_CENTERS.filter(c=>['Bogor Tengah','Bogor Selatan','Bogor Utara','Bogor Timur','Bogor Barat','Cibinong','Sentul','Citeureup','Gunung Putri','Cileungsi','Ciawi','Parung'].includes(c.name));
}

function mapGoogleCategory(types, primaryType){
  const t = [...(types||[]), primaryType||''].join(' ').toLowerCase();
  if(t.includes('bakery')) return 'Bakery';
  if(t.includes('ice_cream') || t.includes('dessert')) return 'Dessert';
  if(t.includes('cafe') || t.includes('coffee')) return 'Café';
  if(t.includes('restaurant')) return 'Restaurant';
  return 'F&B';
}

function detectCityFromAddress(address){
  const a=(address||'').toLowerCase();
  const pairs=[['kota bogor','Kota Bogor'],['kota depok','Kota Depok'],['kota bekasi','Kota Bekasi'],['kota tangerang selatan','Kota Tangerang Selatan'],['kota tangerang','Kota Tangerang'],['kota bandung','Kota Bandung'],['kota cimahi','Kota Cimahi'],['jakarta pusat','DKI Jakarta'],['jakarta selatan','DKI Jakarta'],['jakarta barat','DKI Jakarta'],['jakarta timur','DKI Jakarta'],['jakarta utara','DKI Jakarta']];
  const hit=pairs.find(([k])=>a.includes(k)); return hit?hit[1]:'Unknown';
}
function detectRegencyFromAddress(address){
  const a=(address||'').toLowerCase();
  const pairs=[['kabupaten bogor','Kabupaten Bogor'],['kabupaten bekasi','Kabupaten Bekasi'],['kabupaten tangerang','Kabupaten Tangerang'],['kabupaten bandung barat','Kabupaten Bandung Barat'],['kabupaten bandung','Kabupaten Bandung']];
  const hit=pairs.find(([k])=>a.includes(k)); return hit?hit[1]:'Unknown';
}

function normalizeGooglePlace(p){
  if(!p || !p.id || !p.displayName?.text) return null;
  const loc=p.location||{};
  const address=p.formattedAddress||'Unknown';
  return {
    external_id:'google:' + p.id,
    business_name:p.displayName.text,
    category:mapGoogleCategory(p.types,p.primaryType),
    address, city: detectCityFromAddress(address),
    regency: detectRegencyFromAddress(address),
    district:'Unknown',
    latitude:loc.latitude ?? null, longitude:loc.longitude ?? null,
    phone:p.nationalPhoneNumber || 'Unknown',
    website:p.websiteUri || 'Unknown',
    instagram:'Not Found', social_verified:false,
    rating:typeof p.rating==='number'?p.rating:null,
    review_count:typeof p.userRatingCount==='number'?p.userRatingCount:null,
    price_range:p.priceLevel || 'Unknown',
    outlet_count:null,
    opening_hours:p.regularOpeningHours?.weekdayDescriptions?.join(' | ') || 'Unknown',
    source:'Google Places API (New)',
    source_url:p.googleMapsUri || 'Unknown',
    last_checked:new Date().toISOString(),
    source_ids:{google:p.id}
  };
}

async function fetchGoogleProxy(areaKey, categoryKey, onProgress, signal){
  const proxy=getGoogleProxyUrl();
  if(!proxy) throw new Error('Google Places proxy URL belum diisi.');
  const terms=GOOGLE_QUERY_TERMS[categoryKey]||GOOGLE_QUERY_TERMS.all;
  const centers=googleCentersFor(areaKey);
  onProgress && onProgress(`Google Places: ${centers.length} coverage points × ${terms.length} queries...`);
  const res=await acqFetch(proxy,{
    method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
    body:JSON.stringify({area:areaKey,category:categoryKey,queries:terms,centers}), signal:signal||discoveryAbortController?.signal
  });
  const text=await res.text();
  let data; try{data=JSON.parse(text);}catch(e){throw new Error('Google proxy returned non-JSON: '+text.slice(0,180));}
  if(!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error||('Google proxy error '+res.status));
  const places=Array.isArray(data.places)?data.places:[];
  onProgress && onProgress(`Google Places returned ${places.length} raw places.`);
  return places.map(normalizeGooglePlace).filter(Boolean);
}

function geoDistanceKm(a,b){
  if(a.latitude==null||a.longitude==null||b.latitude==null||b.longitude==null) return 999;
  const R=6371, dLat=(b.latitude-a.latitude)*Math.PI/180, dLon=(b.longitude-a.longitude)*Math.PI/180;
  const x=Math.sin(dLat/2)**2 + Math.cos(a.latitude*Math.PI/180)*Math.cos(b.latitude*Math.PI/180)*Math.sin(dLon/2)**2;
  return 2*R*Math.asin(Math.sqrt(x));
}
function normName(v){return (v||'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\u00c0-\u024f]+/gi,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();}
function normPhone(v){return String(v||'').replace(/\D/g,'').replace(/^62/,'0');}
function normInstagram(v){return String(v||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^@/,'').replace(/\/$/,'').replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?instagram\.com\//,'');}
function normWebsite(v){try{return new URL(v).hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./,'');}catch(e){return '';}}
function recordsLikelySame(a,b){
  if(a.external_id && b.external_id && a.external_id===b.external_id) return true;
  const ap=normPhone(a.phone), bp=normPhone(b.phone);
  if(ap && bp && ap.length>=8 && ap===bp) return true;
  const ai=normInstagram(a.instagram), bi=normInstagram(b.instagram);
  if(ai && bi && ai!=='unknown' && ai!=='not found' && ai===bi) return true;
  const aw=normWebsite(a.website), bw=normWebsite(b.website);
  if(aw && bw && aw===bw) return true;
  return normName(a.business_name)===normName(b.business_name) && geoDistanceKm(a,b)<0.35;
}
function mergeBusinessRecords(records){
  const out=[];
  for(const rec of records){
    let hit=out.find(x => recordsLikelySame(x,rec));
    if(!hit){ out.push({...rec}); continue; }
    const prefer=(a,b)=> (b!==null && b!==undefined && b!=='' && b!=='Unknown' && b!=='Not Found') ? b : a;
    hit.business_name=prefer(hit.business_name,rec.business_name);
    hit.address=prefer(hit.address,rec.address); hit.phone=prefer(hit.phone,rec.phone); hit.website=prefer(hit.website,rec.website);
    hit.instagram=prefer(hit.instagram,rec.instagram); hit.social_verified=hit.social_verified||rec.social_verified;
    hit.rating=prefer(hit.rating,rec.rating); hit.review_count=prefer(hit.review_count,rec.review_count); hit.price_range=prefer(hit.price_range,rec.price_range);
    hit.opening_hours=prefer(hit.opening_hours,rec.opening_hours); hit.latitude=hit.latitude??rec.latitude; hit.longitude=hit.longitude??rec.longitude;
    hit.city=prefer(hit.city,rec.city); hit.regency=prefer(hit.regency,rec.regency); hit.district=prefer(hit.district,rec.district);
    hit.source = hit.source===rec.source ? hit.source : `${hit.source} + ${rec.source}`;
    hit.source_url=prefer(hit.source_url,rec.source_url);
    hit.source_ids=Object.assign({},hit.source_ids||{},rec.source_ids||{});
    hit.last_checked=new Date().toISOString();
  }
  return out;
}


async function enrichInstagramFromWebsites(records, onProgress, signal){
  const candidates=records.filter(r=>r.website && /^https?:\/\//i.test(r.website) && (!r.instagram || r.instagram==='Not Found')).slice(0,40);
  if(!candidates.length) return records;
  const endpoint = ['localhost','127.0.0.1'].includes(location.hostname) ? '/api/social-enrich' : '/api/acq-social-enrich';
  try{
    onProgress && onProgress(`Mencari Instagram dari website bisnis (${candidates.length} kandidat)...`);
    const res=await acqFetch(endpoint,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({websites:candidates.map(r=>({external_id:r.external_id,website:r.website}))}),signal:signal||discoveryAbortController?.signal});
    const data=await res.json().catch(()=>({}));
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error||('Social enrichment HTTP '+res.status));
    const byId=new Map((data.results||[]).map(x=>[x.external_id,x]));
    records.forEach(r=>{ const x=byId.get(r.external_id); if(x?.instagram){ r.instagram=x.instagram; r.social_verified=true; r.instagram_status='verified'; } else if(r.instagram==='Not Found'){ r.instagram_status='not_found'; } });
    onProgress && onProgress(`Instagram terverifikasi dari website: ${(data.results||[]).filter(x=>x.instagram).length}.`);
  }catch(e){ onProgress && onProgress('Social enrichment dilewati: '+e.message); }
  return records;
}

const DISCOVERY_PROVIDERS = {
  osm: {
    label: 'OpenStreetMap (Overpass API)',
    async run(areaKey, categoryKey, onProgress, forceRefresh){
      assertDiscoveryActive();
      const elements=await fetchOSM(areaKey,categoryKey,onProgress,forceRefresh);
      onProgress && onProgress(`Found ${elements.length} raw OSM records. Normalizing...`);
      return elements.map(normalizeOSMElement).filter(Boolean);
    }
  },
  google_places: {
    label: 'Google Places API (secure proxy)',
    async run(areaKey,categoryKey,onProgress){ assertDiscoveryActive(); return fetchGoogleProxy(areaKey,categoryKey,onProgress,discoveryAbortController?.signal); }
  },
  hybrid: {
    label: 'Hybrid — OSM + Google Places',
    async run(areaKey,categoryKey,onProgress,forceRefresh){
      const osm=await DISCOVERY_PROVIDERS.osm.run(areaKey,categoryKey,onProgress,forceRefresh);
      let google=[];
      const proxy=getGoogleProxyUrl();
      if(proxy){
        try{ google=await DISCOVERY_PROVIDERS.google_places.run(areaKey,categoryKey,onProgress); }
        catch(e){ onProgress && onProgress(`Google Places skipped: ${e.message}`); }
      } else {
        onProgress && onProgress('Google Places not configured — continuing with OSM only.');
      }
      onProgress && onProgress(`Merging ${osm.length} OSM + ${google.length} Google records...`);
      return mergeBusinessRecords([...osm,...google]);
    }
  }
};

async function runDiscovery(){
  const areaKey = document.getElementById('disc-area').value;
  const categoryKey = document.getElementById('disc-category').value;
  const sourceKey = document.getElementById('disc-source').value;
  const forceRefresh = !!document.getElementById('disc-force-refresh')?.checked;
  const provider = DISCOVERY_PROVIDERS[sourceKey];
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-start-discovery');
  const stopBtn = document.getElementById('btn-stop-discovery');
  const progressBlock = document.getElementById('disc-progress-block');
  const progressList = document.getElementById('disc-progress-list');
  const resultBlock = document.getElementById('disc-result-block');
  // FIX (tidak ada opsi berhenti): dulu sekali Discovery jalan, satu-satunya
  // cara berhenti adalah menutup tab (berisiko kehilangan progress). Flag ini
  // dicek di setiap iterasi loop scoring (bagian yang paling lama, karena
  // satu panggilan AI per lead) — kalau user klik Stop, loop berhenti rapi
  // di lead berikutnya dan progress yang sudah ke-score tetap disimpan.
  if (discoveryJob && ['running','stopping'].includes(discoveryJob.status)) { toast('Discovery masih berjalan. Hentikan proses aktif terlebih dahulu.'); return; }
  discoveryStopRequested = false;
  discoveryAbortController = new AbortController();
  discoveryJob = {job_id:jobUid(),status:'running',started_at:new Date().toISOString(),area:areaKey,category:categoryKey,source:sourceKey,sequence_no:0};
  const discoveryBridge=await getTraceBridge(800);
  if(discoveryBridge?.saveDiscoveryJob) await discoveryBridge.saveDiscoveryJob(discoveryJob);
  if (stopBtn){ stopBtn.style.display='block'; stopBtn.onclick=()=>{ if(discoveryStopRequested)return; discoveryStopRequested=true; if(discoveryJob)discoveryJob.status='stopping'; discoveryAbortController?.abort(); stopBtn.disabled=true; stopBtn.textContent='Menghentikan...'; }; stopBtn.disabled=false; stopBtn.textContent='⏹ Stop Discovery'; }

  if (!provider){
    if(discoveryJob){discoveryJob.status='FAILED'; await discoveryBridge?.updateDiscoveryJob?.(discoveryJob.job_id,'FAILED',{}, {reason:'provider_unconfigured'});}
    discoveryAbortController=null; discoveryStopRequested=false;
    toast('Sumber data ini belum dikonfigurasi');
    return;
  }
  if(location.protocol==='file:'){
    progressBlock.style.display='block';
    progressList.innerHTML='<div>› Mode file:// tidak dapat memanggil server discovery.</div><div>› Jalankan OPEN_TRACE_CONSULTANT.command untuk tes lokal, atau deploy ke Netlify.</div>';
    if(discoveryJob){discoveryJob.status='FAILED'; await discoveryBridge?.updateDiscoveryJob?.(discoveryJob.job_id,'FAILED',{}, {reason:'file_protocol'});}
    discoveryAbortController=null; discoveryStopRequested=false;
    toast('Jalankan OPEN_TRACE_CONSULTANT.command sebelum discovery lokal.');
    return;
  }

  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner"></span>Running Discovery...';
  progressBlock.style.display = 'block';
  resultBlock.style.display = 'none';
  progressList.innerHTML = '';
  const logStep = (msg) => { progressList.innerHTML += `<div>› ${escapeHtml(msg)}</div>`; progressList.scrollTop = progressList.scrollHeight; };

  try{
    logStep('Discovery started — area: ' + areaKey + ', category: ' + categoryKey);
    let normalized = await provider.run(areaKey, categoryKey, logStep, forceRefresh);
    assertDiscoveryActive();
    normalized = mergeBusinessRecords(normalized);
    try{localStorage.setItem('trace:acquisition:last-checkpoint:v1',JSON.stringify(discoveryCheckpointState({label:'discovery_raw_collected',raw_count:normalized.length,saved:false})));}catch(e){}
    normalized = await enrichInstagramFromWebsites(normalized,logStep,discoveryAbortController?.signal);
    assertDiscoveryActive();

    // DEDUPLICATE — external id, phone, Instagram, website, then name+distance.
    logStep(`Deduplicating ${normalized.length} normalized records...`);
    let newCount = 0, existingCount = 0, updatedCount = 0, duplicatesInBatch = 0;
    const batchRecords = [];
    const toInsert = [];
    const toUpdate = [];

    normalized.forEach(rec=>{
      if(batchRecords.some(x=>recordsLikelySame(x,rec))){ duplicatesInBatch++; return; }
      batchRecords.push(rec);

      const existing = LEADS.find(l => recordsLikelySame(l,rec));
      if (existing){
        existingCount++;
        const before=JSON.stringify(existing);
        const mergeFields=['business_name','category','city','regency','district','address','latitude','longitude','phone','website','instagram','rating','review_count','price_range','outlet_count','opening_hours','external_id','source','source_url','social_verified'];
        mergeFields.forEach(f=>{const v=rec[f]; if(v!==undefined && v!==null && v!=='' && v!=='Unknown' && v!=='Not Found') existing[f]=v;});
        existing.last_checked=new Date().toISOString(); existing.updated_at=new Date().toISOString();
        if(JSON.stringify(existing)!==before) updatedCount++;
        toUpdate.push(existing);
        return;
      }
      newCount++; toInsert.push(rec);
    });

    // SAVE NEW + REFRESH EXISTING RECORDS
    logStep(`Saving ${toInsert.length} new + refreshing ${toUpdate.length} existing businesses...`);
    const insertedLeads = toInsert.map(rec => blankLead(rec));
    LEADS.push(...insertedLeads);
    await persistDiscoveryCheckpoint('leads_raw_persisted',{new_count:newCount,existing_count:existingCount,updated_count:updatedCount});

    // ENRICH — already merged into normalize() since contact:* tags are the
    // enrichment data available directly from the source; nothing further
    // is fabricated or guessed here.
    logStep('Enrichment complete (contact/instagram/website taken directly from source tags where present).');

    // SCORE
    logStep(`Analyzing ${insertedLeads.length} new leads...`);
    let scored = 0, scoreFailed = 0, stoppedEarly = false;
    // FIX: nyimpen ke Supabase tiap 25 lead (bukan tiap 1 lead) — lihat
    // catatan di runAIAnalysis(). Tetap ada progress save berkala supaya
    // kalau tab tertutup/koneksi putus di tengah jalan, paling banyak
    // cuma kehilangan hasil scoring 25 lead terakhir, bukan mulai dari nol.
    const SAVE_BATCH_SIZE = 25;
    for (const lead of insertedLeads){
      if (discoveryStopRequested || discoveryAbortController?.signal.aborted){ stoppedEarly = true; logStep(`Dihentikan oleh user setelah ${scored}/${insertedLeads.length} lead dianalisis.`); break; }
      try{
        await runAIAnalysis(lead.id, {skipPersist:true});
        scored++;
        if (scored % SAVE_BATCH_SIZE === 0) await persistLeads();
        logStep(`Scored ${scored}/${insertedLeads.length}: ${lead.business_name} → ${lead.lead_score}`);
      }catch(e){
        scoreFailed++;
        console.error('Scoring failed for', lead.business_name, e);
      }
    }
    // Simpan sisa lead yang belum sempat ke-cover oleh checkpoint per-25 di atas
    // (termasuk kalau dihentikan lebih awal oleh user).
    await persistDiscoveryCheckpoint('scoring_checkpoint',{scored,score_failed:scoreFailed,stopped:stoppedEarly});

    const refreshedToAnalyze = stoppedEarly ? [] : toUpdate.filter(l=>l.analysis && l.last_checked && (Date.now()-new Date(l.analysis.analyzed_at||0).getTime()>0)).slice(0,150);
    if(refreshedToAnalyze.length){
      logStep(`Re-scoring ${refreshedToAnalyze.length} refreshed leads...`);
      for(const lead of refreshedToAnalyze){
        if (discoveryStopRequested || discoveryAbortController?.signal.aborted){ stoppedEarly = true; break; }
        await runAIAnalysis(lead.id, {skipPersist:true});
      }
      await persistDiscoveryCheckpoint('rescore_checkpoint',{rescore_count:refreshedToAnalyze.length});
    }

    const needsVerification = [...insertedLeads,...toUpdate].filter(l =>
      l.phone === 'Unknown' || l.website === 'Unknown' || l.instagram === 'Not Found' || l.rating === null
    ).length;

    if(normalized.length===0){ throw new Error('Tidak ada bisnis ditemukan dari sumber aktif. Coba ulang beberapa saat lagi atau aktifkan Google Places di Settings.'); }
    if(discoveryJob){discoveryJob.status=stoppedEarly?'STOPPED':'COMPLETED'; await discoveryBridge?.updateDiscoveryJob?.(discoveryJob.job_id,discoveryJob.status,{scored,score_failed:scoreFailed,new_count:newCount,updated_count:updatedCount});}
    logStep(stoppedEarly ? 'Discovery dihentikan oleh user (sebagian data sudah tersimpan).' : 'Discovery complete.');
    const hero=document.getElementById('hero-status'); if(hero) hero.textContent=(stoppedEarly?'Dihentikan':'Update selesai')+` · ${newCount} lead baru · ${scored} dianalisis · ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('id-ID',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}`;

    document.getElementById('disc-result-stats').innerHTML = [
      ['Businesses Found', normalized.length],
      ['New Businesses', newCount],
      ['Existing Businesses', existingCount],
      ['Updated Records', updatedCount],
      ['Duplicates Removed', duplicatesInBatch],
      ['Needs Verification', needsVerification]
    ].map(s=>`<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">${s[1]}</div><div class="stat-label">${s[0]}</div></div>`).join('');
    resultBlock.style.display = 'block';

    toast(stoppedEarly ? `Discovery dihentikan — ${scored} lead sudah dianalisis & tersimpan.` : `Discovery selesai: ${newCount} baru · ${updatedCount} diperbarui · ${scoreFailed>0?scoreFailed+' gagal analisis':scored+' dianalisis'}`);
    renderDashboard(); renderLeadsTable();
  }catch(e){
    console.error(e);
    const stopped=e?.code==='DISCOVERY_STOPPED'||e?.name==='AbortError'||discoveryStopRequested;
    if(stopped){ try{await persistDiscoveryCheckpoint('stopped_checkpoint',{stopped:true});}catch(saveErr){console.error('stopped checkpoint failed',saveErr);} if(discoveryJob){discoveryJob.status='STOPPED'; await discoveryBridge?.updateDiscoveryJob?.(discoveryJob.job_id,'STOPPED',{scored:0},{reason:'user_stopped'});} logStep('Discovery dihentikan. Checkpoint terakhir dipertahankan; tidak ada penghapusan data otomatis.'); toast('Discovery dihentikan — checkpoint terakhir tetap tersimpan.'); }
    else { if(discoveryJob){discoveryJob.status='FAILED'; await discoveryBridge?.updateDiscoveryJob?.(discoveryJob.job_id,'FAILED',{},{message:e?.message||String(e)});} logStep('ERROR: '+e.message); toast('Discovery belum berhasil. Data yang sudah ter-checkpoint tidak dihapus.'); }
  }finally{
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.innerHTML = '🔎 START DISCOVERY';
    if (stopBtn) stopBtn.style.display='none';
    discoveryAbortController=null;
    discoveryStopRequested=false;
  }
}

const EXCLUDE_KEYWORDS_KEY = 'trace:acquisition:exclude_keywords:v1';
function getExcludeKeywords(){
  try{ return localStorage.getItem(EXCLUDE_KEYWORDS_KEY) || ''; }catch(e){ return ''; }
}
function onExcludeKeywordsChange(){

function renderLeadsTable(){
  const search = document.getElementById('filter-search').value.toLowerCase();
  const city = document.getElementById('filter-city').value;
  const status = document.getElementById('filter-status').value;
  const category = document.getElementById('filter-category')?.value || '';
  const sortMode = document.getElementById('sort-leads')?.value || 'score_desc';
  // FIX: field kata kunci dipulihkan dari localStorage sekali saat elemen
  // masih kosong, supaya pilihan user (mis. "KFC, Warteg") tidak hilang tiap
  // pindah tab. Ini murni preferensi tampilan filter, bukan mengubah data.
  const excludeInput = document.getElementById('filter-exclude-keywords');
  if (excludeInput && !excludeInput.value && !excludeInput.dataset.touched){
    excludeInput.value = getExcludeKeywords();
    excludeInput.dataset.touched = '1';
  }
  const excludeKeywords = (excludeInput?.value || '').split(',').map(s=>s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);

  let rows = LEADS.filter(l=>{
    if (search && !l.business_name.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return false;
    if (city && l.city !== city) return false;
    if (status && l.status !== status) return false;
    if (category && l.category !== category) return false;
    if (excludeKeywords.length && excludeKeywords.some(k=>l.business_name.toLowerCase().includes(k))) return false;
    return true;
  });

  // FIX (tidak ada sortir sama sekali sebelumnya): lead ditampilkan begitu
  // saja sesuai urutan ditemukan, jadi lead berkualitas tinggi tercampur
  // dengan yang kemungkinan besar bukan target ideal. Sekarang bisa
  // diurutkan berdasarkan skor (default: tertinggi dulu), nama, atau baru
  // ditemukan dulu.
  if (sortMode==='score_desc') rows = rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.lead_score??-1)-(a.lead_score??-1));
  else if (sortMode==='score_asc') rows = rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>(a.lead_score??-1)-(b.lead_score??-1));
  else if (sortMode==='name_asc') rows = rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.business_name.localeCompare(b.business_name));
  else if (sortMode==='recent') rows = rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.last_checked||0)-new Date(a.last_checked||0));

  const tbody = document.getElementById('leads-table-body');
  if (rows.length===0){
    tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="8"><div class="empty-state">Tidak ada lead yang cocok. Import, tambahkan, atau jalankan Discovery untuk mendapatkan lead baru.</div></td></tr>`;
    return;
  }
  tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(l=>{
    const lvl = potentialLevel(l.lead_score);
    return `<tr class="row-clickable" data-id="${l.id}">
      <td>${escapeHtml(l.business_name)}</td>
      <td>${escapeHtml(l.category)}</td>
      <td>${escapeHtml(l.district!=='Unknown'?l.district:l.city)}</td>
      <td>${l.rating ?? '—'}</td>
      <td><span class="score-badge ${lvl.cls}">${l.lead_score ?? '—'}</span></td>
      <td><span class="status-pill status-${escapeHtml(l.status)}">${escapeHtml(l.status.replace('_',' '))}</span></td>
      <td style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--text-faint);">${(l.last_checked||'').slice(0,10)}</td>
      <td>${freshness(l.last_checked).icon} <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-faint);">${freshness(l.last_checked).label}</span></td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join('');
  tbody.querySelectorAll('tr').forEach(tr=>{
    tr.addEventListener('click', ()=> openDetail(tr.dataset.id));
  });
}

function getInstagramUsername(value){
  if(!value || ['Unknown','Not Found'].includes(value)) return null;
  let v=String(value).trim();
  const m=v.match(/instagram\.com\/(?:[^/]+\/)?([A-Za-z0-9._]+)/i);
  if(m) return m[1].replace(/^@/,'');
  v=v.replace(/^@/,'').replace(/^https?:\/\//i,'').replace(/^www\./i,'').replace(/^instagram\.com\//i,'').split(/[/?#]/)[0].trim();
  return /^[A-Za-z0-9._]{1,30}$/.test(v) ? v : null;
}
function instagramProfileUrl(lead){
  const u=getInstagramUsername(lead?.instagram);
  return u ? `https://www.instagram.com/${encodeURIComponent(u)}/` : null;
}
function instagramDMUrl(lead){
  const u=getInstagramUsername(lead?.instagram);
  return u ? `https://ig.me/m/${encodeURIComponent(u)}` : null;
}
// Manual lookup assist — OSM & Google Places do not provide Instagram as a
// data field, and we do not scrape Instagram itself. This simply opens a
// Google search in a new tab so a human can find and paste the handle via
// "New Lead" edit / CSV import. No automated fetching happens here.
function searchInstagramManually(id){
  const lead=LEADS.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!lead) return;
  const cityPart = [lead.city, lead.regency].filter(v=>v && v!=='Unknown').join(' ');
  const q = `site:instagram.com "${lead.business_name}" ${cityPart}`.trim();
  window.open(`https://www.google.com/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
}
function openInstagramProfile(id){
  const lead=LEADS.find(x=>x.id===id); const url=instagramProfileUrl(lead);
  if(!url){toast('Instagram belum ditemukan/terverifikasi untuk lead ini.');return;}
  window.open(url,'_blank','noopener,noreferrer');

async function prepareAndOpenInstagramDM(id){
  const lead=LEADS.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!lead)return;
  const url=instagramDMUrl(lead);
  if(!url){toast('Instagram belum ditemukan/terverifikasi untuk lead ini.');return;}
  // Open synchronously first to avoid popup blockers, then prepare the draft.
  const tab=window.open('about:blank','_blank');
  if(!tab){toast('Popup diblokir browser. Izinkan pop-up untuk TRACE.');return;}
  tab.document.write('<title>Menyiapkan Instagram…</title><body style="font-family:system-ui;padding:32px">Menyiapkan DM TRACE…</body>');
  try{
    if(!lead.analysis) await runAIAnalysis(id);
    let last=lead.outreach?.[lead.outreach.length-1];
    if(!last || !last.message || last.status!=='draft'){
      await generateDM(id);
    }
    await navigator.clipboard?.writeText(lead.outreach?.[lead.outreach.length-1]?.message || '');
    tab.location.href=url;
    toast('DM disiapkan & dibuka. Teks DM juga dicoba disalin.');
    renderDetail(lead); renderDashboard(); renderLeadsTable();
  }catch(e){
    console.error(e); tab.location.href=url; toast('Instagram dibuka. Draft DM belum siap; buka lead untuk membuatnya.');
  }
}

  }

  document.getElementById('detail-modal-content').innerHTML = html;

  const runBtn = document.getElementById('btn-run-analysis');
  if (runBtn) runBtn.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
    runBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner"></span>Menganalisis...';
    runBtn.disabled = true;
    try{
      await runAIAnalysis(lead.id);
      toast('Analysis selesai');

      renderDashboard(); renderLeadsTable();
    }catch(e){
      console.error(e);
      toast('Gagal menjalankan AI Analysis');
      runBtn.innerHTML = 'Run Analysis'; runBtn.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  const dmBtn = document.getElementById('btn-generate-dm');
  if (dmBtn) dmBtn.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
    dmBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner"></span>Menulis DM...';
    dmBtn.disabled = true;
    try{
      await generateDM(lead.id);
      toast('DM berhasil dibuat');
      renderDetail(LEADS.find(l=>l.id===lead.id));
    }catch(e){
      console.error(e);
      toast('Gagal generate DM');
      dmBtn.innerHTML = 'Generate DM'; dmBtn.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-set-status]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
      const newStatus = btn.dataset.setStatus;
      lead.status = newStatus;
      lead.updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
      scheduleNextFollowup(lead,newStatus);
      if (['contacted','replied','meeting','proposal','closed'].includes(newStatus)){
        const outreachStatusMap = {contacted:'sent', replied:'replied', meeting:'meeting_booked', proposal:'proposal', closed:'won'};
        if (lead.outreach.length===0){
          lead.outreach.push({id:uid(),channel:'instagram',message:'',status:outreachStatusMap[newStatus],sent_at:new Date().toISOString(),replied_at: newStatus!=='contacted'?new Date().toISOString():null,notes:'',created_at:new Date().toISOString()});
        } else {
          const last = lead.outreach[lead.outreach.length-1];
          last.status = outreachStatusMap[newStatus];
          if (newStatus==='contacted') last.sent_at = last.sent_at || new Date().toISOString();
          if (newStatus!=='contacted') last.replied_at = new Date().toISOString();
        }
      }
      await persistLeads();
      toast('Status diperbarui: ' + newStatus.replace('_',' '));
      renderDetail(lead); renderDashboard(); renderLeadsTable();
    });
  });
}

/* ---------- CSV import ---------- */
function parseCSV(text){
  const rows=[]; let row=[]; let cell=''; let quoted=false;
  for(let i=0;i<text.length;i++){
    const ch=text[i], next=text[i+1];
    if(ch==='"'){ if(quoted && next==='"'){cell+='"';i++;} else quoted=!quoted; }
    else if(ch===',' && !quoted){row.push(cell.trim());cell='';}
    else if((ch==='\n'||ch==='\r')&&!quoted){if(ch==='\r'&&next==='\n')i++;row.push(cell.trim());cell='';if(row.some(v=>v!==''))rows.push(row);row=[];}
    else cell+=ch;
  }
  if(cell!==''||row.length){row.push(cell.trim());rows.push(row);}
  if(rows.length<2)return []; const headers=rows[0].map(h=>h.trim());
  return rows.slice(1).map(cells=>{const obj={};headers.forEach((h,i)=>obj[h]=cells[i]??'');return obj;});
}

async function importCSV(){
  const text = document.getElementById('csv-input').value;
  if (!text.trim()){ toast('CSV kosong'); return; }
  const rows = parseCSV(text);
  if (rows.length===0){ toast('Format CSV tidak valid'); return; }
  let count = 0;
  rows.forEach(row=>{
    if (!row.business_name) return;
    const numOr = v => (v===undefined || v==='' ) ? null : Number(v);
    const strOr = v => (v===undefined || v==='') ? 'Unknown' : v;
    const lead = blankLead({
      business_name: row.business_name,
      category: strOr(row.category),
      city: strOr(row.city),
      regency: strOr(row.regency || row.city),
      district: strOr(row.district),
      address: strOr(row.address),
      phone: strOr(row.phone),
      website: strOr(row.website),
      instagram: strOr(row.instagram),
      rating: numOr(row.rating),
      review_count: numOr(row.review_count),
      price_range: strOr(row.price_range),
      outlet_count: numOr(row.outlet_count),
      opening_hours: strOr(row.opening_hours),
      source: strOr(row.source) === 'Unknown' ? 'csv import' : row.source,
      source_url: strOr(row.source_url)
    });
    LEADS.push(lead);
    count++;
  });
  await persistLeads();
  document.getElementById('import-result').textContent = `${count} lead berhasil diimport.`;
  toast(`${count} lead diimport`);
  renderDashboard(); renderLeadsTable();
}

function copyLatestDM(id){
  const l=LEADS.find(x=>x.id===id), o=l?.outreach?.[l.outreach.length-1]; if(!o)return;
  navigator.clipboard?.writeText(o.message).then(()=>toast('DM disalin')).catch(()=>toast('Tidak bisa copy otomatis; blok teks DM lalu copy.'));
}
async function markLatestSent(id){
  const l=LEADS.find(x=>x.id===id), o=l?.outreach?.[l.outreach.length-1]; if(!o)return;
  o.status='sent';o.sent_at=new Date().toISOString();l.status='contacted';scheduleNextFollowup(l,'contacted');l.updated_at=new Date().toISOString();await persistLeads();toast('DM ditandai sudah dikirim');renderDetail(l);renderDashboard();renderPipeline();
}
async function generateFollowup(id,step){
  const l=LEADS.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!l)return;
  const angle=l.analysis?.recommended_sales_angle||'profitability';
  const name=l.business_name;
  const msgs={
    1:`Halo Kak, izin follow up sedikit soal ${name}. Saya kepikiran satu hal dari sisi ${angle.toLowerCase()} yang mungkin cukup relevan untuk bisnisnya. Kalau berkenan, saya bisa share insight singkatnya di sini.`,
    2:`Halo Kak, saya tutup follow up saya untuk ${name} dulu ya. Kalau suatu saat sedang evaluasi ${angle.toLowerCase()} atau mau melihat angka bisnis lebih rapi, saya dengan senang hati bantu sharing benchmark awal tanpa komitmen.`
  };
  const msg=msgs[step]||msgs[1];
  l.outreach.push({id:uid(),channel:'instagram',message:msg,status:'draft',sequence:`followup_${step}`,sent_at:null,replied_at:null,notes:'Local follow-up draft — personalize before sending.',created_at:new Date().toISOString()});
  l.next_follow_up_at=step===1?daysFromNow(salesSettings().fu2):null;l.updated_at=new Date().toISOString();await persistLeads();toast(`Follow-up ${step} dibuat`);renderDetail(l);renderFollowups();
}

function saveLeadNotes(id){
  const lead=LEADS.find(l=>l.id===id); const el=document.getElementById('lead-notes-'+id);
  if(!lead||!el)return; lead.notes=el.value; lead.updated_at=new Date().toISOString(); persistLeads(); toast('Catatan tersimpan');

async function markConverted(id){
  const lead=LEADS.find(l=>l.id===id); if(!lead)return;
  try{
    const bridge=await getTraceBridge(1200);
    if(!bridge?.createClientFromLead) throw new Error('TRACE bridge belum siap');
    const result=await bridge.createClientFromLead(lead);
    lead.converted_to_client=true; lead.conversion_date=new Date().toISOString(); lead.trace_client_id=result.client.id; lead.updated_at=new Date().toISOString();
    await persistLeads();
    toast(result.existing?'Client sudah ada di Database Klien TRACE.':'Lead berhasil menjadi Client TRACE Consultant.');
  }catch(e){console.error(e);toast('Konversi gagal: '+(e.message||'periksa koneksi/database'),true);return;}
  renderDetail(lead);renderDashboard();renderLeadsTable();
}
function renderPipeline(){
  const summary=document.getElementById('pipeline-summary');
  summary.innerHTML=PIPELINE_STAGES.map(st=>`<div class="quick-card"><div class="quick-value">${LEADS.filter(l=>l.status===st).length}</div><div class="quick-label">${STAGE_LABELS[st]}</div></div>`).join('');

    const arr=LEADS.filter(l=>l.status===st).sort((a,b)=>(b.lead_score||0)-(a.lead_score||0)).slice(0,30);
    return `<div class="kanban-col"><div class="kanban-head"><span>${STAGE_LABELS[st]}</span><span class="kanban-count">${arr.length}</span></div>${arr.map(l=>`<div class="kanban-card" onclick="openDetail('${l.id}')"><div class="kanban-name">${escapeHtml(l.business_name)}</div><div class="kanban-meta">${escapeHtml(l.category)} · ${escapeHtml(l.district!=='Unknown'?l.district:l.city)}</div><div style="margin-top:6px;"><span class="score-badge ${potentialLevel(l.lead_score).cls}">${l.lead_score??'—'}</span></div>${l.next_follow_up_at?`<div class="next-action">Next: ${formatDateTime(l.next_follow_up_at)}</div>`:''}</div>`).join('') || '<div class="unknown" style="padding:12px 4px;">Kosong</div>'}</div>`;
  }).join('');

function renderFollowups(){
  const due=LEADS.filter(l=>l.next_follow_up_at && !['closed','not_a_fit'].includes(l.status)).sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.next_follow_up_at)-new Date(b.next_follow_up_at));
  const overdue=due.filter(followupDue).length;
  const today=due.filter(l=>{const d=new Date(l.next_follow_up_at),n=new Date();return d.toDateString()===n.toDateString()}).length;
  document.getElementById('followup-stats').innerHTML=[['Overdue',overdue],['Hari Ini',today],['Terjadwal',due.length],['High Potential',due.filter(l=>(l.lead_score||0)>=75).length]].map(x=>`<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">${x[1]}</div><div class="stat-label">${x[0]}</div></div>`).join('');

async function markFollowupDone(id){

function renderInsights(){
  const contacted=LEADS.filter(l=>['contacted','replied','meeting','proposal','closed'].includes(l.status)).length;
  const replied=LEADS.filter(l=>['replied','meeting','proposal','closed'].includes(l.status)).length;
  const meetings=LEADS.filter(l=>['meeting','proposal','closed'].includes(l.status)).length;
  const won=LEADS.filter(l=>l.status==='closed').length;
  const replyRate=contacted?Math.round(replied/contacted*100):0;
  const meetRate=contacted?Math.round(meetings/contacted*100):0;
  const winRate=contacted?Math.round(won/contacted*100):0;
  document.getElementById('insight-stats').innerHTML=[['Contacted',contacted],['Reply Rate',replyRate+'%'],['Meeting Rate',meetRate+'%'],['Win Rate',winRate+'%']].map(x=>`<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">${x[1]}</div><div class="stat-label">${x[0]}</div></div>`).join('');
  const byAngle={}; LEADS.forEach(l=>{const a=l.analysis?.recommended_sales_angle||'Unknown';if(!byAngle[a])byAngle[a]={total:0,replied:0};byAngle[a].total++;if(['replied','meeting','proposal','closed'].includes(l.status))byAngle[a].replied++;});
  const angles=Object.entries(byAngle).sort((a,b)=>(b[1].replied/Math.max(1,b[1].total))-(a[1].replied/Math.max(1,a[1].total))).slice(0,5);
  document.getElementById('winning-signals').innerHTML=angles.length?angles.map(([a,v])=>{const rate=Math.round(v.replied/Math.max(1,v.total)*100);return `<div style="margin-bottom:12px;"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;"><span>${a}</span><span>${rate}% reply signal</span></div><div class="learning-bar"><div class="learning-fill" style="width:${Math.min(100,rate)}%"></div></div></div>`}).join(''):'<div class="unknown">Belum cukup data outcome. Mulai outreach untuk membangun learning signal.</div>';
  const cat={};LEADS.forEach(l=>{const k=l.category||'Unknown';if(!cat[k])cat[k]={n:0,score:0};cat[k].n++;cat[k].score+=(l.lead_score||0)});
  const focus=Object.entries(cat).map(([k,v])=>({k,avg:Math.round(v.score/Math.max(1,v.n)),n:v.n})).sort((a,b)=>b.avg-a.avg).slice(0,5);
  document.getElementById('recommended-focus').innerHTML=focus.map(x=>`<div class="kv"><span class="kv-k">${x.k} (${x.n})</span><span class="kv-v">Avg ${x.avg}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="unknown">Belum ada data.</div>';
  const funnel=[['Discovered',LEADS.length],['Analyzed',LEADS.filter(l=>l.analysis).length],['Contacted',contacted],['Replied',replied],['Meeting',meetings],['Won',won]];const max=Math.max(1,...funnel.map(x=>x[1]));
  document.getElementById('sales-funnel').innerHTML=funnel.map(x=>`<div class="funnel-row"><span>${x[0]}</span><div class="funnel-track"><div class="funnel-fill" style="width:${Math.round(x[1]/max*100)}%"></div></div><span>${x[1]}</span></div>`).join('');
}
function exportLeadsCSV(){
  const headers=['business_name','category','city','regency','district','address','phone','website','instagram','rating','review_count','price_range','outlet_count','lead_score','fit_score','fit_status','priority','acquisition_stage','status','next_follow_up_at','source','source_url','last_checked'];
  const esc=v=>'"'+String(v??'').replace(/"/g,'""')+'"';
  const csv=[headers.join(','),...LEADS.map(l=>headers.map(h=>esc(l[h])).join(','))].join('\n');
  downloadBlob(csv,'trace-acquisition-leads.csv','text/csv;charset=utf-8');
}
function exportBackup(){downloadBlob(JSON.stringify({version:'TRACE Acquisition OS Final',exported_at:new Date().toISOString(),leads:LEADS,settings:salesSettings()},null,2),'trace-acquisition-backup.json','application/json');}
function downloadBlob(text,name,type){const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text],{type}));a.download=name;a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000);}
async function restoreBackup(file){if(!file)return;try{const data=JSON.parse(await file.text());if(!Array.isArray(data.leads))throw new Error('Backup tidak valid');LEADS=data.leads;await persistLeads();if(data.settings)localStorage.setItem(SETTINGS_KEY,JSON.stringify(data.settings));toast('Backup berhasil dipulihkan');renderDashboard();renderLeadsTable();}catch(e){toast('Backup gagal dipulihkan');console.error(e);}}
async function clearAllLeads(){if(!confirm('Hapus semua lead dari browser ini? Data tidak dapat dipulihkan tanpa backup.'))return;LEADS=[];await persistLeads();toast('Semua data lokal dihapus');renderDashboard();renderLeadsTable();}
async function refreshStaleLeads(){
  const stale=LEADS.filter(l=>freshness(l.last_checked).label!=='Fresh'&&!['closed','not_a_fit'].includes(l.status));
  if(!stale.length){toast('Semua lead masih fresh');return;}
  // Refreshing means re-running discovery for the configured Bogor scope; source-level refresh updates records without creating duplicates.
  switchPage('discovery'); toast(`${stale.length} lead aging/stale. Menjalankan discovery untuk refresh sumber.`); setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('btn-start-discovery')?.click(),100);
}

/* ============================================================
   INIT
============================================================ */
(async function init(){
  await loadLeads();
  renderDashboard();
  renderLeadsTable();
  // Normalize legacy records for V2/V3 fields without changing existing data.
  LEADS.forEach(l=>{ if(l.fit_score===undefined)l.fit_score=l.lead_score??null; if(l.fit_status===undefined)l.fit_status=l.fit_score==null?'insufficient_data':(l.fit_score>=75?'high':l.fit_score>=50?'medium':'low'); if(l.priority===undefined)l.priority=l.fit_status==='high'?'P1':l.fit_status==='medium'?'P2':l.fit_status==='low'?'P3':'P4'; if(l.acquisition_stage===undefined)l.acquisition_stage=l.fit_score==null?'discovery':'prioritized'; if(!Array.isArray(l.problem_hypotheses))l.problem_hypotheses=[]; if(!Array.isArray(l.outreach))l.outreach=[]; if(l.next_follow_up_at===undefined)l.next_follow_up_at=null; if(l.notes===undefined)l.notes=''; if(l.converted_to_client===undefined)l.converted_to_client=false; });
  persistLeads();
})();
</script>

-- ============================================================
-- TRACE Acquisition OS V1 — Supabase / PostgreSQL schema
-- Internal sales intelligence system for TRACE Consultant
-- Scope: F&B leads in Kota Bogor & Kabupaten Bogor
-- ============================================================

create extension if not exists "pgcrypto";

-- ------------------------------------------------------------
-- leads
-- ------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists leads (
  id                uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_name     text not null,
  category          text,               -- coffee shop / cafe / restaurant / bakery / dessert / casual dining / other
  city              text,               -- 'Kota Bogor' | 'Kabupaten Bogor'
  regency           text,
  district          text,
  address           text,
  latitude          numeric,
  longitude         numeric,
  phone             text,
  website           text,
  instagram         text,
  rating             numeric,
  review_count      integer,
  price_range       text,
  outlet_count      integer,
  opening_hours     text,
  external_id       text,               -- provider-specific id (e.g. 'osm:node/123456') used for dedup
  social_verified   boolean not null default false, -- true only if a social handle was found directly in source data
  source            text,               -- where this record came from (manual / csv import / api name / OpenStreetMap)
  source_url        text,
  last_checked      timestamptz,
  data_quality      numeric,            -- 0-100, computed from field completeness
  status            text not null default 'new',
    -- new | analyzed | contacted | replied | meeting | not_a_fit | closed
  lead_score        numeric,            -- 0-100, null until analyzed
  created_at        timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at        timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists idx_leads_city on leads (city);
create index if not exists idx_leads_status on leads (status);
create index if not exists idx_leads_score on leads (lead_score desc);
create unique index if not exists idx_leads_external_id on leads (external_id) where external_id is not null;

-- ------------------------------------------------------------
-- lead_analysis
-- ------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists lead_analysis (
  id                        uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  lead_id                   uuid not null references leads(id) on delete cascade,
  business_potential        numeric,     -- 0-100, AI-derived
  growth_signal             numeric,     -- 0-100, AI-derived
  operational_complexity    numeric,     -- 0-100, AI-derived
  marketing_opportunity     numeric,     -- 0-100, AI-derived
  profitability_opportunity numeric,     -- 0-100, AI-derived
  expansion_signal          numeric,     -- 0-100, AI-derived
  overall_score             numeric,     -- 0-100, weighted composite incl. data_quality
  likely_pain_points        jsonb,       -- [{text, is_hypothesis: true/false}]
  opportunity               text,
  recommended_sales_angle   text,
  reasoning                 text,
  analyzed_at               timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists idx_lead_analysis_lead_id on lead_analysis (lead_id);

-- ------------------------------------------------------------
-- outreach
-- ------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists outreach (
  id           uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  lead_id      uuid not null references leads(id) on delete cascade,
  channel      text not null default 'instagram',
  message      text,
  status       text not null default 'draft',
    -- draft | sent | replied | meeting_booked | no_response | declined
  sent_at      timestamptz,
  replied_at   timestamptz,
  notes        text,
  created_at   timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index if not exists idx_outreach_lead_id on outreach (lead_id);

-- ------------------------------------------------------------
-- updated_at trigger for leads
-- ------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function set_updated_at()
returns trigger as $$
begin
  new.updated_at = now();
  return new;
end;
$$ language plpgsql;

drop trigger if exists trg_leads_updated_at on leads;
create trigger trg_leads_updated_at
before update on leads
for each row execute function set_updated_at();

--   business_potential        20%
--   growth_signal              20%
--   operational_complexity     15%
--   marketing_opportunity      15%
--   profitability_opportunity  15%
--   expansion_signal           10%
--   data_quality                5%
-- lead_score = weighted sum of the above (0-100)
-- ============================================================

alter table leads add column if not exists is_demo boolean not null default false;

create index if not exists idx_leads_source_ids on leads using gin (source_ids);
create index if not exists idx_leads_last_checked on leads (last_checked);

alter table public.leads enable row level security;
alter table public.lead_analysis enable row level security;
alter table public.outreach enable row level security;

drop policy if exists "acquisition authenticated leads" on public.leads;
drop policy if exists "acquisition authenticated lead_analysis" on public.lead_analysis;
drop policy if exists "acquisition authenticated outreach" on public.outreach;
create policy "acquisition authenticated leads" on public.leads for all to authenticated using (true) with check (true);
create policy "acquisition authenticated lead_analysis" on public.lead_analysis for all to authenticated using (true) with check (true);
create policy "acquisition authenticated outreach" on public.outreach for all to authenticated using (true) with check (true);
revoke all on table public.leads, public.lead_analysis, public.outreach from anon;
grant select, insert, update, delete on table public.leads, public.lead_analysis, public.outreach to authenticated;

Discovery

Temukan bisnis F&B di wilayah target

Tidak perlu mencari Google → Maps → Instagram satu per satu. OS akan mengambil data dari sumber yang tersedia, menghapus duplikat, lalu memprioritaskan lead.

Pengaturan sumber data
Google Places menambah rating, jumlah review, website, telepon, jam buka, dan Google Maps URL. API key disimpan di server/proxy, bukan di browser. Instagram hanya disimpan bila ditemukan dan dapat diverifikasi; sistem tidak melakukan bypass Instagram.

V1 tidak memerlukan API key untuk discovery dasar. Untuk data Google rating/review/website/telepon yang lebih lengkap, sambungkan Google Places melalui server-side proxy.

AI / Scoring

Jika AI provider belum dikonfigurasi, OS tetap melakukan scoring lokal berbasis data nyata yang tersedia. Hasil tersebut ditandai sebagai Local heuristic, bukan fakta dari AI.

Sales Learning

V3 menggunakan hasil contacted → replied → meeting → proposal → won sebagai sinyal pembelajaran untuk memprioritaskan lead berikutnya. Ini adalah learning heuristic lokal, bukan model AI yang mengarang data.

Backup & Data

Semua data browser dapat dicadangkan. Gunakan backup sebelum pindah perangkat atau sebelum integrasi dengan TRACE Consultant OS.

  .content { padding: 26px 42px 68px; max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; width: 100%; }

  .view-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 26px; padding-bottom: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
  h2.view-title { font-size: 27px; font-weight: 800; margin: 0 0 5px; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--ink); }

  .section-label {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em;

  form.panel {

  input, select, textarea {
    width: 100%; font-family: inherit; font-size: 13.5px; padding: 9.5px 12px;

    transition: border-color .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease;
  }
  input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--accent); }

  button.submit {

    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter .12s ease, transform .05s ease, box-shadow .12s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -6px rgba(249,98,44,0.5);
  }
  button.submit:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -6px rgba(249,98,44,0.6); }
  button.submit:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
  button.submit:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; }
  button.ghost {
    background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--ink);

    transition: background .12s ease, border-color .12s ease;
  }
  button.ghost:hover { background: var(--sidebar-panel); border-color: #d7dae3; }
  .status { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 9px; min-height: 14px; }

  .search-bar { margin: 20px 0 8px; display: flex; gap: 8px; }
  .search-bar input { max-width: 320px; border-radius: var(--r-sm); }

  .cards { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin-top: 14px; }
  .card { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 14px 16px; position: relative; box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); transition: border-color .12s ease, transform .12s var(--ease); }
  .card:hover { border-color: #d7dae3; }
  .card .meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted-soft); font-family: var(--mono); margin-bottom: 7px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
  .card .author, .card .title { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; font-size: 13.5px; font-family: Inter; }
  .card .body { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--ink); }
  .badge { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--accent-text); background: var(--accent-soft); padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 6px; margin-right: 6px; display: inline-block; }
  .badge.client { color: #92400e; background: var(--warning-soft); }

  .status-pill { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px; font-family: var(--mono); }
  .status-pill.status-aktif { color: var(--positive); background: var(--positive-soft); }
  .status-pill.status-trial { color: var(--warning); background: var(--warning-soft); }
  .status-pill.status-nonaktif { color: var(--muted); background: var(--sidebar-panel); }
  .pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; margin-top: 9px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--sidebar-panel); color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); }
  .pill.overdue { background: var(--danger-soft); color: var(--danger); }
  .card.overdue { border-color: rgba(185,28,28,0.35); }
  .card a.filelink { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; }

  .progress-track { margin-top: 10px; height: 8px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--sidebar-panel); overflow: hidden; }

  .progress-label { margin-top: 5px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
  .status-pill.status-baru { color: var(--accent-text); background: var(--accent-soft); }

  .chip-row { display: flex; gap: 7px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 14px 0 4px; }

  .status-select { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; font-family: var(--mono); border-radius: 20px; padding: 3px 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--card); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; }
  .info-box { background: var(--accent-soft); border: 1px solid rgba(249,98,44,0.28); border-radius: 12px; padding: 0;
    font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: #9a3b12; margin-bottom: 16px; overflow: hidden; }

  .kpi-cluster-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--muted-soft); margin: 16px 0 8px; }

  .akt-tab-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); margin: 2px 0 10px; }

  /* ---------- Charts ---------- */
  .chart-card { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; padding: 18px 20px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); margin-top: 12px; }

  .asumsi-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px 14px; margin-top: 10px; }

  .exec-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 8px; }

  .stat-card .kpi-icon { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 12px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); }

  .stat-card.kpi-gp .kpi-icon { background: var(--positive-soft); color: var(--positive); }

  .stat-card.kpi-op .kpi-icon { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent-dark); }
  .stat-card .stat-label { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: 0; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .stat-card .stat-value { font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .stat-card .stat-value.warn { color: var(--warning); }
  .stat-card .stat-value.danger { color: var(--danger); }
  .stat-card .stat-foot { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted-soft); margin-top: 9px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
  .stat-card .stat-foot.trend-up { color: var(--positive); font-weight: 600; }

  @media (max-width: 1300px) { .exec-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); } }

  .quick-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 10px; }

  .backup-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
  #importFile { display: none; }

  .activity-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .activity-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .activity-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); margin-top: 6px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .activity-row .atxt { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--ink); }
  .activity-row .atxt b { font-weight: 700; }
  .activity-row .atime { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted-soft); white-space: nowrap; }

  /* ---------- Toasts ---------- */
  .toast-wrap { position: fixed; top: 18px; right: 18px; z-index: 999; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
  .toast {
    background: var(--ink); color: #fff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 11px 16px; border-radius: var(--r-sm);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-width: 200px; max-width: 320px;
    animation: toastin .2s var(--ease); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  }
  .toast.err { background: #7f1d1d; border-color: rgba(248,113,113,0.35); }
  .toast .tdot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4ade80; flex-shrink: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(74,222,128,0.2); }
  .toast.err .tdot { background: #ff8a80; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,138,128,0.18); }
  @keyframes toastin { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

  /* ---------- Auth gate (internal team only) ---------- */
  .auth-overlay {
    display:none; position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:1000; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    padding:24px; background:rgba(15,23,42,.72); backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  }
  .auth-overlay.open { display:flex; }
  .auth-card {
    width:min(420px,100%); background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:22px;
    padding:28px; box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(15,23,42,.28);
  }
  .auth-brand { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; margin-bottom:24px; }
  .auth-logo { width:42px; height:42px; object-fit:contain; border-radius:11px; border:1px solid var(--border); background:#fff; }
  .auth-brand-title { font-size:16px; font-weight:900; color:var(--ink); }
  .auth-brand-sub { font-size:10px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; font-family:var(--mono); }
  .auth-kicker { font-size:9px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--accent); }
  .auth-title { font-size:25px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:-.03em; margin:5px 0 7px; color:var(--ink); }
  .auth-desc { font-size:12px; line-height:1.55; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:20px; }
  .auth-form { display:grid; gap:12px; }
  .auth-form label { font-size:11px; font-weight:800; color:var(--ink); margin-bottom:5px; display:block; }
  .auth-form input { width:100%; }
  .auth-submit { width:100%; margin-top:4px; }
  .auth-error { display:none; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--danger-soft); color:var(--danger); font-size:11px; line-height:1.45; }
  .auth-error.show { display:block; }
  .auth-foot { margin-top:16px; padding-top:13px; border-top:1px solid var(--border-soft); font-size:10px; color:var(--muted-soft); line-height:1.45; }
  .auth-user { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; max-width:260px; }
  .auth-user-email { max-width:170px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; font-size:10.5px; color:var(--muted); }
  .auth-logout { border:1px solid var(--border); background:#fff; color:var(--muted); border-radius:9px; padding:5px 8px; font-size:10px; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; }
  .auth-logout:hover { color:var(--danger); border-color:#fecaca; background:#fff7f7; }

  /* ---------- Modal (konfirmasi hapus & riwayat perubahan) ---------- */
  .modal-overlay {
    display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(23,26,33,0.45); backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
    z-index: 200; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 20px;
  }
  .modal-box {
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-xl); padding: 24px;
    max-width: 380px; width: 100%; box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop); animation: modalin .16s var(--ease);
  }
  @keyframes modalin { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px) scale(.99); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  .modal-box.wide { max-width: 480px; max-height: 80vh; overflow-y: auto; }
  .modal-title { font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--ink); }
  .modal-desc { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .modal-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; justify-content: flex-end; }
  .modal-actions button.submit { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f87171, #b91c1c); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px -6px rgba(185,28,28,0.4); }
  #sopSave.submit { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff8a3d, #f9622c); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px -6px rgba(249,98,44,0.5); }
  .whoami-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin: 8px 4px 2px; }
  .whoami-wrap label { margin: 0; font-size: 10px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .whoami-wrap select { font-size: 11.5px; padding: 5px 7px; }
  .year-select-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .year-select-row select { width: auto; min-width: 90px; }
  .year-select-row .ysr-label { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }

  /* ---------- Diagnosis ---------- */
  .atab-panel { display: none; }
  .atab-panel.active { display: block; }
  .kategori-pill { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 800; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 20px; font-family: var(--mono); letter-spacing: .02em; }
  .kategori-pill.kat-star { color: var(--positive); background: var(--positive-soft); }
  .kategori-pill.kat-plowhorse { color: var(--warning); background: var(--warning-soft); }
  .kategori-pill.kat-puzzle { color: var(--accent-text); background: var(--accent-soft); }
  .kategori-pill.kat-dog { color: var(--danger); background: var(--danger-soft); }
  .cb-row { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 8px; }
  .cb-item { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 20px; font-family: var(--mono); letter-spacing: .01em; }
  .cb-item.done { color: var(--positive); background: var(--positive-soft); }
  .cb-item.pending { color: var(--muted); background: var(--sidebar-panel); }
  .funnel-pill { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 800; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 20px; font-family: var(--mono); }
  .funnel-pill.fn-baik { color: var(--positive); background: var(--positive-soft); }
  .funnel-pill.fn-perlu { color: var(--danger); background: var(--danger-soft); }
  .hist-link { background: none; border: none; color: var(--accent-text); font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; }

  /* ---------- Tablet ---------- */
  @media (max-width: 1180px) and (min-width: 881px) {
    .content { max-width: 100%; padding: 28px 26px 64px; }
    .exec-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); }
    .stat-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); }
    .quick-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); }
  }

  @media (max-width: 880px) {
    .sidebar { display: none; width: 250px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 100vw rgba(23,26,33,0.35); }
    .sidebar.open { display: flex; }
    .main { margin-left: 0; max-width: 100vw; }
    .topbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; padding: 10px 14px; gap: 8px; }
    .jobdesk-switcher .jd-label, .topbar-status .ts-label { display: none; }
    .jobdesk-switcher select { min-width: 0; max-width: 108px; font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 18px 5px 7px; }
    .auth-user-email { display: none; }
    .content { padding: 20px 14px 60px; max-width: 100vw; }
    .exec-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 10px; }
    .stat-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 10px; }
    .quick-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .view-head { flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    form.panel { padding: 16px; }
    .row { gap: 10px; }
    input, select, textarea, button.submit, button.ghost { font-size: 16px; } /* cegah zoom-in otomatis iOS saat fokus input */

    /* Tabel akuntansi (produk & cash flow) jadi tampilan card di HP */
    .card-table { border: none; }
    .card-table thead { display: none; }
    .card-table, .card-table tbody, .card-table tr, .card-table td { display: block; width: 100%; }
    .card-table tr { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; margin-bottom: 10px; background: #fff; }
    .card-table tr.current-month { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .card-table td { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-align: right; padding: 5px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border); font-size: 12.5px; }
    .card-table td:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .card-table td::before { content: attr(data-label); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .03em; text-align: left; }
    .card-table td:first-child::before { content: ""; }
    .card-table td:first-child { font-weight: 800; font-size: 13.5px; justify-content: flex-start; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); margin-bottom: 4px; padding-bottom: 8px; }
    .card-table td:empty { display: none; }
  }

  /* ================================================================
     EXECUTIVE DASHBOARD — controlled structural redesign (v2)
     Ide: 1 fokus visual dominan (chart), angka finansial jadi teks
     editorial (bukan grid kartu seragam), alert/ops jadi baris ringkas
     tanpa bungkus card per-item. ID yang dibaca/ditulis JS TIDAK berubah.
     ================================================================ */
  .dash-context-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 12px; }
  .ctx-chip {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700;
    padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--sidebar-panel); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  }
  .ctx-chip.accent { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: rgba(249,98,44,0.25); color: var(--accent-text); }
  .ctx-chip .dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

  .dash-section { margin-top: 34px; }
  .dash-section:first-of-type { margin-top: 0; }
  .dash-section-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .dash-section-head .dsh-title {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--sidebar-text-dim); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .dash-section-head .dsh-num { display: none; }
  .dash-section-head .dsh-sub { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted-soft); }

  /* ---- 1. Ringkasan finansial: editorial, BUKAN grid kartu seragam.
     Revenue = angka besar jadi anchor tipografis; sisanya baris metrik
     tipis dengan pembatas vertikal, tanpa border/shadow per-item. ---- */
  .fin-hero { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; gap: 40px; padding-bottom: 26px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
  .fin-hero-primary { min-width: 240px; }
  .fin-hero-primary .stat-label { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .fin-hero-primary .stat-value {
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 44px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink); line-height: 1;
  }
  .fin-hero-primary .stat-foot { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted-soft); margin-top: 10px; }
  .fin-hero-secondary { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0; flex: 1; min-width: 280px; }
  .fin-metric { padding: 0 26px; border-left: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
  .fin-metric:first-child { padding-left: 0; border-left: none; }
  .fin-metric .stat-label { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 7px; }
  .fin-metric .stat-value { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); line-height: 1; }
  .fin-metric .stat-foot { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--muted-soft); margin-top: 8px; max-width: 160px; }
  .fin-metric .stat-foot.margin-badge:not(:empty) {
    display: inline-block; font-weight: 800; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--positive);
    background: var(--positive-soft); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 20px; margin-top: 8px;
  }
  @media (max-width: 880px) {
    .fin-hero { gap: 22px; }
    .fin-metric { padding: 0 16px; }
    .fin-hero-primary .stat-value { font-size: 34px; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 560px) {
    .fin-metric { flex: 1 1 44%; border-left: none; padding: 0; }
  }

  .exec-overview-row { display: flex; gap: 18px; align-items: stretch; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .exec-kpi-grid { flex: 1 1 360px; max-width: 460px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; }
  .exec-kpi-grid .stat-card { padding: 16px 16px 14px; }
  .exec-kpi-grid .stat-value { font-size: 22px; }
  .acq-funnel-card { flex: 2 1 480px; }
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    .exec-kpi-grid { max-width: none; }
  }

  /* ---- Funnel akuisisi klien: Prospek -> Deal -> Revenue, gaya ring
     bertingkat seperti referensi dashboard eksternal. ---- */
  .acq-funnel-card {
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 26px 28px 22px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
  .acq-funnel-head { margin-bottom: 22px; }
  .acq-funnel-head .chart-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 3px; }
  .acq-funnel-head .chart-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted-soft); }
  .acq-funnel { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .acq-stage { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; min-width: 118px; }
  .acq-stage-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .acq-ring {
    width: 112px; height: 112px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: conic-gradient(var(--ring-color, var(--accent)) calc(var(--ring-pct, 100) * 1%), var(--border-soft) 0);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; position: relative;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 14px rgba(23,26,33,0.20));
  }
  /* Shading terarah di sepanjang badan ring (bukan cuma titik highlight) supaya
     kelihatan seperti tabung melengkung (torus), bukan cincin datar. Dipotong
     ke bentuk pita ring pakai mask radial (transparan di lubang tengah &
     di luar lingkaran luar). */
  .acq-ring::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none;
    background: linear-gradient(148deg,
      rgba(255,255,255,0.85) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.25) 28%,
      rgba(0,0,0,0) 46%, rgba(0,0,0,0.10) 62%, rgba(0,0,0,0.38) 100%);
    -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(circle, transparent 60%, black 61.5%, black 100%);
            mask-image: radial-gradient(circle, transparent 60%, black 61.5%, black 100%);
    mix-blend-mode: overlay;
  }
  .acq-ring::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--card);
    box-shadow: inset 0 3px 6px rgba(23,26,33,0.14), inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
  }
  .acq-ring-value { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink); line-height: 1.25; padding: 0 6px; }
  .acq-stage-rate { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted-soft); margin-top: 10px; }
  .acq-arrow { color: var(--accent); font-size: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; opacity: 0.7; }
  @media (max-width: 700px) {
    .acq-funnel { justify-content: center; }
    .acq-arrow { transform: rotate(90deg); }
  }

  /* ---- 2. Chart = focal visual dominan, full-width, bukan berbagi
     ruang 50/50 dengan panel lain. Outlet compare jadi elemen sekunder
     di bawahnya, lebih ringkas & ringan. ---- */
  .chart-focal {
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 28px 30px 22px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
  .chart-focal-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .chart-focal-head .chart-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 3px; }
  .chart-focal-head .chart-sub { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted-soft); }
  .chart-focal-legend { display: flex; gap: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .chart-focal-legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
  .chart-focal-legend .lg-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; }
  .chart-focal #dashRevenueChart { margin-top: 12px; }

  .outlet-compare-mini { margin-top: 18px; }
  .outlet-compare-mini .ocm-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .outlet-compare-mini .ocm-title { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--sidebar-text-dim); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
  .outlet-compare-mini .ocm-sub { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted-soft); }
  .outlet-compare-mini table.compare-table { margin-top: 0; }

  .compare-row { padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
  .compare-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .compare-row .cr-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .compare-row .cr-name { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); }
  .compare-row .cr-rev { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); white-space: nowrap; }
  .compare-row .cr-track { height: 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--sidebar-panel); overflow: hidden; }
  .compare-row .cr-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-2), var(--accent)); }
  .compare-row.cr-total .cr-name { color: var(--accent-text); }
  .compare-row.cr-total .cr-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a3a7b3, #6b7280); }
  .compare-row .cr-margin { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--muted-soft); margin-top: 4px; }

  /* Bar kontribusi Revenue di dalam mini-table (dashboard + halaman Outlet) */
  table.compare-table { margin-top: 0; }
  table.compare-table td, table.compare-table th { white-space: nowrap; }
  .mt-bar-cell { min-width: 110px; }
  .mt-bar-track { height: 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--sidebar-panel); overflow: hidden; }
  .mt-bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-2), var(--accent)); }
  .mt-bar-fill.total { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a3a7b3, #6b7280); }

  /* ---- 3. Perlu perhatian: satu baris ringkas, bukan 4 kotak
     berbayang sejajar dengan chart utama. ---- */
  .alert-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; }
  .alert-seg { flex: 1; min-width: 190px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 15px 18px; border-left: 1px solid var(--border-soft); }
  .alert-seg:first-child { border-left: none; }
  .alert-seg .as-num { font-family: var(--mono); font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1; color: var(--ink); flex-shrink: 0; }
  .alert-seg.tone-danger .as-num { color: var(--danger); }
  .alert-seg.tone-warn .as-num { color: var(--warning); }
  .alert-seg.tone-info .as-num { color: var(--accent-text); }
  .alert-seg .as-label { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); }
  .alert-seg .as-sub { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--muted-soft); margin-top: 1px; }
  @media (max-width: 880px) { .alert-seg { border-left: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-soft); } .alert-seg:first-child { border-top: none; } }

  /* ---- 4. Ringkasan operasional: baris inline tipis, tanpa kartu. ---- */
  .ops-inline { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 34px; }
  .ops-inline-item .stat-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 6px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
  .ops-inline-item .stat-value { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); line-height: 1; }
  .ops-inline-item .stat-value.warn { color: var(--warning); }
  .ops-inline-item .stat-value.danger { color: var(--danger); }
  .ops-inline-item .stat-foot { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted-soft); margin-top: 6px; }

  /* ---- 5. Akses cepat: pill datar, bukan kartu berbayang. ---- */
  .quick-actions-strip { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .quick-actions-strip .quick-card { flex: 1; min-width: 180px; }

  /* ---- Workspace secondary panels (team / backup / activity) ---- */

<script>
(function () {
  var splash = document.getElementById('appSplash');
  if (!splash) return;
  var hidden = false;
  var shownAt = Date.now();
  var MIN_VISIBLE_MS = 900; // keeps the intro consistent instead of sometimes flashing instantly
  function doHide() {
    if (hidden) return;
    hidden = true;
    splash.classList.add('app-splash-out');
    setTimeout(function () { if (splash.parentNode) splash.parentNode.removeChild(splash); }, 550);
  }
  window.__hideAppSplash = function () {
    var elapsed = Date.now() - shownAt;
    var remaining = MIN_VISIBLE_MS - elapsed;
    if (remaining > 0) setTimeout(doHide, remaining);
    else doHide();
  };
  // Safety net: never let the splash get stuck if boot logic errors out.
  setTimeout(doHide, 3200);
})();
