<script>
/* ============================================================
   STORAGE ADAPTER
   Uses Claude Artifact persistent storage (window.storage) when
   available; falls back to localStorage for standalone use
   (e.g. this file opened directly outside claude.ai).
   All leads are kept in a single JSON blob per storage best
   practice (data updated together lives in one key).
============================================================ */
const ACQ_STORE_KEY = 'acquisitionLeads';
const ACQ_SETTINGS_KEY = 'trace:acquisition:settings:v4';
const STORE_KEY = ACQ_STORE_KEY;
const SETTINGS_KEY = ACQ_SETTINGS_KEY;
async function getTraceBridge(timeoutMs=3000){
  const until=Date.now()+timeoutMs;
  while(Date.now()<until){
    if(window.parent && window.parent.TRACE_ACQUISITION_BRIDGE) return window.parent.TRACE_ACQUISITION_BRIDGE;
    await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));
  }
  return null;
}
const storageAdapter = {
  async get(key){
    const bridge=await getTraceBridge(800);
    if(bridge && key===ACQ_STORE_KEY){ const v=await bridge.loadLeads(); return JSON.stringify(v||[]); }
    return localStorage.getItem(key);
  },
  async set(key,value){
    const bridge=await getTraceBridge(800);
    if(bridge && key===ACQ_STORE_KEY){ try{return !!(await bridge.saveLeads(JSON.parse(value)));}catch(e){console.error(e);return false;} }
    try{localStorage.setItem(key,value);return true;}catch(e){return false;}
  }
};

let LEADS = []; // in-memory cache, array of lead objects (leads + analysis + outreach merged)
let discoveryStopRequested = false;
let discoveryAbortController = null;
let discoveryJob = null;
function discoveryCheckpointState(extra={}){ return Object.assign({job_id:discoveryJob?.job_id||null,status:discoveryJob?.status||'idle',started_at:discoveryJob?.started_at||null,updated_at:new Date().toISOString(),area:discoveryJob?.area||null,category:discoveryJob?.category||null,source:discoveryJob?.source||null,saved:true},extra); }
function assertDiscoveryActive(){ if(discoveryStopRequested || discoveryAbortController?.signal.aborted){ const e=new Error('DISCOVERY_STOPPED'); e.code='DISCOVERY_STOPPED'; throw e; } }
async function persistDiscoveryCheckpoint(label, extra={}){ await persistLeads(); try{localStorage.setItem('trace:acquisition:last-checkpoint:v1',JSON.stringify(discoveryCheckpointState({label,...extra})));}catch(e){} const bridge=await getTraceBridge(300); if(bridge?.saveDiscoveryCheckpoint && discoveryJob?.job_id){ discoveryJob.sequence_no=(discoveryJob.sequence_no||0)+1; await bridge.saveDiscoveryCheckpoint(discoveryJob.job_id,discoveryJob.sequence_no,extra,{label,...extra}); } return true; }

function uid(){ return 'ld_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10) + Date.now().toString(36); }
function jobUid(){ return (globalThis.crypto?.randomUUID?.() || ('00000000-0000-4000-8000-' + Math.random().toString(16).slice(2,14).padEnd(12,'0'))); }
function escapeHtml(value){ return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, ch => ({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[ch])); }
function escapeAttr(value){ return escapeHtml(value).replace(/`/g,'`'); }

async function loadLeads(){
  const raw = await storageAdapter.get(STORE_KEY);
  LEADS = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  LEADS.forEach(l=>{ if(!('instagram_intelligence' in l)) l.instagram_intelligence=null; if(!Array.isArray(l.manual_evidence)) l.manual_evidence=[]; if(l.analysis) enrichAnalysisEvidence(l,l.analysis); });
}
async function persistLeads(){ const ok=await storageAdapter.set(STORE_KEY,JSON.stringify(LEADS)); if(!ok) throw new Error('TRACE_SAVE_FAILED:'+STORE_KEY); return true; }

const PIPELINE_STAGES = ['new','analyzed','contacted','replied','meeting','proposal','closed'];
const STAGE_LABELS = {new:'New', analyzed:'Analyzed', contacted:'Contacted', replied:'Replied', meeting:'Meeting', proposal:'Proposal', closed:'Won'};
function salesSettings(){
  try{return Object.assign({fu1:2,fu2:5},JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SETTINGS_KEY)||'{}'));}catch(e){return {fu1:2,fu2:5};}
}
function saveSalesSettings(){
  const cfg={fu1:Math.max(1,Number(document.getElementById('fu1-days')?.value||2)),fu2:Math.max(2,Number(document.getElementById('fu2-days')?.value||5))};
  localStorage.setItem(SETTINGS_KEY,JSON.stringify(cfg)); toast('Pengaturan follow-up disimpan');
}
function daysFromNow(days){const d=new Date();d.setDate(d.getDate()+days);return d.toISOString();}
function formatDateTime(v){if(!v)return '—';return new Date(v).toLocaleString('id-ID',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});}
function followupDue(lead){return lead.next_follow_up_at ? new Date(lead.next_follow_up_at) <= new Date() : false;}
function scheduleNextFollowup(lead, stage){
  const cfg=salesSettings();
  if(stage==='contacted') lead.next_follow_up_at=daysFromNow(cfg.fu1);
  else if(stage==='replied') lead.next_follow_up_at=null;
  else if(stage==='meeting') lead.next_follow_up_at=null;
  else if(stage==='proposal') lead.next_follow_up_at=daysFromNow(3);
  else if(stage==='closed'||stage==='not_a_fit') lead.next_follow_up_at=null;
}
function learningMultiplier(lead){
  const stats=LEADS.reduce((a,l)=>{const s=l.status; if(['contacted','replied','meeting','proposal','closed'].includes(s))a.contacted++; if(['replied','meeting','proposal','closed'].includes(s))a.replied++; if(['meeting','proposal','closed'].includes(s))a.meeting++; if(s==='closed')a.won++; return a;},{contacted:0,replied:0,meeting:0,won:0});
  if(!stats.contacted) return 1;
  const base=stats.replied/stats.contacted;
  const localSignals=(lead.analysis?.recommended_sales_angle||'').toLowerCase();
  let bonus=0;
  if(localSignals.includes('profitability') && base>.2) bonus+=.04;
  if((lead.outlet_count||0)>1 && stats.meeting>0) bonus+=.04;
  return Math.min(1.12,1+bonus);
}
function todayTopLeads(){
  return LEADS.filter(l=>l.lead_score!==null && !['closed','not_a_fit'].includes(l.status))
    .map(l=>Object.assign({adjusted_score:Math.round((l.lead_score||0)*learningMultiplier(l))},l))
    .sort((a,b)=>b.adjusted_score-a.adjusted_score).slice(0,10);
}


/* ============================================================
   DATA MODEL HELPERS
============================================================ */
function blankLead(fields){
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  return Object.assign({
    id: uid(),
    business_name: 'Unknown',
    category: 'Unknown',
    city: 'Unknown',
    regency: 'Unknown',
    district: 'Unknown',
    address: 'Unknown',
    latitude: null,
    longitude: null,
    phone: 'Unknown',
    website: 'Unknown',
    instagram: 'Unknown',
    rating: null,
    review_count: null,
    price_range: 'Unknown',
    outlet_count: null,
    opening_hours: 'Unknown',
    external_id: null,       // provider-specific id (e.g. OSM node id) — used for dedup
    social_verified: false,  // true only if instagram/social was found directly in source data
    source: 'manual entry',
    source_url: 'Unknown',
    last_checked: now,
    status: 'new',
    lead_score: null,
    fit_score: null,
    fit_status: 'insufficient_data',
    priority: 'P4',
    acquisition_stage: 'discovery',
    problem_hypotheses: [],
    created_at: now,
    updated_at: now,
    analysis: null,   // lead_analysis object, null until AI analysis run
    instagram_intelligence: null, // automatic public social intelligence; no screenshot required
    outreach: [],
    next_follow_up_at: null,
    notes: '',
    tags: [],
    converted_to_client: false,
    conversion_date: null
  }, fields);
}

const WEIGHTS = {
  business_potential: 20,
  growth_signal: 20,
  operational_complexity: 15,
  marketing_opportunity: 15,
  profitability_opportunity: 15,
  expansion_signal: 10
  // data_quality: 5 (computed separately)
};

function computeDataQuality(lead){
  const fields = ['phone','website','instagram','address','rating','review_count','price_range','outlet_count','category','city'];
  let filled = 0;
  fields.forEach(f=>{
    const v = lead[f];
    if (v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '' && v !== 'Unknown') filled++;
  });
  return Math.round((filled / fields.length) * 100);
}

function evidenceValue(v){
  return v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '' && v !== 'Unknown' && v !== 'Not Found';
}

function buildEvidenceLedger(lead){
  const checks = [
    ['Business identity','business_name',lead.business_name,'Business name'],
    ['Category','category',lead.category,'Business category'],
    ['Location','address',lead.address,'Business address'],
    ['Phone','phone',lead.phone,'Phone/contact'],
    ['Website','website',lead.website,'Website'],
    ['Instagram','instagram',lead.instagram,'Instagram'],
    ['Rating','rating',lead.rating,'Rating'],
    ['Review count','review_count',lead.review_count,'Review count'],
    ['Price range','price_range',lead.price_range,'Price range'],
    ['Outlet count','outlet_count',lead.outlet_count,'Outlet count'],
    ['Source','source',lead.source,'Discovery source']
  ];
  return checks.map(([id,field,value,label])=>({
    id, field, label,
    status:evidenceValue(value)?'Available':'Unavailable',
    value:evidenceValue(value)?value:null,
    source:evidenceValue(value)?(lead.source||'TRACE discovery'):'Not available',
    source_url:evidenceValue(value)?(lead.source_url||null):null,
    captured_at:lead.last_checked||lead.updated_at||null,
    notes:evidenceValue(value)?'Ditemukan pada data lead.':'Data ini tidak tersedia pada sumber yang diperoleh.'
  }));
}

function evidenceCompleteness(lead){
  const ledger=buildEvidenceLedger(lead);
  const usable=ledger.filter(x=>x.status==='Available').length;
  return Math.round((usable/ledger.length)*100);
}

function buildScoreReasons(lead, analysis){
  const r=[];
  const reviews=Number(lead.review_count||0), rating=Number(lead.rating||0), outlets=Number(lead.outlet_count||0);
  if(reviews) r.push(`Review count ${reviews.toLocaleString('id-ID')} menjadi evidence customer proof.`);
  if(rating) r.push(`Rating ${rating} menjadi evidence social proof, bukan evidence profitability.`);
  if(outlets) r.push(`Outlet count ${outlets} menjadi evidence skala/kompleksitas, bukan bukti masalah operasional.`);
  if(evidenceValue(lead.website)) r.push('Website tersedia sebagai sumber konteks digital/offer.');
  if(evidenceValue(lead.instagram)) r.push('Instagram tersedia sebagai sumber presence digital yang dapat diverifikasi.');
  if(!r.length) r.push('Evidence publik masih terbatas; analisis perlu validasi langsung.');
  return r;
}

function enrichAnalysisEvidence(lead, analysis){
  const ledger=buildEvidenceLedger(lead);
  const completeness=evidenceCompleteness(lead);
  const confidence=Math.max(20, Math.min(95, Math.round(35 + completeness*.45 + (lead.analysis?.analysis_mode==='ai'?10:0))));
  analysis.evidence={
    status:completeness>=75?'Sufficient Evidence':completeness>=45?'Partial Evidence':'Insufficient Data',
    completeness,
    items:ledger,
    missing:ledger.filter(x=>x.status==='Unavailable').map(x=>x.label),
    limitations:'Missing data limits scope of conclusion; it does not block analysis based on available evidence.'
  };
  analysis.confidence={score:confidence,reason:`Confidence ${confidence}% ditentukan dari kelengkapan evidence (${completeness}%) dan mode analisis. Confidence tidak berarti fakta terverifikasi.`};
  analysis.score_reasons=buildScoreReasons(lead,analysis);
  return analysis;
}

function manualEvidenceForLead(leadId){
  const lead=LEADS.find(l=>l.id===leadId); if(!lead) return;
  const type=prompt('Data Type (contoh: transaction, conversion, customer, COGS):',''); if(!type) return;
  const value=prompt('Value:',''); if(value===null) return;
  const period=prompt('Period (contoh: Aug 2026):','');
  const source=prompt('Source:','Owner-provided');
  const notes=prompt('Notes:','')||'';
  if(!Array.isArray(lead.manual_evidence)) lead.manual_evidence=[];
  lead.manual_evidence.push({id:uid(),type,value,period,source:source||'Manual / Owner-provided',notes,created_at:new Date().toISOString()});
  lead.updated_at=new Date().toISOString();
  if(lead.analysis) enrichAnalysisEvidence(lead,lead.analysis);
  persistLeads().then(()=>{renderDetail(lead);toast('Manual evidence tersimpan.');});
}

function computeOverallScore(lead){
  if (!lead.analysis) return null;
  const a = lead.analysis;
  let sum = 0;
  for (const k in WEIGHTS){
    const v = typeof a[k] === 'number' ? a[k] : 0;
    sum += (v/100) * WEIGHTS[k];
  }
  const dq = computeDataQuality(lead);
  sum += (dq/100) * 5;
  const score=Math.round(sum);
  const fitStatus = score >= 75 ? 'high' : score >= 50 ? 'medium' : score > 0 ? 'low' : 'insufficient_data';
  lead.fit_score=score;
  lead.fit_status=fitStatus;
  lead.priority=fitStatus==='high'?'P1':fitStatus==='medium'?'P2':fitStatus==='low'?'P3':'P4';
  lead.acquisition_stage='prioritized';
  lead.problem_hypotheses=Array.isArray(a.likely_pain_points) ? a.likely_pain_points.map(x=>({text:x.text,is_hypothesis:x.is_hypothesis!==false,status:'hypothesis'})) : [];
  a.score_breakdown={...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(WEIGHTS).map(([k,w])=>[k,{value:typeof a[k]==='number'?a[k]:0,weight:w,contribution:Math.round(((typeof a[k]==='number'?a[k]:0)/100)*w*100)/100}])),data_quality:{value:dq,weight:5,contribution:Math.round((dq/100)*5*100)/100},total:score};
  return score;
}

function potentialLevel(score){
  if (score === null || score === undefined) return {label:'Not Analyzed', cls:'score-none'};
  if (score >= 75) return {label:'High', cls:'score-high'};
  if (score >= 50) return {label:'Medium', cls:'score-mid'};
  return {label:'Low', cls:'score-low'};
}

function freshness(lastChecked){
  if (!lastChecked) return {icon:'🔴', label:'Stale'};
  const days = (Date.now() - new Date(lastChecked).getTime()) / 86400000;
  if (days <= 7) return {icon:'🟢', label:'Fresh'};
  if (days <= 30) return {icon:'🟡', label:'Aging'};
  return {icon:'🔴', label:'Stale'};
}

function fmt(v){
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '' || v === 'Unknown') return '<span class="unknown">Unknown</span>';

}

function mapOSMCategory(tags){
  const amenity=tags.amenity, shop=tags.shop, cuisine=(tags.cuisine||'').toLowerCase();
  if(shop==='bakery') return 'Bakery';
  if(shop==='pastry' || cuisine.includes('dessert') || cuisine.includes('ice_cream')) return 'Dessert';
  if(amenity==='cafe') return 'Café';
  if(amenity==='fast_food') return 'Casual Dining';
  if(amenity==='restaurant') return 'Restaurant';
  return 'F&B';
}
function escapeOverpassRegex(s){
  return String(s).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
}
// Exact ["name"="X"] match is fragile: OSM contributors are not fully
// consistent about including the "Kota"/"Kabupaten" prefix in the `name`
// tag for Indonesian administrative boundaries (some map it as "Kota Bogor",
// others just "Bogor", with the prefix only in name:id or official_name).
// A single wrong/missing prefix silently returns an EMPTY area — no error,
// just "0 data ditemukan" for that whole batch. To avoid depending on us
// guessing the exact tagging for every area, match on the name OR the same
// name with an optional Kota/Kabupaten prefix stripped/added, across both
// `name` and `name:id`.
function areaNameVariants(name){
  const bare = name.replace(/^(Kota|Kabupaten|Daerah Khusus Ibukota)\s+/i,'').trim();
  const variants = new Set([name, bare]);
  if(/^Jakarta/i.test(bare)) variants.add('DKI Jakarta');
  return [...variants].map(escapeOverpassRegex);
}
function buildOverpassQueryForNames(areaNames, categoryKey){
  const tagFilters=OSM_CATEGORY_TAGS[categoryKey]||OSM_CATEGORY_TAGS.all;
  const areaClauses=areaNames.map((name,i)=>{
    const pattern = '^(' + areaNameVariants(name).join('|') + ')$';
    return `area["boundary"="administrative"]["name"~"${pattern}"]->.a${i};\n`+
           `area["boundary"="administrative"]["name:id"~"${pattern}"]->.b${i};`;
  }).join('\n');
  const nwr=[];
  areaNames.forEach((_,i)=>tagFilters.forEach(tag=>{
    const [k,v]=tag.split('=');
    nwr.push(`nwr["${k}"="${v}"](area.a${i});`);
    nwr.push(`nwr["${k}"="${v}"](area.b${i});`);
  }));
  return `[out:json][timeout:45];\n${areaClauses}\n(\n${nwr.join('\n')}\n);\nout center tags;`;
}
function buildOverpassQuery(areaKey, categoryKey){ return buildOverpassQueryForNames(OSM_AREAS[areaKey]||OSM_AREAS.both,categoryKey); }
function regionLabel(areaKey){
  return ({jabodetabek:'Jabodetabek',bandung:'Bandung Raya',jabodetabek_bandung:'Jabodetabek + Bandung',both:'Bogor Kota + Kabupaten Bogor',kota:'Kota Bogor',kabupaten:'Kabupaten Bogor'})[areaKey]||areaKey;
}

const OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS = [
  'https://maps.mail.ru/osm/tools/overpass/api/interpreter',
  'https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter',
  'https://lz4.overpass-api.de/api/interpreter',

async function postOverpass(query, signal){
  let lastError = null;
  for (const endpoint of OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS){
    try{
      const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'},
        body: 'data=' + encodeURIComponent(query),
        signal: signal || discoveryAbortController?.signal
      });
      if (!res.ok){
        const text = await res.text().catch(()=> '');
        lastError = new Error(`Overpass (${endpoint}) HTTP ${res.status}${text ? ': '+text.slice(0,180) : ''}`);
        continue;
      }
      const data = await res.json().catch(()=>null);
      if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.elements)){
        lastError = new Error(`Overpass (${endpoint}) mengembalikan response tidak valid`);
        continue;
      }
      return data.elements;
    }catch(err){
      if(err?.name==='AbortError' || discoveryAbortController?.signal.aborted) throw err;
      lastError = err;
      continue;
    }
  }
  throw lastError || new Error('Semua server Overpass publik gagal dihubungi. Coba lagi beberapa saat.');
}
async function saveOSMBatchIncrementally(elements, areaKey, onProgress){

  if(!normalized.length) return;
  let savedNew = 0, savedUpdated = 0;
  const seenInThisBatch = new Set();
  for(const rec of normalized){
    const normKey = normOSM(rec.business_name, rec.address);
    if((rec.external_id && seenInThisBatch.has(rec.external_id)) || seenInThisBatch.has(normKey)) continue;
    if(rec.external_id) seenInThisBatch.add(rec.external_id);
    seenInThisBatch.add(normKey);

    const existing = LEADS.find(l => (rec.external_id && l.external_id===rec.external_id) || normOSM(l.business_name,l.address)===normKey);
    if(existing){
      const mergeFields=['business_name','category','city','regency','district','address','latitude','longitude','phone','website','instagram','rating','review_count','price_range','outlet_count','opening_hours','external_id','source','source_url','social_verified'];
      mergeFields.forEach(f=>{const v=rec[f]; if(v!==undefined && v!==null && v!=='' && v!=='Unknown' && v!=='Not Found') existing[f]=v;});
      existing.last_checked=new Date().toISOString(); existing.updated_at=new Date().toISOString();
      savedUpdated++;
      continue;
    }
    const newLead = blankLead(rec);
    LEADS.push(newLead);
    savedNew++;
  }
  await persistLeads();
  // Skor cepat untuk lead baru di batch ini supaya kalaupun proses terhenti
  // di tengah jalan, lead yang sudah tersimpan sudah punya skor.
  // FIX (Stop tidak responsif + simpan berulang): loop ini sebelumnya
  // memanggil persistLeads() (upload SELURUH database) untuk SETIAP lead di
  // batch OSM ini (bisa ratusan sekaligus), dan sama sekali tidak mengecek
  // tombol Stop — makanya klik Stop kelihatan macet lama di tahap
  // "Batch 1: X data ditemukan" ini. Sekarang: skip persist per-lead
  // (checkpoint tiap 25 + 1x di akhir), dan cek discoveryStopRequested
  // tiap lead supaya Stop langsung kerasa responnya di tahap ini juga.
  const justAdded = LEADS.slice(-savedNew).filter(l=>!l.analysis);
  const SAVE_BATCH_SIZE = 25;
  let analyzedInBatch = 0;
  for(const lead of justAdded){
    if (typeof discoveryStopRequested !== 'undefined' && discoveryStopRequested) break;
    try{
      await runAIAnalysis(lead.id, {skipPersist:true});
      analyzedInBatch++;
      if (analyzedInBatch % SAVE_BATCH_SIZE === 0) await persistLeads();
    }catch(e){ /* skor bisa menyusul nanti, data mentahnya sudah aman */ }
  }
  await persistLeads();
  if(savedNew || savedUpdated){
    onProgress&&onProgress(`💾 Tersimpan otomatis: ${savedNew} lead baru, ${savedUpdated} diperbarui — aman walau proses terhenti.`);
  }
}

async function fetchOSM(areaKey,categoryKey,onProgress,forceRefresh){
  const allNames=OSM_AREAS[areaKey]||OSM_AREAS.both;
  const batches=OSM_BATCHES[areaKey]||[allNames];
  onProgress&&onProgress(`Mencari OpenStreetMap — ${regionLabel(areaKey)} (${allNames.length} wilayah; ${batches.length} batch)...`);
  const all=[]; let failed=0; let fromCache=0; let staleFallback=0;
  for(let i=0;i<batches.length;i++){
    assertDiscoveryActive();
    if (typeof discoveryStopRequested !== 'undefined' && discoveryStopRequested){
      onProgress&&onProgress(`Dihentikan oleh user sebelum batch ${i+1}/${batches.length}.`);
      break;
    }
    const names=batches[i];
    const cached = forceRefresh ? null : readOverpassCache(names, categoryKey);
    const cacheIsFresh = cached && (Date.now() - cached.cachedAt) < OVERPASS_CACHE_TTL_MS;

    if(cacheIsFresh){
      const ageMin = Math.round((Date.now()-cached.cachedAt)/60000);
      onProgress&&onProgress(`Batch ${i+1}/${batches.length}: ${names.join(', ')} — pakai cache (${cached.elements.length} data, umur ${ageMin} menit).`);
      cached.elements.forEach(el=>{el._trace_scope=areaKey;});
      all.push(...cached.elements);
      fromCache++;
      await saveOSMBatchIncrementally(cached.elements, areaKey, onProgress);
      continue;
    }

    try{
      onProgress&&onProgress(`OSM batch ${i+1}/${batches.length}: ${names.join(', ')}...`);
      const els=await postOverpass(buildOverpassQueryForNames(names,categoryKey),discoveryAbortController?.signal);
      writeOverpassCache(names, categoryKey, els);
      els.forEach(el=>{el._trace_scope=areaKey;});
      all.push(...els);
      onProgress&&onProgress(`Batch ${i+1}: ${els.length} data ditemukan.${els.length===0?' (0 hasil bisa berarti nama wilayah OSM tidak cocok, atau memang OSM belum banyak memetakan F&B di area ini — bukan error koneksi.)':''}`);
      await saveOSMBatchIncrementally(els, areaKey, onProgress);
    }catch(err){
      if(err?.name==='AbortError' || discoveryAbortController?.signal.aborted) throw err;
      // Live fetch gagal — coba pakai cache lama (walau sudah lewat TTL) daripada
      // langsung kehilangan seluruh batch ini. Lebih baik data agak basi
      // daripada tidak ada data sama sekali.
      if(cached && cached.elements.length){
        const ageHr = Math.round((Date.now()-cached.cachedAt)/3600000);
        onProgress&&onProgress(`Batch ${i+1} gagal (${err.message}) — memakai cache lama (±${ageHr} jam) sebagai fallback.`);
        cached.elements.forEach(el=>{el._trace_scope=areaKey;});
        all.push(...cached.elements);
        staleFallback++;
        await saveOSMBatchIncrementally(cached.elements, areaKey, onProgress);
      } else {
        failed++;
        onProgress&&onProgress(`Batch ${i+1} gagal: ${err.message}`);
      }
    }
  }
  if(!all.length) throw new Error(`Discovery ${regionLabel(areaKey)} gagal: semua batch Overpass gagal dan tidak ada cache tersedia. Jika memakai file://, jalankan OPEN_TRACE.command atau gunakan deployment Netlify.`);
  if(failed) onProgress&&onProgress(`${failed} batch gagal total, tetapi ${all.length} data berhasil dikumpulkan dari batch lain.`);
  if(fromCache) onProgress&&onProgress(`${fromCache} batch diambil dari cache (hemat waktu & tidak membebani Overpass).`);
  if(staleFallback) onProgress&&onProgress(`${staleFallback} batch memakai cache lama karena live fetch gagal — data mungkin tidak 100% terbaru.`);
  onProgress&&onProgress(`${regionLabel(areaKey)}: ${all.length} raw records sebelum deduplication.`);
  return all;
}

function normOSM(businessName, address){
  return (businessName||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,' ') + '|' + (address||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,' ');
}

function normalizeOSMElement(el){
  const tags = el.tags || {};
  if (!tags.name) return null; // require a name — never fabricate one

  const addrParts = [tags['addr:street'], tags['addr:housenumber'], tags['addr:suburb']].filter(Boolean);
  const address = addrParts.length ? addrParts.join(' ') : 'Unknown';
  const district = tags['addr:suburb'] || tags['addr:district'] || 'Unknown';
  const scope = el._trace_scope;
  const rawCity = tags['addr:city'] || tags['addr:town'] || tags['addr:municipality'] || '';
  const text = `${rawCity} ${tags['addr:county']||''} ${tags['addr:state']||''}`.toLowerCase();
  const regionNames = ['Jakarta','Depok','Bogor','Bekasi','Tangerang','Bandung','Cimahi'];
  const city = rawCity || (scope==='kota' ? 'Kota Bogor' : 'Unknown');
  let regency = tags['addr:county'] || 'Unknown';
  if (/kabupaten bogor/.test(text)) regency='Kabupaten Bogor';
  else if (/kabupaten bekasi/.test(text)) regency='Kabupaten Bekasi';
  else if (/kabupaten tangerang/.test(text)) regency='Kabupaten Tangerang';
  else if (/kabupaten bandung barat/.test(text)) regency='Kabupaten Bandung Barat';
  else if (/kabupaten bandung/.test(text)) regency='Kabupaten Bandung';
  else if (scope==='kabupaten') regency=city;
  const lat = el.lat ?? (el.center ? el.center.lat : null);
  const lon = el.lon ?? (el.center ? el.center.lon : null);
  const instagram = tags['contact:instagram'] || tags['instagram'] || null;
  const website = tags['contact:website'] || tags['website'] || 'Unknown';
  const phone = tags['contact:phone'] || tags['phone'] || 'Unknown';

  return {
    external_id: 'osm:' + el.type + '/' + el.id,
    business_name: tags.name,
    category: mapOSMCategory(tags),
    address, city, regency, district,
    latitude: lat, longitude: lon,
    phone, website,
    instagram: instagram || 'Not Found',
    social_verified: !!instagram,
    rating: null,          // OSM does not provide ratings
    review_count: null,    // OSM does not provide review counts
    price_range: 'Unknown',
    outlet_count: null,
    opening_hours: tags.opening_hours || 'Unknown',
    source: 'OpenStreetMap (Overpass API)',
    source_url: `https://www.openstreetmap.org/${el.type}/${el.id}`,
    last_checked: new Date().toISOString()
  };
}

  if(areaKey==='jabodetabek') return GOOGLE_CENTERS.filter(c=>c.region==='jabodetabek');
  if(areaKey==='bandung') return GOOGLE_CENTERS.filter(c=>c.region==='bandung');
  if(areaKey==='jabodetabek_bandung') return GOOGLE_CENTERS;

}

function mapGoogleCategory(types, primaryType){
  const t = [...(types||[]), primaryType||''].join(' ').toLowerCase();
  if(t.includes('bakery')) return 'Bakery';
  if(t.includes('ice_cream') || t.includes('dessert')) return 'Dessert';
  if(t.includes('cafe') || t.includes('coffee')) return 'Café';
  if(t.includes('restaurant')) return 'Restaurant';
  return 'F&B';
}

function detectCityFromAddress(address){
  const a=(address||'').toLowerCase();
  const pairs=[['kota bogor','Kota Bogor'],['kota depok','Kota Depok'],['kota bekasi','Kota Bekasi'],['kota tangerang selatan','Kota Tangerang Selatan'],['kota tangerang','Kota Tangerang'],['kota bandung','Kota Bandung'],['kota cimahi','Kota Cimahi'],['jakarta pusat','DKI Jakarta'],['jakarta selatan','DKI Jakarta'],['jakarta barat','DKI Jakarta'],['jakarta timur','DKI Jakarta'],['jakarta utara','DKI Jakarta']];
  const hit=pairs.find(([k])=>a.includes(k)); return hit?hit[1]:'Unknown';
}
function detectRegencyFromAddress(address){

  const pairs=[['kabupaten bogor','Kabupaten Bogor'],['kabupaten bekasi','Kabupaten Bekasi'],['kabupaten tangerang','Kabupaten Tangerang'],['kabupaten bandung barat','Kabupaten Bandung Barat'],['kabupaten bandung','Kabupaten Bandung']];

async function fetchGoogleProxy(areaKey, categoryKey, onProgress, signal){
  const proxy=getGoogleProxyUrl();
  if(!proxy) throw new Error('Google Places proxy URL belum diisi.');
  const terms=GOOGLE_QUERY_TERMS[categoryKey]||GOOGLE_QUERY_TERMS.all;
  const centers=googleCentersFor(areaKey);
  onProgress && onProgress(`Google Places: ${centers.length} coverage points × ${terms.length} queries...`);
  const res=await acqFetch(proxy,{
    method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
    body:JSON.stringify({area:areaKey,category:categoryKey,queries:terms,centers}), signal:signal||discoveryAbortController?.signal
  });
  const text=await res.text();
  let data; try{data=JSON.parse(text);}catch(e){throw new Error('Google proxy returned non-JSON: '+text.slice(0,180));}
  if(!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error||('Google proxy error '+res.status));
  const places=Array.isArray(data.places)?data.places:[];
  onProgress && onProgress(`Google Places returned ${places.length} raw places.`);
  return places.map(normalizeGooglePlace).filter(Boolean);
}

function geoDistanceKm(a,b){
  if(a.latitude==null||a.longitude==null||b.latitude==null||b.longitude==null) return 999;
  const R=6371, dLat=(b.latitude-a.latitude)*Math.PI/180, dLon=(b.longitude-a.longitude)*Math.PI/180;
  const x=Math.sin(dLat/2)**2 + Math.cos(a.latitude*Math.PI/180)*Math.cos(b.latitude*Math.PI/180)*Math.sin(dLon/2)**2;
  return 2*R*Math.asin(Math.sqrt(x));
}
function normName(v){return (v||'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\u00c0-\u024f]+/gi,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();}
function normPhone(v){return String(v||'').replace(/\D/g,'').replace(/^62/,'0');}
function normInstagram(v){return String(v||'').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^@/,'').replace(/\/$/,'').replace(/^https?:\/\/(www\.)?instagram\.com\//,'');}
function normWebsite(v){try{return new URL(v).hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./,'');}catch(e){return '';}}
function recordsLikelySame(a,b){
  if(a.external_id && b.external_id && a.external_id===b.external_id) return true;
  const ap=normPhone(a.phone), bp=normPhone(b.phone);
  if(ap && bp && ap.length>=8 && ap===bp) return true;
  const ai=normInstagram(a.instagram), bi=normInstagram(b.instagram);
  if(ai && bi && ai!=='unknown' && ai!=='not found' && ai===bi) return true;
  const aw=normWebsite(a.website), bw=normWebsite(b.website);
  if(aw && bw && aw===bw) return true;
  return normName(a.business_name)===normName(b.business_name) && geoDistanceKm(a,b)<0.35;
}
function mergeBusinessRecords(records){
  const out=[];
  for(const rec of records){
    let hit=out.find(x => recordsLikelySame(x,rec));
    if(!hit){ out.push({...rec}); continue; }
    const prefer=(a,b)=> (b!==null && b!==undefined && b!=='' && b!=='Unknown' && b!=='Not Found') ? b : a;
    hit.business_name=prefer(hit.business_name,rec.business_name);
    hit.address=prefer(hit.address,rec.address); hit.phone=prefer(hit.phone,rec.phone); hit.website=prefer(hit.website,rec.website);
    hit.instagram=prefer(hit.instagram,rec.instagram); hit.social_verified=hit.social_verified||rec.social_verified;
    hit.rating=prefer(hit.rating,rec.rating); hit.review_count=prefer(hit.review_count,rec.review_count); hit.price_range=prefer(hit.price_range,rec.price_range);
    hit.opening_hours=prefer(hit.opening_hours,rec.opening_hours); hit.latitude=hit.latitude??rec.latitude; hit.longitude=hit.longitude??rec.longitude;
    hit.city=prefer(hit.city,rec.city); hit.regency=prefer(hit.regency,rec.regency); hit.district=prefer(hit.district,rec.district);
    hit.source = hit.source===rec.source ? hit.source : `${hit.source} + ${rec.source}`;
    hit.source_url=prefer(hit.source_url,rec.source_url);
    hit.source_ids=Object.assign({},hit.source_ids||{},rec.source_ids||{});
    hit.last_checked=new Date().toISOString();
  }
  return out;
}


async function enrichInstagramFromWebsites(records, onProgress, signal){
  const candidates=records.filter(r=>r.website && /^https?:\/\//i.test(r.website) && (!r.instagram || r.instagram==='Not Found')).slice(0,40);
  if(!candidates.length) return records;
  const endpoint = ['localhost','127.0.0.1'].includes(location.hostname) ? '/api/social-enrich' : '/api/acq-social-enrich';
  try{
    onProgress && onProgress(`Mencari Instagram dari website bisnis (${candidates.length} kandidat)...`);
    const res=await acqFetch(endpoint,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({websites:candidates.map(r=>({external_id:r.external_id,website:r.website}))}),signal:signal||discoveryAbortController?.signal});
    const data=await res.json().catch(()=>({}));
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error||('Social enrichment HTTP '+res.status));
    const byId=new Map((data.results||[]).map(x=>[x.external_id,x]));
    records.forEach(r=>{ const x=byId.get(r.external_id); if(x?.instagram){ r.instagram=x.instagram; r.social_verified=true; r.instagram_status='verified'; } else if(r.instagram==='Not Found'){ r.instagram_status='not_found'; } });
    onProgress && onProgress(`Instagram terverifikasi dari website: ${(data.results||[]).filter(x=>x.instagram).length}.`);
  }catch(e){ onProgress && onProgress('Social enrichment dilewati: '+e.message); }
  return records;
}

const DISCOVERY_PROVIDERS = {
  osm: {
    label: 'OpenStreetMap (Overpass API)',
    async run(areaKey, categoryKey, onProgress, forceRefresh){
      assertDiscoveryActive();
      const elements=await fetchOSM(areaKey,categoryKey,onProgress,forceRefresh);
      onProgress && onProgress(`Found ${elements.length} raw OSM records. Normalizing...`);
      return elements.map(normalizeOSMElement).filter(Boolean);
    }
  },
  google_places: {
    label: 'Google Places API (secure proxy)',
    async run(areaKey,categoryKey,onProgress){ assertDiscoveryActive(); return fetchGoogleProxy(areaKey,categoryKey,onProgress,discoveryAbortController?.signal); }
  },
  hybrid: {
    label: 'Hybrid — OSM + Google Places',
    async run(areaKey,categoryKey,onProgress,forceRefresh){
      const osm=await DISCOVERY_PROVIDERS.osm.run(areaKey,categoryKey,onProgress,forceRefresh);
      let google=[];
      const proxy=getGoogleProxyUrl();
      if(proxy){
        try{ google=await DISCOVERY_PROVIDERS.google_places.run(areaKey,categoryKey,onProgress); }
        catch(e){ onProgress && onProgress(`Google Places skipped: ${e.message}`); }
      } else {
        onProgress && onProgress('Google Places not configured — continuing with OSM only.');
      }
      onProgress && onProgress(`Merging ${osm.length} OSM + ${google.length} Google records...`);
      return mergeBusinessRecords([...osm,...google]);
    }
  }
};

async function runDiscovery(){
  const areaKey = document.getElementById('disc-area').value;
  const categoryKey = document.getElementById('disc-category').value;
  const sourceKey = document.getElementById('disc-source').value;
  const forceRefresh = !!document.getElementById('disc-force-refresh')?.checked;
  const provider = DISCOVERY_PROVIDERS[sourceKey];
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-start-discovery');
  const stopBtn = document.getElementById('btn-stop-discovery');
  const progressBlock = document.getElementById('disc-progress-block');
  const progressList = document.getElementById('disc-progress-list');
  const resultBlock = document.getElementById('disc-result-block');
  // FIX (tidak ada opsi berhenti): dulu sekali Discovery jalan, satu-satunya
  // cara berhenti adalah menutup tab (berisiko kehilangan progress). Flag ini
  // dicek di setiap iterasi loop scoring (bagian yang paling lama, karena
  // satu panggilan AI per lead) — kalau user klik Stop, loop berhenti rapi
  // di lead berikutnya dan progress yang sudah ke-score tetap disimpan.
  if (discoveryJob && ['running','stopping'].includes(discoveryJob.status)) { toast('Discovery masih berjalan. Hentikan proses aktif terlebih dahulu.'); return; }
  discoveryStopRequested = false;
  discoveryAbortController = new AbortController();
  discoveryJob = {job_id:jobUid(),status:'running',started_at:new Date().toISOString(),area:areaKey,category:categoryKey,source:sourceKey,sequence_no:0};
  const discoveryBridge=await getTraceBridge(800);
  if(discoveryBridge?.saveDiscoveryJob) await discoveryBridge.saveDiscoveryJob(discoveryJob);
  if (stopBtn){ stopBtn.style.display='block'; stopBtn.onclick=()=>{ if(discoveryStopRequested)return; discoveryStopRequested=true; if(discoveryJob)discoveryJob.status='stopping'; discoveryAbortController?.abort(); stopBtn.disabled=true; stopBtn.textContent='Menghentikan...'; }; stopBtn.disabled=false; stopBtn.textContent='⏹ Stop Discovery'; }

  if (!provider){
    if(discoveryJob){discoveryJob.status='FAILED'; await discoveryBridge?.updateDiscoveryJob?.(discoveryJob.job_id,'FAILED',{}, {reason:'provider_unconfigured'});}
    discoveryAbortController=null; discoveryStopRequested=false;
    toast('Sumber data ini belum dikonfigurasi');
    return;
  }
  if(location.protocol==='file:'){
    progressBlock.style.display='block';
    progressList.innerHTML='<div>› Mode file:// tidak dapat memanggil server discovery.</div><div>› Jalankan OPEN_TRACE_CONSULTANT.command untuk tes lokal, atau deploy ke Netlify.</div>';
    if(discoveryJob){discoveryJob.status='FAILED'; await discoveryBridge?.updateDiscoveryJob?.(discoveryJob.job_id,'FAILED',{}, {reason:'file_protocol'});}
    discoveryAbortController=null; discoveryStopRequested=false;
    toast('Jalankan OPEN_TRACE_CONSULTANT.command sebelum discovery lokal.');
    return;
  }

  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.innerHTML = '<span class="spinner"></span>Running Discovery...';
  progressBlock.style.display = 'block';
  resultBlock.style.display = 'none';
  progressList.innerHTML = '';
  const logStep = (msg) => { progressList.innerHTML += `<div>› ${escapeHtml(msg)}</div>`; progressList.scrollTop = progressList.scrollHeight; };

  try{
    logStep('Discovery started — area: ' + areaKey + ', category: ' + categoryKey);
    let normalized = await provider.run(areaKey, categoryKey, logStep, forceRefresh);
    assertDiscoveryActive();
    normalized = mergeBusinessRecords(normalized);
    try{localStorage.setItem('trace:acquisition:last-checkpoint:v1',JSON.stringify(discoveryCheckpointState({label:'discovery_raw_collected',raw_count:normalized.length,saved:false})));}catch(e){}
    normalized = await enrichInstagramFromWebsites(normalized,logStep,discoveryAbortController?.signal);
    assertDiscoveryActive();

    // DEDUPLICATE — external id, phone, Instagram, website, then name+distance.
    logStep(`Deduplicating ${normalized.length} normalized records...`);
    let newCount = 0, existingCount = 0, updatedCount = 0, duplicatesInBatch = 0;
    const batchRecords = [];
    const toInsert = [];
    const toUpdate = [];

    normalized.forEach(rec=>{
      if(batchRecords.some(x=>recordsLikelySame(x,rec))){ duplicatesInBatch++; return; }
      batchRecords.push(rec);

      const existing = LEADS.find(l => recordsLikelySame(l,rec));
      if (existing){
        existingCount++;
        const before=JSON.stringify(existing);
        const mergeFields=['business_name','category','city','regency','district','address','latitude','longitude','phone','website','instagram','rating','review_count','price_range','outlet_count','opening_hours','external_id','source','source_url','social_verified'];
        mergeFields.forEach(f=>{const v=rec[f]; if(v!==undefined && v!==null && v!=='' && v!=='Unknown' && v!=='Not Found') existing[f]=v;});
        existing.last_checked=new Date().toISOString(); existing.updated_at=new Date().toISOString();
        if(JSON.stringify(existing)!==before) updatedCount++;
        toUpdate.push(existing);
        return;
      }
      newCount++; toInsert.push(rec);
    });

    // SAVE NEW + REFRESH EXISTING RECORDS
    logStep(`Saving ${toInsert.length} new + refreshing ${toUpdate.length} existing businesses...`);
    const insertedLeads = toInsert.map(rec => blankLead(rec));
    LEADS.push(...insertedLeads);
    await persistDiscoveryCheckpoint('leads_raw_persisted',{new_count:newCount,existing_count:existingCount,updated_count:updatedCount});

    // ENRICH — already merged into normalize() since contact:* tags are the
    // enrichment data available directly from the source; nothing further
    // is fabricated or guessed here.
    logStep('Enrichment complete (contact/instagram/website taken directly from source tags where present).');

    // SCORE
    logStep(`Analyzing ${insertedLeads.length} new leads...`);
    let scored = 0, scoreFailed = 0, stoppedEarly = false;
    // FIX: nyimpen ke Supabase tiap 25 lead (bukan tiap 1 lead) — lihat
    // catatan di runAIAnalysis(). Tetap ada progress save berkala supaya
    // kalau tab tertutup/koneksi putus di tengah jalan, paling banyak
    // cuma kehilangan hasil scoring 25 lead terakhir, bukan mulai dari nol.
    const SAVE_BATCH_SIZE = 25;
    for (const lead of insertedLeads){
      if (discoveryStopRequested || discoveryAbortController?.signal.aborted){ stoppedEarly = true; logStep(`Dihentikan oleh user setelah ${scored}/${insertedLeads.length} lead dianalisis.`); break; }
      try{
        await runAIAnalysis(lead.id, {skipPersist:true});
        scored++;
        if (scored % SAVE_BATCH_SIZE === 0) await persistLeads();
        logStep(`Scored ${scored}/${insertedLeads.length}: ${lead.business_name} → ${lead.lead_score}`);
      }catch(e){
        scoreFailed++;
        console.error('Scoring failed for', lead.business_name, e);
      }
    }
    // Simpan sisa lead yang belum sempat ke-cover oleh checkpoint per-25 di atas
    // (termasuk kalau dihentikan lebih awal oleh user).
    await persistDiscoveryCheckpoint('scoring_checkpoint',{scored,score_failed:scoreFailed,stopped:stoppedEarly});

    const refreshedToAnalyze = stoppedEarly ? [] : toUpdate.filter(l=>l.analysis && l.last_checked && (Date.now()-new Date(l.analysis.analyzed_at||0).getTime()>0)).slice(0,150);
    if(refreshedToAnalyze.length){
      logStep(`Re-scoring ${refreshedToAnalyze.length} refreshed leads...`);
      for(const lead of refreshedToAnalyze){
        if (discoveryStopRequested || discoveryAbortController?.signal.aborted){ stoppedEarly = true; break; }
        await runAIAnalysis(lead.id, {skipPersist:true});
      }
      await persistDiscoveryCheckpoint('rescore_checkpoint',{rescore_count:refreshedToAnalyze.length});
    }

    const needsVerification = [...insertedLeads,...toUpdate].filter(l =>
      l.phone === 'Unknown' || l.website === 'Unknown' || l.instagram === 'Not Found' || l.rating === null
    ).length;

    if(normalized.length===0){ throw new Error('Tidak ada bisnis ditemukan dari sumber aktif. Coba ulang beberapa saat lagi atau aktifkan Google Places di Settings.'); }
    if(discoveryJob){discoveryJob.status=stoppedEarly?'STOPPED':'COMPLETED'; await discoveryBridge?.updateDiscoveryJob?.(discoveryJob.job_id,discoveryJob.status,{scored,score_failed:scoreFailed,new_count:newCount,updated_count:updatedCount});}
    logStep(stoppedEarly ? 'Discovery dihentikan oleh user (sebagian data sudah tersimpan).' : 'Discovery complete.');
    const hero=document.getElementById('hero-status'); if(hero) hero.textContent=(stoppedEarly?'Dihentikan':'Update selesai')+` · ${newCount} lead baru · ${scored} dianalisis · ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('id-ID',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}`;

    document.getElementById('disc-result-stats').innerHTML = [
      ['Businesses Found', normalized.length],
      ['New Businesses', newCount],
      ['Existing Businesses', existingCount],
      ['Updated Records', updatedCount],
      ['Duplicates Removed', duplicatesInBatch],
      ['Needs Verification', needsVerification]
    ].map(s=>`<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">${s[1]}</div><div class="stat-label">${s[0]}</div></div>`).join('');
    resultBlock.style.display = 'block';

    toast(stoppedEarly ? `Discovery dihentikan — ${scored} lead sudah dianalisis & tersimpan.` : `Discovery selesai: ${newCount} baru · ${updatedCount} diperbarui · ${scoreFailed>0?scoreFailed+' gagal analisis':scored+' dianalisis'}`);
    renderDashboard(); renderLeadsTable();
  }catch(e){
    console.error(e);
    const stopped=e?.code==='DISCOVERY_STOPPED'||e?.name==='AbortError'||discoveryStopRequested;
    if(stopped){ try{await persistDiscoveryCheckpoint('stopped_checkpoint',{stopped:true});}catch(saveErr){console.error('stopped checkpoint failed',saveErr);} if(discoveryJob){discoveryJob.status='STOPPED'; await discoveryBridge?.updateDiscoveryJob?.(discoveryJob.job_id,'STOPPED',{scored:0},{reason:'user_stopped'});} logStep('Discovery dihentikan. Checkpoint terakhir dipertahankan; tidak ada penghapusan data otomatis.'); toast('Discovery dihentikan — checkpoint terakhir tetap tersimpan.'); }
    else { if(discoveryJob){discoveryJob.status='FAILED'; await discoveryBridge?.updateDiscoveryJob?.(discoveryJob.job_id,'FAILED',{},{message:e?.message||String(e)});} logStep('ERROR: '+e.message); toast('Discovery belum berhasil. Data yang sudah ter-checkpoint tidak dihapus.'); }
  }finally{
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.innerHTML = '🔎 START DISCOVERY';
    if (stopBtn) stopBtn.style.display='none';
    discoveryAbortController=null;
    discoveryStopRequested=false;
  }
}

const EXCLUDE_KEYWORDS_KEY = 'trace:acquisition:exclude_keywords:v1';
function getExcludeKeywords(){
  try{ return localStorage.getItem(EXCLUDE_KEYWORDS_KEY) || ''; }catch(e){ return ''; }
}
function onExcludeKeywordsChange(){
  const el = document.getElementById('filter-exclude-keywords');
  try{ localStorage.setItem(EXCLUDE_KEYWORDS_KEY, el.value); }catch(e){}
  renderLeadsTable();
}
function renderLeadsTable(){
  const search = document.getElementById('filter-search').value.toLowerCase();
  const city = document.getElementById('filter-city').value;
  const status = document.getElementById('filter-status').value;
  const category = document.getElementById('filter-category')?.value || '';
  const sortMode = document.getElementById('sort-leads')?.value || 'score_desc';
  // FIX: field kata kunci dipulihkan dari localStorage sekali saat elemen
  // masih kosong, supaya pilihan user (mis. "KFC, Warteg") tidak hilang tiap
  // pindah tab. Ini murni preferensi tampilan filter, bukan mengubah data.
  const excludeInput = document.getElementById('filter-exclude-keywords');
  if (excludeInput && !excludeInput.value && !excludeInput.dataset.touched){
    excludeInput.value = getExcludeKeywords();
    excludeInput.dataset.touched = '1';
  }
  const excludeKeywords = (excludeInput?.value || '').split(',').map(s=>s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);

  let rows = LEADS.filter(l=>{
    if (search && !l.business_name.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return false;
    if (city && l.city !== city) return false;
    if (status && l.status !== status) return false;
    if (category && l.category !== category) return false;
    if (excludeKeywords.length && excludeKeywords.some(k=>l.business_name.toLowerCase().includes(k))) return false;
    return true;
  });

  // FIX (tidak ada sortir sama sekali sebelumnya): lead ditampilkan begitu
  // saja sesuai urutan ditemukan, jadi lead berkualitas tinggi tercampur
  // dengan yang kemungkinan besar bukan target ideal. Sekarang bisa
  // diurutkan berdasarkan skor (default: tertinggi dulu), nama, atau baru
  // ditemukan dulu.
  if (sortMode==='score_desc') rows = rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.lead_score??-1)-(a.lead_score??-1));
  else if (sortMode==='score_asc') rows = rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>(a.lead_score??-1)-(b.lead_score??-1));
  else if (sortMode==='name_asc') rows = rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.business_name.localeCompare(b.business_name));
  else if (sortMode==='recent') rows = rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.last_checked||0)-new Date(a.last_checked||0));

  const tbody = document.getElementById('leads-table-body');
  if (rows.length===0){
    tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="8"><div class="empty-state">Tidak ada lead yang cocok. Import, tambahkan, atau jalankan Discovery untuk mendapatkan lead baru.</div></td></tr>`;
    return;
  }
  tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(l=>{
    const lvl = potentialLevel(l.lead_score);
    return `<tr class="row-clickable" data-id="${l.id}">
      <td>${escapeHtml(l.business_name)}</td>
      <td>${escapeHtml(l.category)}</td>
      <td>${escapeHtml(l.district!=='Unknown'?l.district:l.city)}</td>
      <td>${l.rating ?? '—'}</td>
      <td><span class="score-badge ${lvl.cls}">${l.lead_score ?? '—'}</span></td>
      <td><span class="status-pill status-${escapeHtml(l.status)}">${escapeHtml(l.status.replace('_',' '))}</span></td>
      <td style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--text-faint);">${(l.last_checked||'').slice(0,10)}</td>
      <td>${freshness(l.last_checked).icon} <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-faint);">${freshness(l.last_checked).label}</span></td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join('');
  tbody.querySelectorAll('tr').forEach(tr=>{
    tr.addEventListener('click', ()=> openDetail(tr.dataset.id));
  });
}

function getInstagramUsername(value){
  if(!value || ['Unknown','Not Found'].includes(value)) return null;
  let v=String(value).trim();
  const m=v.match(/instagram\.com\/(?:[^/]+\/)?([A-Za-z0-9._]+)/i);
  if(m) return m[1].replace(/^@/,'');
  v=v.replace(/^@/,'').replace(/^https?:\/\//i,'').replace(/^www\./i,'').replace(/^instagram\.com\//i,'').split(/[/?#]/)[0].trim();
  return /^[A-Za-z0-9._]{1,30}$/.test(v) ? v : null;
}
function instagramProfileUrl(lead){
  const u=getInstagramUsername(lead?.instagram);
  return u ? `https://www.instagram.com/${encodeURIComponent(u)}/` : null;
}
function instagramDMUrl(lead){
  const u=getInstagramUsername(lead?.instagram);
  return u ? `https://ig.me/m/${encodeURIComponent(u)}` : null;
}
// Manual lookup assist — OSM & Google Places do not provide Instagram as a
// data field, and we do not scrape Instagram itself. This simply opens a
// Google search in a new tab so a human can find and paste the handle via
// "New Lead" edit / CSV import. No automated fetching happens here.
function searchInstagramManually(id){
  const lead=LEADS.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!lead) return;
  const cityPart = [lead.city, lead.regency].filter(v=>v && v!=='Unknown').join(' ');
  const q = `site:instagram.com "${lead.business_name}" ${cityPart}`.trim();
  window.open(`https://www.google.com/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
}
function openInstagramProfile(id){
  const lead=LEADS.find(x=>x.id===id); const url=instagramProfileUrl(lead);
  if(!url){toast('Instagram belum ditemukan/terverifikasi untuk lead ini.');return;}
  window.open(url,'_blank','noopener,noreferrer');
}
async function prepareAndOpenInstagramDM(id){
  const lead=LEADS.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!lead)return;
  const url=instagramDMUrl(lead);
  if(!url){toast('Instagram belum ditemukan/terverifikasi untuk lead ini.');return;}
  // Open synchronously first to avoid popup blockers, then prepare the draft.
  const tab=window.open('about:blank','_blank');
  if(!tab){toast('Popup diblokir browser. Izinkan pop-up untuk TRACE.');return;}
  tab.document.write('<title>Menyiapkan Instagram…</title><body style="font-family:system-ui;padding:32px">Menyiapkan DM TRACE…</body>');
  try{
    if(!lead.analysis) await runAIAnalysis(id);
    let last=lead.outreach?.[lead.outreach.length-1];
    if(!last || !last.message || last.status!=='draft'){
      await generateDM(id);
    }
    await navigator.clipboard?.writeText(lead.outreach?.[lead.outreach.length-1]?.message || '');
    tab.location.href=url;
    toast('DM disiapkan & dibuka. Teks DM juga dicoba disalin.');
    renderDetail(lead); renderDashboard(); renderLeadsTable();
  }catch(e){
    console.error(e); tab.location.href=url; toast('Instagram dibuka. Draft DM belum siap; buka lead untuk membuatnya.');
  }
}

/* ---------- CSV import ---------- */
function parseCSV(text){
  const rows=[]; let row=[]; let cell=''; let quoted=false;
  for(let i=0;i<text.length;i++){
    const ch=text[i], next=text[i+1];
    if(ch==='"'){ if(quoted && next==='"'){cell+='"';i++;} else quoted=!quoted; }
    else if(ch===',' && !quoted){row.push(cell.trim());cell='';}
    else if((ch==='\n'||ch==='\r')&&!quoted){if(ch==='\r'&&next==='\n')i++;row.push(cell.trim());cell='';if(row.some(v=>v!==''))rows.push(row);row=[];}
    else cell+=ch;
  }
  if(cell!==''||row.length){row.push(cell.trim());rows.push(row);}
  if(rows.length<2)return []; const headers=rows[0].map(h=>h.trim());
  return rows.slice(1).map(cells=>{const obj={};headers.forEach((h,i)=>obj[h]=cells[i]??'');return obj;});
}

async function importCSV(){
  const text = document.getElementById('csv-input').value;
  if (!text.trim()){ toast('CSV kosong'); return; }
  const rows = parseCSV(text);
  if (rows.length===0){ toast('Format CSV tidak valid'); return; }
  let count = 0;
  rows.forEach(row=>{
    if (!row.business_name) return;
    const numOr = v => (v===undefined || v==='' ) ? null : Number(v);
    const strOr = v => (v===undefined || v==='') ? 'Unknown' : v;
    const lead = blankLead({
      business_name: row.business_name,
      category: strOr(row.category),
      city: strOr(row.city),
      regency: strOr(row.regency || row.city),
      district: strOr(row.district),
      address: strOr(row.address),
      phone: strOr(row.phone),
      website: strOr(row.website),
      instagram: strOr(row.instagram),
      rating: numOr(row.rating),
      review_count: numOr(row.review_count),
      price_range: strOr(row.price_range),
      outlet_count: numOr(row.outlet_count),
      opening_hours: strOr(row.opening_hours),
      source: strOr(row.source) === 'Unknown' ? 'csv import' : row.source,
      source_url: strOr(row.source_url)
    });
    LEADS.push(lead);
    count++;
  });
  await persistLeads();
  document.getElementById('import-result').textContent = `${count} lead berhasil diimport.`;
  toast(`${count} lead diimport`);
  renderDashboard(); renderLeadsTable();
}

function copyLatestDM(id){
  const l=LEADS.find(x=>x.id===id), o=l?.outreach?.[l.outreach.length-1]; if(!o)return;
  navigator.clipboard?.writeText(o.message).then(()=>toast('DM disalin')).catch(()=>toast('Tidak bisa copy otomatis; blok teks DM lalu copy.'));
}
async function markLatestSent(id){
  const l=LEADS.find(x=>x.id===id), o=l?.outreach?.[l.outreach.length-1]; if(!o)return;
  o.status='sent';o.sent_at=new Date().toISOString();l.status='contacted';scheduleNextFollowup(l,'contacted');l.updated_at=new Date().toISOString();await persistLeads();toast('DM ditandai sudah dikirim');renderDetail(l);renderDashboard();renderPipeline();
}
async function generateFollowup(id,step){
  const l=LEADS.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!l)return;
  const angle=l.analysis?.recommended_sales_angle||'profitability';
  const name=l.business_name;
  const msgs={
    1:`Halo Kak, izin follow up sedikit soal ${name}. Saya kepikiran satu hal dari sisi ${angle.toLowerCase()} yang mungkin cukup relevan untuk bisnisnya. Kalau berkenan, saya bisa share insight singkatnya di sini.`,
    2:`Halo Kak, saya tutup follow up saya untuk ${name} dulu ya. Kalau suatu saat sedang evaluasi ${angle.toLowerCase()} atau mau melihat angka bisnis lebih rapi, saya dengan senang hati bantu sharing benchmark awal tanpa komitmen.`
  };
  const msg=msgs[step]||msgs[1];
  l.outreach.push({id:uid(),channel:'instagram',message:msg,status:'draft',sequence:`followup_${step}`,sent_at:null,replied_at:null,notes:'Local follow-up draft — personalize before sending.',created_at:new Date().toISOString()});
  l.next_follow_up_at=step===1?daysFromNow(salesSettings().fu2):null;l.updated_at=new Date().toISOString();await persistLeads();toast(`Follow-up ${step} dibuat`);renderDetail(l);renderFollowups();
}

async function markConverted(id){
  const lead=LEADS.find(l=>l.id===id); if(!lead)return;
  try{
    const bridge=await getTraceBridge(1200);
    if(!bridge?.createClientFromLead) throw new Error('TRACE bridge belum siap');
    const result=await bridge.createClientFromLead(lead);
    lead.converted_to_client=true; lead.conversion_date=new Date().toISOString(); lead.trace_client_id=result.client.id; lead.updated_at=new Date().toISOString();
    await persistLeads();
    toast(result.existing?'Client sudah ada di Database Klien TRACE.':'Lead berhasil menjadi Client TRACE Consultant.');
  }catch(e){console.error(e);toast('Konversi gagal: '+(e.message||'periksa koneksi/database'),true);return;}
  renderDetail(lead);renderDashboard();renderLeadsTable();
}

    return `<div class="kanban-col"><div class="kanban-head"><span>${STAGE_LABELS[st]}</span><span class="kanban-count">${arr.length}</span></div>${arr.map(l=>`<div class="kanban-card" onclick="openDetail('${l.id}')"><div class="kanban-name">${escapeHtml(l.business_name)}</div><div class="kanban-meta">${escapeHtml(l.category)} · ${escapeHtml(l.district!=='Unknown'?l.district:l.city)}</div><div style="margin-top:6px;"><span class="score-badge ${potentialLevel(l.lead_score).cls}">${l.lead_score??'—'}</span></div>${l.next_follow_up_at?`<div class="next-action">Next: ${formatDateTime(l.next_follow_up_at)}</div>`:''}</div>`).join('') || '<div class="unknown" style="padding:12px 4px;">Kosong</div>'}</div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function renderFollowups(){
  const due=LEADS.filter(l=>l.next_follow_up_at && !['closed','not_a_fit'].includes(l.status)).sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.next_follow_up_at)-new Date(b.next_follow_up_at));
  const overdue=due.filter(followupDue).length;
  const today=due.filter(l=>{const d=new Date(l.next_follow_up_at),n=new Date();return d.toDateString()===n.toDateString()}).length;
  document.getElementById('followup-stats').innerHTML=[['Overdue',overdue],['Hari Ini',today],['Terjadwal',due.length],['High Potential',due.filter(l=>(l.lead_score||0)>=75).length]].map(x=>`<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">${x[1]}</div><div class="stat-label">${x[0]}</div></div>`).join('');
  const grid=document.getElementById('followup-grid');
  if(!due.length){grid.innerHTML='<div class="empty-state">Belum ada follow-up terjadwal. Saat lead ditandai Contacted, OS otomatis membuat jadwal follow-up.</div>';return;}
  grid.innerHTML=due.map(l=>`<div class="detail-block follow-card ${followupDue(l)?'overdue':''}"><div class="hero-eyebrow">${followupDue(l)?'OVERDUE':'NEXT ACTION'}</div><h3 style="margin:0 0 4px;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:16px;">${escapeHtml(l.business_name)}</h3><div class="muted-note">${escapeHtml(l.category)} · ${escapeHtml(l.district!=='Unknown'?l.district:l.city)}</div><div class="follow-date" style="margin-top:12px;">${formatDateTime(l.next_follow_up_at)}</div><div style="display:flex;gap:7px;margin-top:12px;"><button class="btn btn-accent btn-sm" onclick="openDetail('${l.id}')">Buka Lead</button><button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onclick="markFollowupDone('${l.id}')">Selesai</button></div></div>`).join('');
}
async function markFollowupDone(id){
  const l=LEADS.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!l)return; l.next_follow_up_at=null; l.notes=(l.notes?l.notes+'\n':'')+'Follow-up dilakukan '+formatDateTime(new Date().toISOString()); l.updated_at=new Date().toISOString(); await persistLeads(); toast('Follow-up ditandai selesai'); renderFollowups(); renderDashboard();
}
function renderInsights(){
  const contacted=LEADS.filter(l=>['contacted','replied','meeting','proposal','closed'].includes(l.status)).length;
  const replied=LEADS.filter(l=>['replied','meeting','proposal','closed'].includes(l.status)).length;
  const meetings=LEADS.filter(l=>['meeting','proposal','closed'].includes(l.status)).length;
  const won=LEADS.filter(l=>l.status==='closed').length;
  const replyRate=contacted?Math.round(replied/contacted*100):0;
  const meetRate=contacted?Math.round(meetings/contacted*100):0;
  const winRate=contacted?Math.round(won/contacted*100):0;
  document.getElementById('insight-stats').innerHTML=[['Contacted',contacted],['Reply Rate',replyRate+'%'],['Meeting Rate',meetRate+'%'],['Win Rate',winRate+'%']].map(x=>`<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">${x[1]}</div><div class="stat-label">${x[0]}</div></div>`).join('');
  const byAngle={}; LEADS.forEach(l=>{const a=l.analysis?.recommended_sales_angle||'Unknown';if(!byAngle[a])byAngle[a]={total:0,replied:0};byAngle[a].total++;if(['replied','meeting','proposal','closed'].includes(l.status))byAngle[a].replied++;});
  const angles=Object.entries(byAngle).sort((a,b)=>(b[1].replied/Math.max(1,b[1].total))-(a[1].replied/Math.max(1,a[1].total))).slice(0,5);
  document.getElementById('winning-signals').innerHTML=angles.length?angles.map(([a,v])=>{const rate=Math.round(v.replied/Math.max(1,v.total)*100);return `<div style="margin-bottom:12px;"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12px;"><span>${a}</span><span>${rate}% reply signal</span></div><div class="learning-bar"><div class="learning-fill" style="width:${Math.min(100,rate)}%"></div></div></div>`}).join(''):'<div class="unknown">Belum cukup data outcome. Mulai outreach untuk membangun learning signal.</div>';
  const cat={};LEADS.forEach(l=>{const k=l.category||'Unknown';if(!cat[k])cat[k]={n:0,score:0};cat[k].n++;cat[k].score+=(l.lead_score||0)});
  const focus=Object.entries(cat).map(([k,v])=>({k,avg:Math.round(v.score/Math.max(1,v.n)),n:v.n})).sort((a,b)=>b.avg-a.avg).slice(0,5);
  document.getElementById('recommended-focus').innerHTML=focus.map(x=>`<div class="kv"><span class="kv-k">${x.k} (${x.n})</span><span class="kv-v">Avg ${x.avg}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="unknown">Belum ada data.</div>';
  const funnel=[['Discovered',LEADS.length],['Analyzed',LEADS.filter(l=>l.analysis).length],['Contacted',contacted],['Replied',replied],['Meeting',meetings],['Won',won]];const max=Math.max(1,...funnel.map(x=>x[1]));
  document.getElementById('sales-funnel').innerHTML=funnel.map(x=>`<div class="funnel-row"><span>${x[0]}</span><div class="funnel-track"><div class="funnel-fill" style="width:${Math.round(x[1]/max*100)}%"></div></div><span>${x[1]}</span></div>`).join('');
}
function exportLeadsCSV(){
  const headers=['business_name','category','city','regency','district','address','phone','website','instagram','rating','review_count','price_range','outlet_count','lead_score','fit_score','fit_status','priority','acquisition_stage','status','next_follow_up_at','source','source_url','last_checked'];
  const esc=v=>'"'+String(v??'').replace(/"/g,'""')+'"';
  const csv=[headers.join(','),...LEADS.map(l=>headers.map(h=>esc(l[h])).join(','))].join('\n');
  downloadBlob(csv,'trace-acquisition-leads.csv','text/csv;charset=utf-8');
}
function exportBackup(){downloadBlob(JSON.stringify({version:'TRACE Acquisition OS Final',exported_at:new Date().toISOString(),leads:LEADS,settings:salesSettings()},null,2),'trace-acquisition-backup.json','application/json');}
function downloadBlob(text,name,type){const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text],{type}));a.download=name;a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000);}
async function restoreBackup(file){if(!file)return;try{const data=JSON.parse(await file.text());if(!Array.isArray(data.leads))throw new Error('Backup tidak valid');LEADS=data.leads;await persistLeads();if(data.settings)localStorage.setItem(SETTINGS_KEY,JSON.stringify(data.settings));toast('Backup berhasil dipulihkan');renderDashboard();renderLeadsTable();}catch(e){toast('Backup gagal dipulihkan');console.error(e);}}
async function clearAllLeads(){if(!confirm('Hapus semua lead dari browser ini? Data tidak dapat dipulihkan tanpa backup.'))return;LEADS=[];await persistLeads();toast('Semua data lokal dihapus');renderDashboard();renderLeadsTable();}
async function refreshStaleLeads(){
  const stale=LEADS.filter(l=>freshness(l.last_checked).label!=='Fresh'&&!['closed','not_a_fit'].includes(l.status));
  if(!stale.length){toast('Semua lead masih fresh');return;}
  // Refreshing means re-running discovery for the configured Bogor scope; source-level refresh updates records without creating duplicates.
  switchPage('discovery'); toast(`${stale.length} lead aging/stale. Menjalankan discovery untuk refresh sumber.`); setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('btn-start-discovery')?.click(),100);
}

/* ============================================================
   INIT
============================================================ */
(async function init(){
  await loadLeads();
  renderDashboard();
  renderLeadsTable();
  // Normalize legacy records for V2/V3 fields without changing existing data.
  LEADS.forEach(l=>{ if(l.fit_score===undefined)l.fit_score=l.lead_score??null; if(l.fit_status===undefined)l.fit_status=l.fit_score==null?'insufficient_data':(l.fit_score>=75?'high':l.fit_score>=50?'medium':'low'); if(l.priority===undefined)l.priority=l.fit_status==='high'?'P1':l.fit_status==='medium'?'P2':l.fit_status==='low'?'P3':'P4'; if(l.acquisition_stage===undefined)l.acquisition_stage=l.fit_score==null?'discovery':'prioritized'; if(!Array.isArray(l.problem_hypotheses))l.problem_hypotheses=[]; if(!Array.isArray(l.outreach))l.outreach=[]; if(l.next_follow_up_at===undefined)l.next_follow_up_at=null; if(l.notes===undefined)l.notes=''; if(l.converted_to_client===undefined)l.converted_to_client=false; });
  persistLeads();
})();
</script>

-- DRAFT — belum dijalankan/diverifikasi. Depends on migration 001.
--
-- KOREKSI SCOPE (2026-09-12): TRACE Consultants OS murni internal untuk
-- tim Trace sendiri — TIDAK ADA klien yang login sendiri ke aplikasi ini.
-- Tabel ini menampung DUA jenis akun sekaligus, dibedakan lewat
-- `is_internal_account`:
--   - is_internal_account = true  -> akun Instagram/TikTok Trace Consultants
--     sendiri (dipakai buat cari klien lewat konten), client_id di sini
--     boleh diisi konstanta tetap mis. 'trace-internal'.
--   - is_internal_account = false -> akun klien F&B, dikelola/dikonek oleh
--     TIM TRACE atas nama klien (lewat akses admin/collaborator yang
--     diberikan klien di luar aplikasi, atau OAuth yang dilakukan tim
--     Trace) — bukan klien connect sendiri lewat portal.
-- Makanya RLS di bawah cuma mengenal satu jenis akses: trace_is_team_member().
-- client_id di sini murni untuk mengelompokkan data di dalam kerja tim,
-- bukan untuk membatasi akses klien (klien memang tidak pernah masuk ke
-- sistem ini sama sekali, baik akun sendiri maupun akun Trace).
--
-- Token TIDAK PERNAH boleh dibaca lewat PostgREST bahkan oleh tim Trace —
-- hanya boleh ditulis/dibaca oleh backend tepercaya (mis. Edge Function
-- pakai service role) saat proses OAuth callback dan refresh token. Makanya
-- kolom token di-exclude dari grant select secara eksplisit (column-level
-- grant), bukan cuma "jangan ditampilkan di UI" — ini proteksi di level
-- database, supaya token tidak bocor lewat DevTools/network tab tim sendiri.

create table if not exists public.trace_social_accounts (

  last_synced_at timestamptz,

);

-- Update status (mis. tim Trace klik "revoke" saat akses klien dicabut)
-- diberikan lewat function security definer di bawah, BUKAN lewat UPDATE
-- langsung ke tabel — supaya token tetap tidak bisa diutak-atik langsung
-- lewat client-side call walau grant select-nya sudah dibatasi. Tidak ada
-- policy "for update" untuk authenticated.

create or replace function public.trace_revoke_social_account(p_account_id uuid)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_row public.trace_social_accounts%rowtype;
begin
  select * into v_row from public.trace_social_accounts where id = p_account_id;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'TRACE_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if not public.trace_is_team_member() then
    raise exception 'TRACE_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT_ACCESS_DENIED';
  end if;

  update public.trace_social_accounts
  set status = 'revoked',
      access_token_ciphertext = null,
      refresh_token_ciphertext = null,
      token_expires_at = null
  where id = p_account_id
  returning * into v_row;

  return jsonb_build_object('id', v_row.id, 'status', v_row.status);
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.trace_revoke_social_account(uuid) from public;
grant execute on function public.trace_revoke_social_account(uuid) to authenticated;

drop trigger if exists trg_trace_social_accounts_updated_at on public.trace_social_accounts;
create trigger trg_trace_social_accounts_updated_at
  before update on public.trace_social_accounts
  for each row execute function public.trace_set_updated_at();

-- ============================================================================
-- Dipilih: kacamata PER-CLIENT (bukan satu akun Trace pusat), dengan
-- fallback eksplisit (bukan silent-fail), prioritas antrian refresh, dan
-- cap jumlah kompetitor per klien. Semua tabel/fungsi baru di bawah ini

-- 1. Kacamata per klien — satu baris per client_id, menunjuk ke salah satu
--    trace_social_accounts milik client_id yang sama. Validasi lintas kolom
--    (harus milik client_id yang sama, bukan akun internal, dan berstatus
--    connected) dilakukan di trigger karena tidak bisa murni pakai FK/CHECK.
create table if not exists public.trace_competitor_discovery_lens (

create or replace function public.trace_validate_discovery_lens()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_account public.trace_social_accounts%rowtype;
begin
  if new.discovery_account_id is null then
    return new;
  end if;

  select * into v_account
  from public.trace_social_accounts
  where id = new.discovery_account_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'TRACE_DISCOVERY_LENS_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND';
  end if;
  if v_account.client_id <> new.client_id then
    raise exception 'TRACE_DISCOVERY_LENS_CLIENT_MISMATCH';
  end if;
  if v_account.is_internal_account then
    raise exception 'TRACE_DISCOVERY_LENS_MUST_BE_CLIENT_ACCOUNT';
  end if;
  if v_account.status <> 'connected' then
    raise exception 'TRACE_DISCOVERY_LENS_ACCOUNT_NOT_CONNECTED';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists trg_trace_validate_discovery_lens on public.trace_competitor_discovery_lens;
create trigger trg_trace_validate_discovery_lens
  before insert or update on public.trace_competitor_discovery_lens
  for each row execute function public.trace_validate_discovery_lens();

-- 2. Cap jumlah kompetitor per klien — enforced di trigger, bukan cuma
--    disiplin tim, supaya kualitas data per kompetitor terjaga (kompetitor
--    sedikit tapi sering di-refresh > kompetitor banyak tapi data basi).
--    Cap dibaca dari trace_competitor_discovery_lens.max_competitors kalau
--    sudah ada baris untuk client_id itu; default 5 kalau belum ada.
create or replace function public.trace_enforce_competitor_cap()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_cap integer;
  v_count integer;
begin
  select coalesce(
    (select max_competitors from public.trace_competitor_discovery_lens where client_id = new.client_id),
    5
  ) into v_cap;

  select count(*) into v_count
  from public.trace_competitor_accounts
  where client_id = new.client_id;

  if v_count >= v_cap then
    raise exception 'TRACE_COMPETITOR_CAP_REACHED: client % sudah punya % kompetitor (batas %)', new.client_id, v_count, v_cap;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists trg_trace_enforce_competitor_cap on public.trace_competitor_accounts;
create trigger trg_trace_enforce_competitor_cap
  before insert on public.trace_competitor_accounts
  for each row execute function public.trace_enforce_competitor_cap();

-- 3. Status kacamata eksplisit per klien — view, BUKAN silent gap. UI wajib
--    query ini sebelum render halaman kompetitor, supaya klien yang belum
--    punya kacamata tampil dengan status jelas ('no_lens_configured'), bukan
--    cuma daftar kosong tanpa keterangan (evidence-first, konsisten dengan
--    prinsip di core/evidence.ts).
-- PENTING: driven dari UNIVERSE client_id (akun klien + kompetitor + lens
-- yang sudah ada), BUKAN cuma dari trace_competitor_discovery_lens. Kalau
-- driven dari tabel lens saja, klien yang belum pernah punya baris lens sama
-- sekali akan hilang total dari hasil view (0 baris) alih-alih tampil
-- dengan status 'no_lens_configured' — persis silent gap yang ingin
-- dihindari. (Ketahuan lewat functional test sebelum migration ini
-- difinalkan — lihat catatan pengujian.)
create or replace view public.trace_competitor_discovery_status as
with known_clients as (
  select distinct client_id from public.trace_social_accounts where is_internal_account = false
  union
  select distinct client_id from public.trace_competitor_accounts
  union
  select distinct client_id from public.trace_competitor_discovery_lens
)
select
  kc.client_id,
  l.discovery_account_id,
  case
    when l.discovery_account_id is null then 'no_lens_configured'
    when sa.status = 'connected' then 'lens_active'
    when sa.status = 'expired' then 'lens_expired'
    when sa.status = 'revoked' then 'lens_revoked'
    else 'unknown'
  end as lens_status,
  coalesce(l.max_competitors, 5) as max_competitors,
  (select count(*) from public.trace_competitor_accounts ca where ca.client_id = kc.client_id) as current_competitor_count
from known_clients kc
left join public.trace_competitor_discovery_lens l on l.client_id = kc.client_id
left join public.trace_social_accounts sa on sa.id = l.discovery_account_id;

-- security_invoker supaya RLS trace_competitor_discovery_lens dan
-- trace_social_accounts tetap berlaku lewat view ini — bukan security
-- definer view yang diam-diam melewati RLS.
alter view public.trace_competitor_discovery_status set (security_invoker = true);
grant select on public.trace_competitor_discovery_status to authenticated;

-- 4. Prioritas antrian refresh — kompetitor yang paling lama tidak
--    di-refresh (atau belum pernah sama sekali) diprioritaskan duluan.
--    SENGAJA TANPA security definer supaya RLS tetap jalan lewat hak akses
--    pemanggil (team member) — dipanggil oleh job sync (belum dibuat),
--    bukan endpoint bebas dipanggil client-side sembarangan.
create or replace function public.trace_next_competitor_refresh(p_client_id text, p_limit integer default 5)
returns table(competitor_id uuid, handle text, last_captured_at timestamptz)
language sql
stable
set search_path = public
as $$
  select
    ca.id as competitor_id,
    ca.handle,
    (select max(cs.captured_at) from public.trace_competitor_snapshots cs where cs.competitor_id = ca.id) as last_captured_at
  from public.trace_competitor_accounts ca
  where ca.client_id = p_client_id
  order by last_captured_at asc nulls first
  limit p_limit;
$$;

revoke all on function public.trace_next_competitor_refresh(text, integer) from public;
grant execute on function public.trace_next_competitor_refresh(text, integer) to authenticated;

-- CATATAN BELUM SELESAI (sisa, di luar scope keputusan 2026-09-12 di atas):
-- 1. Edge Function/job sync yang benar-benar MEMANGGIL
--    trace_next_competitor_refresh() dan menulis ke trace_competitor_snapshots

--    yang mengeksekusinya secara terjadwal.
-- 2. UI untuk tim mengisi/mengubah trace_competitor_discovery_lens (pilih

-- 3. max_competitors default 5 adalah asumsi awal berdasarkan kapasitas tim

Discovery

Temukan bisnis F&B di wilayah target

Tidak perlu mencari Google → Maps → Instagram satu per satu. OS akan mengambil data dari sumber yang tersedia, menghapus duplikat, lalu memprioritaskan lead.

Pengaturan sumber data
Google Places menambah rating, jumlah review, website, telepon, jam buka, dan Google Maps URL. API key disimpan di server/proxy, bukan di browser. Instagram hanya disimpan bila ditemukan dan dapat diverifikasi; sistem tidak melakukan bypass Instagram.

Analysis EngineFact-based heuristic + optional AI provider

V1 tidak memerlukan API key untuk discovery dasar. Untuk data Google rating/review/website/telepon yang lebih lengkap, sambungkan Google Places melalui server-side proxy.

AI / Scoring

Jika AI provider belum dikonfigurasi, OS tetap melakukan scoring lokal berbasis data nyata yang tersedia. Hasil tersebut ditandai sebagai Local heuristic, bukan fakta dari AI.

Sales Learning

V3 menggunakan hasil contacted → replied → meeting → proposal → won sebagai sinyal pembelajaran untuk memprioritaskan lead berikutnya. Ini adalah learning heuristic lokal, bukan model AI yang mengarang data.

Backup & Data

Data Acquisition tersimpan mengikuti storage TRACE Consultant saat modul dibuka dari dalam TRACE. Backup JSON tetap tersedia sebagai cadangan manual.

Data Ingestion
Foundation import — CSV manual, bukan scraping otomatis

Import via CSV

Header wajib: business_name
Header opsional: category, city, regency, district, address, phone, website, instagram, rating, review_count, price_range, outlet_count, opening_hours, source, source_url
Kolom kosong akan otomatis diberi label "Unknown".
Catatan sumber data: setiap lead menyimpan field source dan last_checked. Sistem ini tidak melakukan scraping otomatis atau bypass rate-limit/authentication pihak ketiga. Untuk data live (Google Maps, Instagram, dsb), hubungkan API resmi melalui layer ingestion terpisah — di luar scope V1.
